verses.zh: 我的仇敌转身退去的时候，他们一见你的面就跌倒灭亡。

verses.en: For you have maintained my just cause. You sit on the throne judging righteously.
verses.zh: 因你已经为我伸冤，为我辨屈；你坐在宝座上，按公义审判。

verses.en: You have rebuked the nations. You have destroyed the wicked. You have blotted out their name forever and ever.
verses.zh: 你曾斥责外邦，你曾灭绝恶人；你曾涂抹他们的名，直到永永远远。

verses.en: The enemy is overtaken by endless ruin. The very memory of the cities which you have overthrown has perished.
verses.zh: 仇敌到了尽头；他们被毁坏，直到永远。你拆毁他们的城邑，连他们的名号都归于无有。

words.g: to complete, in a good or a bad sense
to + a goal, i.e. the bright object at adistance travelled towards

verses.en: But the LORD reigns forever. He has prepared his throne for judgment.
verses.zh: 惟耶和华坐着为王，直到永远；他已经为审判设摆他的宝座。

verses.en: He will judge the world in righteousness. He will administer judgment to the peoples in uprightness.
verses.zh: 他要按公义审判世界，按正直判断万民。

words.g: a straight course, i.e. sail direct
in + evenness, i.e.  prosperity or concord

verses.en: The LORD will also be a high tower for the oppressed; a high tower in times of trouble.
verses.zh: 耶和华又要给受欺压的人作高台，在患难的时候作高台。

verses.en: Those who know your name will put their trust in you, for you, LORD, have not forsaken those who seek you.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，认识你名的人要倚靠你，因你没有离弃寻求你的人。

verses.en: Sing praises to the LORD, who dwells in Zion, and declare among the people what he has done.
verses.zh: 应当歌颂居锡安的耶和华，将他所行的传扬在众民中。

verses.en: For he who avenges blood remembers them. He doesn’t forget the cry of the afflicted.
verses.zh: 因为那追讨流人血之罪的―他记念受屈的人，不忘记困苦人的哀求。

words.g: to mislay, i.e. to be oblivious of

verses.en: Have mercy on me, LORD. See my affliction by those who hate me, and lift me up from the gates of death,
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，你是从死门把我提拔起来的；求你怜恤我，看那恨我的人所加给我的苦难，

words.g: to be high actively, to rise or raise + +me/my

verses.en: that I may show all of your praise. I will rejoice in your salvation in the gates of the daughter of Zion.
verses.zh: 好叫我述说你一切的美德；我必在锡安城（原文是女子）的门因你的救恩欢乐。

words.g: to score with a mark as a tally or record, i.e.  to inscribe
to spin round , i.e. usually rejoice

verses.en: The nations have sunk down in the pit that they made. In the net which they hid, their own foot is taken.
verses.zh: 外邦人陷在自己所掘的坑中；他们的脚在自己暗设的网罗里缠住了。

verses.en: The LORD has made himself known. He has executed judgment. The wicked is snared by the work of his own hands. Meditation. Selah.
verses.zh: 耶和华已将自己显明了，他已施行审判；恶人被自己手所做的缠住了（或译：他叫恶人被自己手所做的累住了）。（细拉）

words.g: a murmuring sound, i.e. a musical notation

verses.en: The wicked shall be turned back to Sheol, even all the nations that forget God.
verses.zh: 恶人，就是忘记神的外邦人，都必归到阴间。

verses.en: For the needy shall not always be forgotten, nor the hope of the poor perish forever.
verses.zh: 穷乏人必不永久被忘；困苦人的指望必不永远落空。

words.g: to + a goal, i.e. the bright object at adistance travelled towards
to mislay, i.e. to be oblivious of

verses.en: Arise, LORD! Don’t let man prevail. Let the nations be judged in your sight.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，求你起来，不容人得胜！愿外邦人在你面前受审判！

verses.en: Put them in fear, LORD. Let the nations know that they are only men. Selah.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，求你使外邦人恐惧；愿他们知道自己不过是人。（细拉）

verses.en: Why do you stand far off, LORD? Why do you hide yourself in times of trouble?
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，你为甚么站在远处？在患难的时候为甚么隐藏？

words.g: to veil from sight, i.e. conceal

verses.en: In arrogance, the wicked hunt down the weak. They are caught in the schemes that they devise.
verses.zh: 恶人在骄横中把困苦人追得火急；愿他们陷在自己所设的计谋里。

verses.en: For the wicked boasts of his heart’s cravings. He blesses the greedy and condemns the LORD.
verses.zh: 因为恶人以心愿自夸；贪财的背弃耶和华，并且轻慢他（或译：他祝福贪财的，却轻慢耶和华）。

verses.en: The wicked, in the pride of his face, has no room in his thoughts for God.
verses.zh: 恶人面带骄傲，说：耶和华必不追究；他一切所想的都以为没有神。

verses.en: His ways are prosperous at all times. He is arrogant, and your laws are far from his sight. As for all his adversaries, he sneers at them.
verses.zh: 凡他所做的，时常稳固；你的审判超过他的眼界。至于他一切的敌人，他都向他们喷气。

words.g: to twist or whirl , i.e.  to dance
to puff, i.e. blow with the breath or air

verses.en: He says in his heart, “I shall not be shaken. For generations I shall have no trouble.”
verses.zh: 他心里说：我必不动摇，世世代代不遭灾难。

verses.en: His mouth is full of cursing, deceit, and oppression. Under his tongue is mischief and iniquity.
verses.zh: 他满口是咒骂、诡诈、欺压，舌底是毒害、奸恶。

words.g: the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +him/his/it

verses.en: He lies in wait near the villages. From ambushes, he murders the innocent. His eyes are secretly set against the helpless.
verses.zh: 他在村庄埋伏等候；他在隐密处杀害无辜的人。他的眼睛窥探无倚无靠的人；

words.g: in + a concealer, i.e. a covert

verses.en: He lurks in secret as a lion in his ambush. He lies in wait to catch the helpless. He catches the helpless when he draws him in his net.
verses.zh: 他埋伏在暗地，如狮子蹲在洞中。他埋伏，要掳去困苦人；他拉网，就把困苦人掳去。

words.g: in + a concealer, i.e. a covert
in + to draw, used in a great variety of applications + +him/his/it

verses.en: The helpless are crushed. They collapse. They fall under his strength.
verses.zh: 他屈身蹲伏，无倚无靠的人就倒在他爪牙（爪牙：或译强暴人）之下。

verses.en: He says in his heart, “God has forgotten. He hides his face. He will never see it.”
verses.zh: 他心里说：神竟忘记了；他掩面永不观看。

words.g: to mislay, i.e. to be oblivious of
to + a goal, i.e. the bright object at adistance travelled towards

verses.en: Arise, LORD! God, lift up your hand! Don’t forget the helpless.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，求你起来！神啊，求你举手，不要忘记困苦人！

words.g: to mislay, i.e. to be oblivious of

verses.en: Why does the wicked person condemn God, and say in his heart, “God won’t call me into account”?
verses.zh: 恶人为何轻慢神，心里说：你必不追究？

verses.en: But you do see trouble and grief. You consider it to take it into your hand. You help the victim and the fatherless.
verses.zh: 其实你已经观看；因为奸恶毒害，你都看见了，为要以手施行报应。无倚无靠的人把自己交托你；你向来是帮助孤儿的。

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you
thou and thee, or  ye and you
to surround, i.e. protect or aid

verses.en: Break the arm of the wicked. As for the evil man, seek out his wickedness until you find none.
verses.zh: 愿你打断恶人的膀臂；至于坏人，愿你追究他的恶，直到净尽。

verses.en: The LORD is King forever and ever! The nations will perish out of his land.
verses.zh: 耶和华永永远远为王；外邦人从他的地已经灭绝了。

verses.en: LORD, you have heard the desire of the humble. You will prepare their heart. You will cause your ear to hear,
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，谦卑人的心愿，你早已知道（原文是听见）。你必预备他们的心，也必侧耳听他们的祈求，

words.g: to prick up the ears, i.e. hearken

verses.en: to judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that man who is of the earth may terrify no more.
verses.zh: 为要给孤儿和受欺压的人伸冤，使强横的人不再威吓他们。

words.g: to + to awe or  to dread

verses.en: For the Chief Musician. By David. In the LORD, I take refuge. How can you say to my soul, “Flee as a bird to your mountain”?
verses.zh: （大卫的诗，交与伶长。）我是投靠耶和华；你们怎么对我说：你当像鸟飞往你的山去。

words.g: to + to glitter from afar, i.e. to be eminent

verses.en: For, behold, the wicked bend their bows. They set their arrows on the strings, that they may shoot in darkness at the upright in heart.
verses.zh: 看哪，恶人弯弓，把箭搭在弦上，要在暗中射那心里正直的人。

words.g: a bow, forshooting  or the iris

verses.en: If the foundations are destroyed, what can the righteous do?
verses.zh: 根基若毁坏，义人还能做甚么呢？

words.g: the + a basis, i.e.  political or moral support
to pull down or in pieces, break
to do or make , especially to practise

verses.en: The LORD is in his holy temple. The LORD is on his throne in heaven. His eyes observe. His eyes examine the children of men.
verses.zh: 耶和华在他的圣殿里；耶和华的宝座在天上；他的慧眼察看世人。

verses.en: The LORD examines the righteous, but his soul hates the wicked and him who loves violence.
verses.zh: 耶和华试验义人；惟有恶人和喜爱强暴的人，他心里恨恶。

verses.en: On the wicked he will rain blazing coals; fire, sulfur, and scorching wind shall be the portion of their cup.
verses.zh: 他要向恶人密布网罗；有烈火、硫磺、热风，作他们杯中的分。

verses.en: For the LORD is righteous. He loves righteousness. The upright shall see his face.
verses.zh: 因为耶和华是公义的，他喜爱公义；正直人必得见他的面。

verses.en: For the Chief Musician; upon an eight-stringed lyre. A Psalm of David.
verses.zh: （大卫的诗，交与伶长。调用第八。）

words.g: to + to glitter from afar, i.e. to be eminent

verses.en: Help, LORD; for the godly man ceases. For the faithful fail from among the children of men.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，求你帮助，因虔诚人断绝了；世人中间的忠信人没有了。

words.g: to be open, wide or free

verses.en: Everyone lies to his neighbor. They speak with flattering lips, and with a double heart.
verses.zh: 人人向邻舍说谎；他们说话，是嘴唇油滑，心口不一。

verses.en: May the LORD cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that boasts,
verses.zh: 凡油滑的嘴唇和夸大的舌头，耶和华必要剪除。

verses.en: who have said, “With our tongue we will prevail. Our lips are our own. Who is lord over us?”
verses.zh: 他们曾说：我们必能以舌头得胜；我们的嘴唇是我们自己的，谁能作我们的主呢？

verses.en: “Because of the oppression of the weak and because of the groaning of the needy, I will now arise,” says the LORD; “I will set him in safety from those who malign him.”
verses.zh: 耶和华说：因为困苦人的冤屈和贫穷人的叹息，我现在要起来，把他安置在他所切慕的稳妥之地。

words.g: to puff, i.e. blow with the breath or air

verses.en: The LORD’s words are flawless words, as silver refined in a clay furnace, purified seven times.
verses.zh: 耶和华的言语是纯净的言语，如同银子在泥炉中炼过七次。

verses.en: You will keep them, LORD. You will preserve them from this generation forever.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，你必保护他们；你必保佑他们永远脱离这世代的人。

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you
to guard, in a good sense  or a bad one + +him/his/it

verses.en: The wicked walk on every side, when what is vile is exalted among the sons of men.
verses.zh: 下流人在世人中升高，就有恶人到处游行。

words.g: like + to be high actively, to rise or raise
a shaking, i.e. perhaps a tempest

verses.en: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David.
verses.zh: （大卫的诗，交与伶长。）

words.g: to + to glitter from afar, i.e. to be eminent

verses.en: How long, LORD? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，你忘记我要到几时呢？要到永远吗？你掩面不顾我要到几时呢？

words.g: to mislay, i.e. to be oblivious of + +me/my
a goal, i.e. the bright object at adistance travelled towards

verses.en: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart every day? How long shall my enemy triumph over me?
verses.zh: 我心里筹算，终日愁苦，要到几时呢？我的仇敌升高压制我，要到几时呢？

words.g: to be high actively, to rise or raise

verses.en: Behold, and answer me, LORD, my God. Give light to my eyes, lest I sleep in death;
verses.zh: 耶和华―我的神啊，求你看顾我，应允我！使我眼目光明，免得我沉睡至死；

verses.en: lest my enemy say, “I have prevailed against him;” lest my adversaries rejoice when I fall.
verses.zh: 免得我的仇敌说：我胜了他；免得我的敌人在我摇动的时候喜乐。

words.g: to spin round , i.e. usually rejoice

verses.en: But I trust in your loving kindness. My heart rejoices in your salvation. I will sing to the LORD, because he has been good to me.
verses.zh: 但我倚靠你的慈爱；我的心因你的救恩快乐。我要向耶和华歌唱，因他用厚恩待我。

words.g: to spin round , i.e. usually rejoice
to treat a person , i.e. benefit or requite

verses.en: For the Chief Musician. By David. The fool has said in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt. They have done abominable deeds. There is no one who does good.
verses.zh: （大卫的诗，交与伶长。）愚顽人心里说：没有神。他们都是邪恶，行了可憎恶的事；没有一个人行善。

words.g: to + to glitter from afar, i.e. to be eminent

verses.en: The LORD looked down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there were any who understood, who sought after God.
verses.zh: 耶和华从天上垂看世人，要看有明白的没有，有寻求神的没有。

words.g: to lean out , i.e.  peep or gaze
to be  circumspect and hence, intelligent

verses.en: They have all gone aside. They have together become corrupt. There is no one who does good, no, not one.
verses.zh: 他们都偏离正路，一同变为污秽；并没有行善的，连一个也没有。

words.g: to muddle, i.e.  to turn  corrupt

verses.en: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and don’t call on the LORD?
verses.zh: 作孽的都没有知识吗？他们吞吃我的百姓，如同吃饭一样，并不求告耶和华。

words.g: to do or make , especially to practise

verses.en: There they were in great fear, for God is in the generation of the righteous.
verses.zh: 他们在那里大大地害怕，因为神在义人的族类中。

verses.en: You frustrate the plan of the poor, because the LORD is his refuge.
verses.zh: 你们叫困苦人的谋算变为羞辱；然而耶和华是他的避难所。

words.g: to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed

verses.en: Oh that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion! When the LORD restores the fortunes of his people, then Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.
verses.zh: 但愿以色列的救恩从锡安而出。耶和华救回他被掳的子民那时，雅各要快乐，以色列要欢喜。

words.g: from + Tsijon , a mountain of Jerusalem
to spin round , i.e. usually rejoice

verses.en: A Psalm by David. LORD, who shall dwell in your sanctuary? Who shall live on your holy hill?
verses.zh: （大卫的诗。）耶和华啊，谁能寄居你的帐幕？谁能住在你的圣山？

words.g: to turn aside from the road , i.e. sojourn

verses.en: He who walks blamelessly and does what is right, and speaks truth in his heart;
verses.zh: 就是行为正直、做事公义、心里说实话的人。

words.g: and + to do or make , especially to practise

verses.en: he who doesn’t slander with his tongue, nor does evil to his friend, nor casts slurs against his fellow man;
verses.zh: 他不以舌头谗谤人，不恶待朋友，也不随伙毁谤邻里。

verses.en: in whose eyes a vile man is despised, but who honors those who fear the LORD; he who keeps an oath even when it hurts, and doesn’t change;
verses.zh: 他眼中藐视匪类，却尊重那敬畏耶和华的人。他发了誓，虽然自己吃亏也不更改。

verses.en: he who doesn’t lend out his money for usury, nor take a bribe against the innocent. He who does these things shall never be shaken.
verses.zh: 他不放债取利，不受贿赂以害无辜。行这些事的人必永不动摇。

verses.en: A Poem by David. Preserve me, God, for I take refuge in you.
verses.zh: （大卫的金诗。）神啊，求你保佑我，因为我投靠你。

verses.en: My soul, you have said to the LORD, “You are my Lord. Apart from you I have no good thing.”
verses.zh: 我的心哪，你曾对耶和华说：你是我的主；我的好处不在你以外。

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: As for the saints who are on the earth, they are the excellent ones in whom is all my delight.
verses.zh: 论到世上的圣民，他们又美又善，是我最喜悦的。

verses.en: Their sorrows shall be multiplied who give gifts to another god. Their drink offerings of blood I will not offer, nor take their names on my lips.
verses.zh: 以别神代替耶和华的（或译：送礼物给别神的），他们的愁苦必加增；他们所浇奠的血我不献上；我嘴唇也不提别神的名号。

words.g: to be liquid or flow easily, i.e
to pour out, especially a libation

verses.en: The LORD assigned my portion and my cup. You made my lot secure.
verses.zh: 耶和华是我的产业，是我杯中的分；我所得的，你为我持守。

words.g: something weighed out, i.e.  a division
thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: The lines have fallen to me in pleasant places. Yes, I have a good inheritance.
verses.zh: 用绳量给我的地界，坐落在佳美之处；我的产业实在美好。

words.g: a rope , especially a measuring line

verses.en: I will bless the LORD, who has given me counsel. Yes, my heart instructs me in the night seasons.
verses.zh: 我必称颂那指教我的耶和华；我的心肠在夜间也警戒我。

verses.en: I have set the LORD always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
verses.zh: 我将耶和华常摆在我面前，因他在我右边，我便不致摇动。

verses.en: Therefore my heart is glad, and my tongue rejoices. My body shall also dwell in safety.
verses.zh: 因此，我的心欢喜，我的灵（原文是荣耀）快乐；我的肉身也要安然居住。

words.g: and + to spin round , i.e. usually rejoice
weight, but only figuratively in a good sense + +me/my

verses.en: For you will not leave my soul in Sheol, neither will you allow your holy one to see corruption.
verses.zh: 因为你必不将我的灵魂撇在阴间，也不叫你的圣者见朽坏。

verses.en: You will show me the path of life. In your presence is fullness of joy. In your right hand there are pleasures forever more.
verses.zh: 你必将生命的道路指示我。在你面前有满足的喜乐；在你右手中有永远的福乐。

words.g: a goal, i.e. the bright object at adistance travelled towards

verses.en: A Prayer by David. Hear, LORD, my righteous plea. Give ear to my prayer that doesn’t go out of deceitful lips.
verses.zh: （大卫的祈祷。）耶和华啊，求你听闻公义，侧耳听我的呼吁！求你留心听我这不出于诡诈嘴唇的祈祷！

words.g: to prick up the ears, i.e. hearken
to broaden out the ear , i.e.  to listen

verses.en: Let my sentence come out of your presence. Let your eyes look on equity.
verses.zh: 愿我的判语从你面前发出；愿你的眼睛观看公正。

verses.en: You have proved my heart. You have visited me in the night. You have tried me, and found nothing. I have resolved that my mouth shall not disobey.
verses.zh: 你已经试验我的心；你在夜间鉴察我；你熬炼我，却找不着甚么；我立志叫我口中没有过失。

words.g: to plan, usually in a bad sense
the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +me/my

verses.en: As for the deeds of men, by the word of your lips, I have kept myself from the ways of the violent.
verses.zh: 论到人的行为，我藉着你嘴唇的言语自己谨守，不行强暴人的道路。

verses.en: My steps have held fast to your paths. My feet have not slipped.
verses.zh: 我的脚踏定了你的路径；我的两脚未曾滑跌。

verses.en: I have called on you, for you will answer me, God. Turn your ear to me. Hear my speech.
verses.zh: 神啊，我曾求告你，因为你必应允我；求你向我侧耳，听我的言语。

verses.en: Show your marvelous loving kindness, you who save those who take refuge by your right hand from their enemies.
verses.zh: 求你显出你奇妙的慈爱来；你是那用右手拯救投靠你的脱离起来攻击他们的人。

words.g: to be open, wide or free

verses.en: Keep me as the apple of your eye. Hide me under the shadow of your wings,
verses.zh: 求你保护我，如同保护眼中的瞳人；将我隐藏在你翅膀的荫下，

words.g: like + the little man of the eye

verses.en: from the wicked who oppress me, my deadly enemies, who surround me.
verses.zh: 使我脱离那欺压我的恶人，就是围困我要害我命的仇敌。

words.g: to strike with more or less violence

verses.en: They close up their callous hearts. With their mouth they speak proudly.
verses.zh: 他们的心被脂油包裹；他们用口说骄傲的话。

words.g: the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +them/their

verses.en: They have now surrounded us in our steps. They set their eyes to cast us down to the earth.
verses.zh: 他们围困了我们的脚步；他们瞪着眼，要把我们推倒在地。

words.g: to + to stretch or spread out

verses.en: He is like a lion that is greedy of his prey, as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.
verses.zh: 他像狮子急要抓食，又像少壮狮子蹲伏在暗处。

words.g: to become pale, i.e.  to pine after
in + a concealer, i.e. a covert

verses.en: Arise, LORD, confront him. Cast him down. Deliver my soul from the wicked by your sword,
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，求你起来，前去迎敌，将他打倒！用你的刀救护我命脱离恶人。

verses.en: from men by your hand, LORD, from men of the world, whose portion is in this life. You fill the belly of your cherished ones. Your sons have plenty, and they store up wealth for their children.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，求你用手救我脱离世人，脱离那只在今生有福分的世人！你把你的财宝充满他们的肚腹；他们因有儿女就心满意足，将其余的财物留给他们的婴孩。

verses.en: As for me, I shall see your face in righteousness. I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with seeing your form.
verses.zh: 至于我，我必在义中见你的面；我醒了的时候，得见（或译：着）你的形像就心满意足了。

verses.en: For the Chief Musician. By David the servant of the LORD, who spoke to the LORD the words of this song in the day that the LORD delivered him from the hand of all his enemies, and from the hand of Saul. He said,
verses.zh: （耶和华的仆人大卫的诗，交与伶长。当耶和华救他脱离一切仇敌和扫罗之手的日子，他向耶和华念这诗的话。说：）

words.g: to + to glitter from afar, i.e. to be eminent
Shaul, the name of an Edomite and two Israelites

verses.en: I love you, LORD, my strength.
verses.zh: 耶和华，我的力量啊，我爱你！

verses.en: The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my rock, in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower.
verses.zh: 耶和华是我的岩石，我的山寨，我的救主，我的神，我的磐石，我所投靠的。他是我的盾牌，是拯救我的角，是我的高台。

words.g: a craggy rock, literally or figuratively + +me/my

verses.en: I call on the LORD, who is worthy to be praised; and I am saved from my enemies.
verses.zh: 我要求告当赞美的耶和华；这样我必从仇敌手中被救出来。

words.g: to be open, wide or free

verses.en: The cords of death surrounded me. The floods of ungodliness made me afraid.
verses.zh: 曾有死亡的绳索缠绕我，匪类的急流使我惊惧，

words.g: a rope , especially a measuring line
and + a stream, especially a winter torrent

verses.en: The cords of Sheol were around me. The snares of death came on me.
verses.zh: 阴间的绳索缠绕我，死亡的网罗临到我。

words.g: a rope , especially a measuring line

verses.en: In my distress I called on the LORD, and cried to my God. He heard my voice out of his temple. My cry before him came into his ears.
verses.zh: 我在急难中求告耶和华，向我的神呼求。他从殿中听了我的声音；我在他面前的呼求入了他的耳中。

verses.en: Then the earth shook and trembled. The foundations also of the mountains quaked and were shaken, because he was angry.
verses.zh: 那时，因他发怒，地就摇撼战抖；山的根基也震动摇撼。

words.g: and + to undulate , particularly through fear

verses.en: Smoke went out of his nostrils. Consuming fire came out of his mouth. Coals were kindled by it.
verses.zh: 从他鼻孔冒烟上腾；从他口中发火焚烧，连炭也着了。

words.g: from + the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +him/his/it

verses.en: He bowed the heavens also, and came down. Thick darkness was under his feet.
verses.zh: 他又使天下垂，亲自降临，有黑云在他脚下。

words.g: and + to stretch or spread out

verses.en: He rode on a cherub, and flew. Yes, he soared on the wings of the wind.
verses.zh: 他坐着基路伯飞行；他藉着风的翅膀快飞。

words.g: and + to dart, i.e. fly rapidly

verses.en: He made darkness his hiding place, his pavilion around him, darkness of waters, thick clouds of the skies.
verses.zh: 他以黑暗为藏身之处，以水的黑暗、天空的厚云为他四围的行宫。

verses.en: At the brightness before him his thick clouds passed, hailstones and coals of fire.
verses.zh: 因他面前的光辉，他的厚云行过便有冰雹火炭。

verses.en: The LORD also thundered in the sky. The Most High uttered his voice: hailstones and coals of fire.
verses.zh: 耶和华也在天上打雷；至高者发出声音便有冰雹火炭。

words.g: and + to tumble, i.e. be violently agitated

verses.en: He sent out his arrows, and scattered them. He routed them with great lightning bolts.
verses.zh: 他射出箭来，使仇敌四散；多多发出闪电，使他们扰乱。

words.g: and + to dash in pieces, literally or figuratively + +them/their

verses.en: Then the channels of waters appeared. The foundations of the world were laid bare at your rebuke, LORD, at the blast of the breath of your nostrils.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，你的斥责一发，你鼻孔的气一出，海底就出现，大地的根基也显露。

verses.en: He sent from on high. He took me. He drew me out of many waters.
verses.zh: 他从高天伸手抓住我，把我从大水中拉上来。

verses.en: He delivered me from my strong enemy, from those who hated me; for they were too mighty for me.
verses.zh: 他救我脱离我的劲敌和那些恨我的人，因为他们比我强盛。

words.g: to be alert, physically  or mentally

verses.en: They came on me in the day of my calamity, but the LORD was my support.
verses.zh: 我遭遇灾难的日子，他们来攻击我；但耶和华是我的倚靠。

words.g: to + a support , i.e.  a protector or sustenance

verses.en: He brought me out also into a large place. He delivered me, because he delighted in me.
verses.zh: 他又领我到宽阔之处；他救拔我，因他喜悦我。

verses.en: The LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness. According to the cleanness of my hands, he has recompensed me.
verses.zh: 耶和华按着我的公义报答我，按着我手中的清洁赏赐我。

words.g: to treat a person , i.e. benefit or requite + +me/my

verses.en: For I have kept the ways of the LORD, and have not wickedly departed from my God.
verses.zh: 因为我遵守了耶和华的道，未曾作恶离开我的神。

verses.en: For all his ordinances were before me. I didn’t put away his statutes from me.
verses.zh: 他的一切典章常在我面前；他的律例我也未曾丢弃。

verses.en: I was also blameless with him. I kept myself from my iniquity.
verses.zh: 我在他面前作了完全人；我也保守自己远离我的罪孽。

verses.en: Therefore the LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.
verses.zh: 所以，耶和华按我的公义，按我在他眼前手中的清洁偿还我。

verses.en: With the merciful you will show yourself merciful. With the perfect man, you will show yourself perfect.
verses.zh: 慈爱的人，你以慈爱待他；完全的人，你以完全待他。

words.g: perhaps to bow , i.e. to be kind
to complete, in a good or a bad sense

verses.en: With the pure, you will show yourself pure. With the crooked you will show yourself shrewd.
verses.zh: 清洁的人，你以清洁待他；乖僻的人，你以弯曲待他。

words.g: to twine, i.e.  to struggle or  be  tortuous

verses.en: For you will save the afflicted people, but the arrogant eyes you will bring down.
verses.zh: 困苦的百姓，你必拯救；高傲的眼目，你必使他降卑。

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you
to be open, wide or free
to be high actively, to rise or raise

verses.en: For you will light my lamp, LORD. My God will light up my darkness.
verses.zh: 你必点着我的灯；耶和华―我的神必照明我的黑暗。

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: For by you, I advance through a troop. By my God, I leap over a wall.
verses.zh: 我藉着你冲入敌军，藉着我的神跳过墙垣。

verses.en: As for God, his way is perfect. The LORD’s word is tried. He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him.
verses.zh: 至于神，他的道是完全的；耶和华的话是炼净的。凡投靠他的，他便作他们的盾牌。

verses.en: For who is God, except the LORD? Who is a rock, besides our God,
verses.zh: 除了耶和华，谁是神呢？除了我们的神，谁是磐石呢？

verses.en: the God who arms me with strength, and makes my way perfect?
verses.zh: 惟有那以力量束我的腰、使我行为完全的，他是神。

words.g: probably a force, whether of men

verses.en: He makes my feet like deer’s feet, and sets me on my high places.
verses.zh: 他使我的脚快如母鹿的蹄，又使我在高处安稳。

words.g: like + a doe or female deer

verses.en: He teaches my hands to war, so that my arms bend a bow of bronze.
verses.zh: 他教导我的手能以争战，甚至我的膀臂能开铜弓。

words.g: a bow, forshooting  or the iris

verses.en: You have also given me the shield of your salvation. Your right hand sustains me. Your gentleness has made me great.
verses.zh: 你把你的救恩给我作盾牌；你的右手扶持我；你的温和使我为大。

verses.en: You have enlarged my steps under me, My feet have not slipped.
verses.zh: 你使我脚下的地步宽阔；我的脚未曾滑跌。

verses.en: I will pursue my enemies, and overtake them. I won’t turn away until they are consumed.
verses.zh: 我要追赶我的仇敌，并要追上他们；不将他们灭绝，我总不归回。

words.g: to end, whether intransitive  or transitived + +them/their

verses.en: I will strike them through, so that they will not be able to rise. They shall fall under my feet.
verses.zh: 我要打伤他们，使他们不能起来；他们必倒在我的脚下。

verses.en: For you have armed me with strength to the battle. You have subdued under me those who rose up against me.
verses.zh: 因为你曾以力量束我的腰，使我能争战；你也使那起来攻击我的都服在我以下。

words.g: probably a force, whether of men

verses.en: You have also made my enemies turn their backs to me, that I might cut off those who hate me.
verses.zh: 你又使我的仇敌在我面前转背逃跑，叫我能以剪除那恨我的人。

words.g: the nape or back of the neck

verses.en: They cried, but there was no one to save; even to the LORD, but he didn’t answer them.
verses.zh: 他们呼求，却无人拯救；就是呼求耶和华，他也不应允。

words.g: to be open, wide or free

verses.en: Then I beat them small as the dust before the wind. I cast them out as the mire of the streets.
verses.zh: 我捣碎他们，如同风前的灰尘，倒出他们，如同街上的泥土。

verses.en: You have delivered me from the strivings of the people. You have made me the head of the nations. A people whom I have not known shall serve me.
verses.zh: 你救我脱离百姓的争竞，立我作列国的元首；我素不认识的民必事奉我。

verses.en: As soon as they hear of me they shall obey me. The foreigners shall submit themselves to me.
verses.zh: 他们一听见我的名声就必顺从我；外邦人要投降我。

words.g: to + something heard, i.e. a sound
to be untrue, in word  or deed

verses.en: The foreigners shall fade away, and shall come trembling out of their strongholds.
verses.zh: 外邦人要衰残，战战兢兢地出他们的营寨。

words.g: and + to leap suddenly, i.e.  to be dismayed
from + something enclosing, i.e. a margin + +them/their

verses.en: The LORD lives! Blessed be my rock. Exalted be the God of my salvation,
verses.zh: 耶和华是活神。愿我的磐石被人称颂；愿救我的神被人尊崇。

words.g: and + to be high actively, to rise or raise

verses.en: even the God who executes vengeance for me, and subdues peoples under me.
verses.zh: 这位神，就是那为我伸冤、使众民服在我以下的。

words.g: avengement, whether the act of the passion

verses.en: He rescues me from my enemies. Yes, you lift me up above those who rise up against me. You deliver me from the violent man.
verses.zh: 你救我脱离仇敌，又把我举起，高过那些起来攻击我的；你救我脱离强暴的人。

words.g: to be high actively, to rise or raise + +me/my

verses.en: Therefore I will give thanks to you, LORD, among the nations, and will sing praises to your name.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，因此我要在外邦中称谢你，歌颂你的名。

verses.en: He gives great deliverance to his king, and shows loving kindness to his anointed, to David and to his offspring, forever more.
verses.zh: 耶和华赐极大的救恩给他所立的王，施慈爱给他的受膏者，就是给大卫和他的后裔，直到永远。

verses.en: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David.
verses.zh: （大卫的诗，交与伶长。）

words.g: to + to glitter from afar, i.e. to be eminent

verses.en: The heavens declare the glory of God. The expanse shows his handiwork.
verses.zh: 诸天述说神的荣耀；穹苍传扬他的手段。

words.g: to score with a mark as a tally or record, i.e.  to inscribe
weight, but only figuratively in a good sense

verses.en: Day after day they pour out speech, and night after night they display knowledge.
verses.zh: 这日到那日发出言语；这夜到那夜传出知识。

verses.en: There is no speech nor language where their voice is not heard.
verses.zh: 无言无语，也无声音可听。

verses.en: Their voice has gone out through all the earth, their words to the end of the world. In them he has set a tent for the sun,
verses.zh: 它的量带通遍天下，它的言语传到地极。神在其间为太阳安设帐幕；

verses.en: which is as a bridegroom coming out of his room, like a strong man rejoicing to run his course.
verses.zh: 太阳如同新郎出洞房，又如勇士欢然奔路。

verses.en: His going out is from the end of the heavens, his circuit to its ends. There is nothing hidden from its heat.
verses.zh: 它从天这边出来，绕到天那边，没有一物被隐藏不得它的热气。

words.g: a going forth, i.e.  an egress + +him/his/it

verses.en: The LORD’s law is perfect, restoring the soul. The LORD’s covenant is sure, making wise the simple.
verses.zh: 耶和华的律法全备，能苏醒人心；耶和华的法度确定，能使愚人有智慧。

verses.en: The LORD’s precepts are right, rejoicing the heart. The LORD’s commandment is pure, enlightening the eyes.
verses.zh: 耶和华的训词正直，能快活人的心；耶和华的命令清洁，能明亮人的眼目。

words.g: a command, whether human or divine

verses.en: The fear of the LORD is clean, enduring forever. The LORD’s ordinances are true, and righteous altogether.
verses.zh: 耶和华的道理洁净，存到永远；耶和华的典章真实，全然公义―

verses.en: They are more to be desired than gold, yes, than much fine gold, sweeter also than honey and the extract of the honeycomb.
verses.zh: 都比金子可羡慕，且比极多的精金可羡慕；比蜜甘甜，且比蜂房下滴的蜜甘甜。

words.g: and + a dripping i.e. of honey

verses.en: Moreover your servant is warned by them. In keeping them there is great reward.
verses.zh: 况且你的仆人因此受警戒，守着这些便有大赏。

words.g: a heel, i.e.  the last of anything

verses.en: Who can discern his errors? Forgive me from hidden errors.
verses.zh: 谁能知道自己的错失呢？愿你赦免我隐而未现的过错。

words.g: from + to hide , literally or figuratively

verses.en: Keep back your servant also from presumptuous sins. Let them not have dominion over me. Then I will be upright. I will be blameless and innocent of great transgression.
verses.zh: 求你拦阻仆人不犯任意妄为的罪，不容这罪辖制我，我便完全，免犯大罪。

words.g: to complete, in a good or a bad sense

verses.en: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in your sight, LORD, my rock, and my redeemer.
verses.zh: 耶和华―我的磐石，我的救赎主啊，愿我口中的言语、心里的意念在你面前蒙悦纳。

words.g: the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +me/my
and + a murmuring sound, i.e. a musical notation
and + to be the next of kin + +me/my

verses.en: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David.
verses.zh: （大卫的诗，交与伶长。）

words.g: to + to glitter from afar, i.e. to be eminent

verses.en: May the LORD answer you in the day of trouble. May the name of the God of Jacob set you up on high,
verses.zh: 愿耶和华在你遭难的日子应允你；愿名为雅各神的高举你。

verses.en: send you help from the sanctuary, grant you support from Zion,
verses.zh: 愿他从圣所救助你，从锡安坚固你，

words.g: and + from + Tsijon , a mountain of Jerusalem

verses.en: remember all your offerings, and accept your burned sacrifice. Selah.
verses.zh: 记念你的一切供献，悦纳你的燔祭，（细拉）

verses.en: May he grant you your heart’s desire, and fulfill all your counsel.
verses.zh: 将你心所愿的赐给你，成就你的一切筹算。

verses.en: We will triumph in your salvation. In the name of our God, we will set up our banners. May the LORD grant all your requests.
verses.zh: 我们要因你的救恩夸胜，要奉我们神的名竖立旌旗。愿耶和华成就你一切所求的！

words.g: to flaunt, i.e. raise a flag

verses.en: Now I know that the LORD saves his anointed. He will answer him from his holy heaven, with the saving strength of his right hand.
verses.zh: 现在我知道耶和华救护他的受膏者，必从他的圣天上应允他，用右手的能力救护他。

words.g: to be open, wide or free

verses.en: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses, but we trust in the name of the LORD our God.
verses.zh: 有人靠车，有人靠马，但我们要提到耶和华―我们神的名。

verses.en: They are bowed down and fallen, but we rise up, and stand upright.
verses.zh: 他们都屈身仆倒，我们却起来，立得正直。

verses.en: Save, LORD! Let the King answer us when we call!
verses.zh: 求耶和华施行拯救；我们呼求的时候，愿王应允我们！

words.g: to be open, wide or free

verses.en: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David.
verses.zh: （大卫的诗，交与伶长。）

words.g: to + to glitter from afar, i.e. to be eminent

verses.en: The king rejoices in your strength, LORD! How greatly he rejoices in your salvation!
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，王必因你的能力欢喜；因你的救恩，他的快乐何其大！

words.g: to spin round , i.e. usually rejoice

verses.en: You have given him his heart’s desire, and have not withheld the request of his lips. Selah.
verses.zh: 他心里所愿的，你已经赐给他；他嘴唇所求的，你未尝不应允。（细拉）

words.g: to debar  from benefit or injury

verses.en: For you meet him with the blessings of goodness. You set a crown of fine gold on his head.
verses.zh: 你以美福迎接他，把精金的冠冕戴在他头上。

verses.en: He asked life of you and you gave it to him, even length of days forever and ever.
verses.zh: 他向你求寿，你便赐给他，就是日子长久，直到永远。

verses.en: His glory is great in your salvation. You lay honor and majesty on him.
verses.zh: 他因你的救恩大有荣耀；你又将尊荣威严加在他身上。

words.g: weight, but only figuratively in a good sense + +him/his/it
and + magnificence, i.e. ornament or splendor

verses.en: For you make him most blessed forever. You make him glad with joy in your presence.
verses.zh: 你使他有洪福，直到永远，又使他在你面前欢喜快乐。

verses.en: For the king trusts in the LORD. Through the loving kindness of the Most High, he shall not be moved.
verses.zh: 王倚靠耶和华，因至高者的慈爱必不摇动。

verses.en: Your hand will find out all of your enemies. Your right hand will find out those who hate you.
verses.zh: 你的手要搜出你的一切仇敌；你的右手要搜出那些恨你的人。

verses.en: You will make them as a fiery furnace in the time of your anger. The LORD will swallow them up in his wrath. The fire shall devour them.
verses.zh: 你发怒的时候，要使他们如在炎热的火炉中。耶和华要在他的震怒中吞灭他们；那火要把他们烧尽了。

verses.en: You will destroy their descendants from the earth, their posterity from among the children of men.
verses.zh: 你必从世上灭绝他们的子孙（原文是果子），从人间灭绝他们的后裔。

verses.en: For they intended evil against you. They plotted evil against you which cannot succeed.
verses.zh: 因为他们有意加害于你；他们想出计谋，却不能做成。

verses.en: For you will make them turn their back, when you aim drawn bows at their face.
verses.zh: 你必使他们转背逃跑，向他们的脸搭箭在弦。

words.g: the neck  as the place of burdens

verses.en: Be exalted, LORD, in your strength, so we will sing and praise your power.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，愿你因自己的能力显为至高！这样，我们就唱诗，歌颂你的大能。

words.g: to be high actively, to rise or raise

verses.en: For the Chief Musician; set to “The Doe of the Morning.” A Psalm by David.
verses.zh: （大卫的诗，交与伶长。调用朝鹿。）

words.g: to + to glitter from afar, i.e. to be eminent

verses.en: My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? Why are you so far from helping me, and from the words of my groaning?
verses.zh: 我的神，我的神！为甚么离弃我？为甚么远离不救我？不听我唉哼的言语？

verses.en: My God, I cry in the daytime, but you don’t answer; in the night season, and am not silent.
verses.zh: 我的神啊，我白日呼求，你不应允，夜间呼求，并不住声。

verses.en: But you are holy, you who inhabit the praises of Israel.
verses.zh: 但你是圣洁的，是用以色列的赞美为宝座（或译：居所）的。

words.g: and + thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: Our fathers trusted in you. They trusted, and you delivered them.
verses.zh: 我们的祖宗倚靠你；他们倚靠你，你便解救他们。

words.g: father, in a literal and immediate + +us/our

verses.en: They cried to you, and were delivered. They trusted in you, and were not disappointed.
verses.zh: 他们哀求你，便蒙解救；他们倚靠你，就不羞愧。

words.g: and + to be smooth, i.e.  to escape
to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed

verses.en: But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised by the people.
verses.zh: 但我是虫，不是人，被众人羞辱，被百姓藐视。

verses.en: All those who see me mock me. They insult me with their lips. They shake their heads, saying,
verses.zh: 凡看见我的都嗤笑我；他们撇嘴摇头，说：

words.g: to cleave or burst through, i.e.  to emit
to waver, in a great variety of applications

verses.en: “He trusts in the LORD. Let him deliver him. Let him rescue him, since he delights in him.”
verses.zh: 他把自己交托耶和华，耶和华可以救他吧！耶和华既喜悦他，可以搭救他吧！

verses.en: But you brought me out of the womb. You made me trust while at my mother’s breasts.
verses.zh: 但你是叫我出母腹的；我在母怀里，你就使我有倚靠的心。

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you
to gush forth , generally to issue + +me/my
the breast of a woman or animal

verses.en: I was thrown on you from my mother’s womb. You are my God since my mother bore me.
verses.zh: 我自出母胎就被交在你手里；从我母亲生我，你就是我的神。

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: Don’t be far from me, for trouble is near. For there is no one to help.
verses.zh: 求你不要远离我！因为急难临近了，没有人帮助我。

words.g: to widen , i.e.  recede or  remove
to surround, i.e. protect or aid

verses.en: Many bulls have surrounded me. Strong bulls of Bashan have encircled me.
verses.zh: 有许多公牛围绕我，巴珊大力的公牛四面困住我。

words.g: Bashan , a region East of the Jordan

verses.en: They open their mouths wide against me, lions tearing prey and roaring.
verses.zh: 它们向我张口，好像抓撕吼叫的狮子。

words.g: the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +them/their

verses.en: I am poured out like water. All my bones are out of joint. My heart is like wax. It is melted within me.
verses.zh: 我如水被倒出来；我的骨头都脱了节；我心在我里面如蜡熔化。

words.g: and + to break through, i.e. spread or separate

verses.en: My strength is dried up like a potsherd. My tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You have brought me into the dust of death.
verses.zh: 我的精力枯干，如同瓦片；我的舌头贴在我牙床上。你将我安置在死地的尘土中。

words.g: to impinge, i.e. cling or adhere
to locate, i.e.  hang on or  establish + +me/my

verses.en: For dogs have surrounded me. A company of evildoers have enclosed me. They have pierced my hands and feet.
verses.zh: 犬类围着我，恶党环绕我；他们扎了我的手，我的脚。

words.g: to strike with more or less violence + +me/my

verses.en: I can count all of my bones. They look and stare at me.
verses.zh: 我的骨头，我都能数过；他们瞪着眼看我。

words.g: to score with a mark as a tally or record, i.e.  to inscribe

verses.en: They divide my garments among them. They cast lots for my clothing.
verses.zh: 他们分我的外衣，为我的里衣拈阄。

verses.en: But don’t be far off, LORD. You are my help. Hurry to help me!
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，求你不要远离我！我的救主啊，求你快来帮助我！

words.g: and + thou and thee, or  ye and you
to widen , i.e.  recede or  remove

verses.en: Deliver my soul from the sword, my precious life from the power of the dog.
verses.zh: 求你救我的灵魂脱离刀剑，救我的生命（生命：原文是独一者）脱离犬类，

verses.en: Save me from the lion’s mouth! Yes, you have rescued me from the horns of the wild oxen.
verses.zh: 救我脱离狮子的口；你已经应允我，使我脱离野牛的角。

words.g: to be open, wide or free + +me/my
from + the mouth , whether literal or figurative

verses.en: I will declare your name to my brothers. Among the assembly, I will praise you.
verses.zh: 我要将你的名传与我的弟兄，在会中我要赞美你。

words.g: to score with a mark as a tally or record, i.e.  to inscribe

verses.en: You who fear the LORD, praise him! All you descendants of Jacob, glorify him! Stand in awe of him, all you descendants of Israel!
verses.zh: 你们敬畏耶和华的人要赞美他！雅各的后裔都要荣耀他！以色列的后裔都要惧怕他！

words.g: and + to turn aside from the road , i.e. sojourn

verses.en: For he has not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted, neither has he hidden his face from him; but when he cried to him, he heard.
verses.zh: 因为他没有藐视憎恶受苦的人，也没有向他掩面；那受苦之人呼吁的时候，他就垂听。

words.g: to be filthy, i.e.  to loathe
and + in + to cry for help + +him/his/it

verses.en: My praise of you comes in the great assembly. I will pay my vows before those who fear him.
verses.zh: 我在大会中赞美你的话是从你而来的；我要在敬畏耶和华的人面前还我的愿。

verses.en: The humble shall eat and be satisfied. They shall praise the LORD who seek after him. Let your hearts live forever.
verses.zh: 谦卑的人必吃得饱足；寻求耶和华的人必赞美他。愿你们的心永远活着！

words.g: to live, whether literally or figuratively

verses.en: All the ends of the earth shall remember and turn to the LORD. All the relatives of the nations shall worship before you.
verses.zh: 地的四极都要想念耶和华，并且归顺他；列国的万族都要在你面前敬拜。

words.g: a family, i.e. circle of relatives

verses.en: For the kingdom is the LORD’s. He is the ruler over the nations.
verses.zh: 因为国权是耶和华的；他是管理万国的。

words.g: the + something ruled, i.e. a realm

verses.en: All the rich ones of the earth shall eat and worship. All those who go down to the dust shall bow before him, even he who can’t keep his soul alive.
verses.zh: 地上一切丰肥的人必吃喝而敬拜；凡下到尘土中―不能存活自己性命的人―都要在他面前下拜。

words.g: to live, whether literally or figuratively

verses.en: Posterity shall serve him. Future generations shall be told about the Lord.
verses.zh: 他必有后裔事奉他；主所行的事必传与后代。

words.g: to score with a mark as a tally or record, i.e.  to inscribe

verses.en: They shall come and shall declare his righteousness to a people that shall be born, for he has done it.
verses.zh: 他们必来把他的公义传给将要生的民，言明这事是他所行的。

verses.en: A Psalm by David. The LORD is my shepherd; I shall lack nothing.
verses.zh: （大卫的诗。）耶和华是我的牧者，我必不致缺乏。

words.n: ro'i — 'my shepherd'. ro'eh ('shepherd') + -i ('my'): two English words, one Hebrew one.

verses.en: He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters.
verses.zh: 他使我躺卧在青草地上，领我在可安歇的水边。

verses.en: He restores my soul. He guides me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.
verses.zh: 他使我的灵魂苏醒，为自己的名引导我走义路。

verses.en: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.
verses.zh: 我虽然行过死荫的幽谷，也不怕遭害，因为你与我同在；你的杖，你的竿，都安慰我。

words.n: tsalmavet — literally 'shadow of death', tsel (shadow) + mavet (death). Modern translations often prefer 'deepest darkness'.

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you
and + support , i.e.  sustenance or  a walking-stick + +you/your

verses.en: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil. My cup runs over.
verses.zh: 在我敌人面前，你为我摆设筵席；你用油膏了我的头，使我的福杯满溢。

words.g: to set in a row, i.e. arrange

verses.en: Surely goodness and loving kindness shall follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the LORD’s house forever.
verses.zh: 我一生一世必有恩惠慈爱随着我；我且要住在耶和华的殿中，直到永远。

verses.en: A Psalm by David. The earth is the LORD’s, with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell in it.
verses.zh: （大卫的诗。）地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属耶和华。

verses.en: For he has founded it on the seas, and established it on the floods.
verses.zh: 他把地建立在海上，安定在大水之上。

verses.en: Who may ascend to the LORD’s hill? Who may stand in his holy place?
verses.zh: 谁能登耶和华的山？谁能站在他的圣所？

verses.en: He who has clean hands and a pure heart; who has not lifted up his soul to falsehood, and has not sworn deceitfully.
verses.zh: 就是手洁心清、不向虚妄、起誓不怀诡诈的人。

verses.en: He shall receive a blessing from the LORD, righteousness from the God of his salvation.
verses.zh: 他必蒙耶和华赐福，又蒙救他的神使他成义。

verses.en: This is the generation of those who seek Him, who seek your face—even Jacob. Selah.
verses.zh: 这是寻求耶和华的族类，是寻求你面的雅各。（细拉）

verses.en: Lift up your heads, you gates! Be lifted up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.
verses.zh: 众城门哪，你们要抬起头来！永久的门户，你们要被举起！那荣耀的王将要进来！

words.g: an opening , i.e. door  or entrance way
the + weight, but only figuratively in a good sense

verses.en: Who is the King of glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.
verses.zh: 荣耀的王是谁呢？就是有力有能的耶和华，在战场上有能的耶和华！

words.g: the + weight, but only figuratively in a good sense

verses.en: Lift up your heads, you gates; yes, lift them up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.
verses.zh: 众城门哪，你们要抬起头来！永久的门户，你们要把头抬起！那荣耀的王将要进来！

words.g: an opening , i.e. door  or entrance way
the + weight, but only figuratively in a good sense

verses.en: Who is this King of glory? The LORD of Armies is the King of glory! Selah.
verses.zh: 荣耀的王是谁呢？万军之耶和华，他是荣耀的王！（细拉）

words.g: the + weight, but only figuratively in a good sense
a mass of persons , especially reg. organized forwar
the + weight, but only figuratively in a good sense

verses.en: By David. To you, LORD, I lift up my soul.
verses.zh: （大卫的诗。）耶和华啊，我的心仰望你。

verses.en: My God, I have trusted in you. Don’t let me be shamed. Don’t let my enemies triumph over me.
verses.zh: 我的神啊，我素来倚靠你；求你不要叫我羞愧，不要叫我的仇敌向我夸胜。

words.g: to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed
to jump for joy, i.e. exult

verses.en: Yes, no one who waits for you will be shamed. They will be shamed who deal treacherously without cause.
verses.zh: 凡等候你的必不羞愧；惟有那无故行奸诈的必要羞愧。

words.g: to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed
to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed

verses.en: Show me your ways, LORD. Teach me your paths.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，求你将你的道指示我，将你的路教训我！

verses.en: Guide me in your truth, and teach me, for you are the God of my salvation. I wait for you all day long.
verses.zh: 求你以你的真理引导我，教训我，因为你是救我的神。我终日等候你。

words.g: and + to goad, i.e.  to teach + +me/my
thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: LORD, remember your tender mercies and your loving kindness, for they are from old times.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，求你记念你的怜悯和慈爱，因为这是亘古以来所常有的。

verses.en: Don’t remember the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions. Remember me according to your loving kindness, for your goodness’ sake, LORD.
verses.zh: 求你不要记念我幼年的罪愆和我的过犯；耶和华啊，求你因你的恩惠，按你的慈爱记念我。

words.g: youth, the state  or the persons + +me/my
thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: Good and upright is the LORD, therefore he will instruct sinners in the way.
verses.zh: 耶和华是良善正直的，所以他必指示罪人走正路。

verses.en: He will guide the humble in justice. He will teach the humble his way.
verses.zh: 他必按公平引领谦卑人，将他的道教训他们。

words.g: and + to goad, i.e.  to teach

verses.en: All the paths of the LORD are loving kindness and truth to such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.
verses.zh: 凡遵守他的约和他法度的人，耶和华都以慈爱诚实待他。

words.g: to + to guard, in a good sense  or a bad one

verses.en: For your name’s sake, LORD, pardon my iniquity, for it is great.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，求你因你的名赦免我的罪，因为我的罪重大。

verses.en: What man is he who fears the LORD? He shall instruct him in the way that he shall choose.
verses.zh: 谁敬畏耶和华，耶和华必指示他当选择的道路。

verses.en: His soul will dwell at ease. His offspring will inherit the land.
verses.zh: 他必安然居住；他的后裔必承受地土。

verses.en: The friendship of the LORD is with those who fear him. He will show them his covenant.
verses.zh: 耶和华与敬畏他的人亲密；他必将自己的约指示他们。

verses.en: My eyes are ever on the LORD, for he will pluck my feet out of the net.
verses.zh: 我的眼目时常仰望耶和华，因为他必将我的脚从网里拉出来。

verses.en: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, for I am desolate and afflicted.
verses.zh: 求你转向我，怜恤我，因为我是孤独困苦。

words.g: and + depressed, in mind or circumstances

verses.en: The troubles of my heart are enlarged. Oh bring me out of my distresses.
verses.zh: 我心里的愁苦甚多，求你救我脱离我的祸患。

verses.en: Consider my affliction and my travail. Forgive all my sins.
verses.zh: 求你看顾我的困苦，我的艰难，赦免我一切的罪。

verses.en: Consider my enemies, for they are many. They hate me with cruel hatred.
verses.zh: 求你察看我的仇敌，因为他们人多，并且痛痛地恨我。

verses.en: Oh keep my soul, and deliver me. Let me not be disappointed, for I take refuge in you.
verses.zh: 求你保护我的性命，搭救我，使我不致羞愧，因为我投靠你。

words.g: to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed

verses.en: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me, for I wait for you.
verses.zh: 愿纯全、正直保守我，因为我等候你。

words.g: to guard, in a good sense  or a bad one + +me/my

verses.en: God, redeem Israel out of all his troubles.
verses.zh: 神啊，求你救赎以色列脱离他一切的愁苦。

verses.en: By David. Judge me, LORD, for I have walked in my integrity. I have trusted also in the LORD without wavering.
verses.zh: （大卫的诗。）耶和华啊，求你为我伸冤，因我向来行事纯全；我又倚靠耶和华，并不摇动。

verses.en: Examine me, LORD, and prove me. Try my heart and my mind.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，求你察看我，试验我，熬炼我的肺腑心肠。

verses.en: For your loving kindness is before my eyes. I have walked in your truth.
verses.zh: 因为你的慈爱常在我眼前，我也按你的真理而行。

verses.en: I have not sat with deceitful men, neither will I go in with hypocrites.
verses.zh: 我没有和虚谎人同坐，也不与瞒哄人的同群。

words.g: to veil from sight, i.e. conceal

verses.en: I hate the assembly of evildoers, and will not sit with the wicked.
verses.zh: 我恨恶恶人的会，必不与恶人同坐。

verses.en: I will wash my hands in innocence, so I will go about your altar, LORD,
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，我要洗手表明无辜，才环绕你的祭坛；

verses.en: that I may make the voice of thanksgiving to be heard and tell of all your wondrous deeds.
verses.zh: 我好发称谢的声音，也要述说你一切奇妙的作为。

words.g: and + to + to score with a mark as a tally or record, i.e.  to inscribe

verses.en: LORD, I love the habitation of your house, the place where your glory dwells.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，我喜爱你所住的殿和你显荣耀的居所。

words.g: weight, but only figuratively in a good sense + +you/your

verses.en: Don’t gather my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloodthirsty men
verses.zh: 不要把我的灵魂和罪人一同除掉；不要把我的性命和流人血的一同除掉。

verses.en: in whose hands is wickedness; their right hand is full of bribes.
verses.zh: 他们的手中有奸恶，右手满有贿赂。

words.g: a plan, especially a bad one

verses.en: But as for me, I will walk in my integrity. Redeem me, and be merciful to me.
verses.zh: 至于我，却要行事纯全；求你救赎我，怜恤我！

verses.en: My foot stands in an even place. In the congregations I will bless the LORD.
verses.zh: 我的脚站在平坦地方；在众会中我要称颂耶和华！

words.g: in + a level, i.e. a plain  as a proper name of certain districts)

verses.en: By David. The LORD is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? The LORD is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?
verses.zh: （大卫的诗。）耶和华是我的亮光，是我的拯救，我还怕谁呢？耶和华是我性命的保障（或译：力量），我还惧谁呢？

verses.en: When evildoers came at me to eat up my flesh, even my adversaries and my foes, they stumbled and fell.
verses.zh: 那作恶的就是我的仇敌，前来吃我肉的时候就绊跌仆倒。

verses.en: Though an army should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear. Though war should rise against me, even then I will be confident.
verses.zh: 虽有军兵安营攻击我，我的心也不害怕；虽然兴起刀兵攻击我，我必仍旧安稳。

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!
used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: One thing I have asked of the LORD, that I will seek after: that I may dwell in the LORD’s house all the days of my life, to see the LORD’s beauty, and to inquire in his temple.
verses.zh: 有一件事，我曾求耶和华，我仍要寻求：就是一生一世住在耶和华的殿中，瞻仰他的荣美，在他的殿里求问。

words.g: and + to + to plough, or  break forth

verses.en: For in the day of trouble, he will keep me secretly in his pavilion. In the secret place of his tabernacle, he will hide me. He will lift me up on a rock.
verses.zh: 因为我遭遇患难，他必暗暗地保守我；在他亭子里，把我藏在他帐幕的隐密处，将我高举在磐石上。

words.g: to be high actively, to rise or raise + +me/my

verses.en: Now my head will be lifted up above my enemies around me. I will offer sacrifices of joy in his tent. I will sing, yes, I will sing praises to the LORD.
verses.zh: 现在我得以昂首，高过四面的仇敌。我要在他的帐幕里欢然献祭；我要唱诗歌颂耶和华。

words.g: to be high actively, to rise or raise
clamor, i.e. acclamation of joy or a battle-cry

verses.en: Hear, LORD, when I cry with my voice. Have mercy also on me, and answer me.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，我用声音呼吁的时候，求你垂听；并求你怜恤我，应允我。

verses.en: When you said, “Seek my face,” my heart said to you, “I will seek your face, LORD.”
verses.zh: 你说：你们当寻求我的面。那时我心向你说：耶和华啊，你的面我正要寻求。

verses.en: Don’t hide your face from me. Don’t put your servant away in anger. You have been my help. Don’t abandon me, neither forsake me, God of my salvation.
verses.zh: 不要向我掩面。不要发怒赶逐仆人，你向来是帮助我的。救我的神啊，不要丢掉我，也不要离弃我。

verses.en: When my father and my mother forsake me, then the LORD will take me up.
verses.zh: 我父母离弃我，耶和华必收留我。

words.g: father, in a literal and immediate + +me/my

verses.en: Teach me your way, LORD. Lead me in a straight path, because of my enemies.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，求你将你的道指教我，因我仇敌的缘故引导我走平坦的路。

words.g: a level, i.e. a plain  as a proper name of certain districts)

verses.en: Don’t deliver me over to the desire of my adversaries, for false witnesses have risen up against me, such as breathe out cruelty.
verses.zh: 求你不要把我交给敌人，遂其所愿；因为妄作见证的和口吐凶言的，起来攻击我。

verses.en: I am still confident of this: I will see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.
verses.zh: 我若不信在活人之地得见耶和华的恩惠，就早已丧胆了。

words.g: in + good , in the widest sense

verses.en: Wait for the LORD. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for the LORD.
verses.zh: 要等候耶和华！当壮胆，坚固你的心！我再说，要等候耶和华！

words.g: and + to be alert, physically  or mentally
and + to bind together , i.e. collect

verses.en: By David. To you, LORD, I call. My rock, don’t be deaf to me, lest, if you are silent to me, I would become like those who go down into the pit.
verses.zh: （大卫的诗。）耶和华啊，我要求告你！我的磐石啊，不要向我缄默！倘若你向我闭口，我就如将死的人一样。

words.g: and + to liken, i.e.  to use figurative language

verses.en: Hear the voice of my petitions, when I cry to you, when I lift up my hands toward your Most Holy Place.
verses.zh: 我呼求你，向你至圣所举手的时候，求你垂听我恳求的声音！

words.g: the shrine or innermost part of the sanctuary

verses.en: Don’t draw me away with the wicked, with the workers of iniquity who speak peace with their neighbors, but mischief is in their hearts.
verses.zh: 不要把我和恶人并作孽的一同除掉；他们与邻舍说和平话，心里却是奸恶。

words.g: to draw, used in a great variety of applications + +me/my
to do or make , especially to practise

verses.en: Give them according to their work, and according to the wickedness of their doings. Give them according to the operation of their hands. Bring back on them what they deserve.
verses.zh: 愿你按着他们所做的，并他们所行的恶事待他们。愿你照着他们手所做的待他们，将他们所应得的报应加给他们。

words.g: and + like + badness , physically or morally

verses.en: Because they don’t respect the works of the LORD, nor the operation of his hands, he will break them down and not build them up.
verses.zh: 他们既然不留心耶和华所行的和他手所做的，他就必毁坏他们，不建立他们。

words.g: to pull down or in pieces, break + +them/their

verses.en: Blessed be the LORD, because he has heard the voice of my petitions.
verses.zh: 耶和华是应当称颂的，因为他听了我恳求的声音。

verses.en: The LORD is my strength and my shield. My heart has trusted in him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart greatly rejoices. With my song I will thank him.
verses.zh: 耶和华是我的力量，是我的盾牌；我心里倚靠他就得帮助。所以我心中欢乐，我必用诗歌颂赞他。

words.g: and + to surround, i.e. protect or aid
and + to jump for joy, i.e. exult

verses.en: The LORD is their strength. He is a stronghold of salvation to his anointed.
verses.zh: 耶和华是他百姓的力量，又是他受膏者得救的保障。

verses.en: Save your people, and bless your inheritance. Be their shepherd also, and bear them up forever.
verses.zh: 求你拯救你的百姓，赐福给你的产业，牧养他们，扶持他们，直到永远。

words.g: to be open, wide or free

verses.en: A Psalm by David. Ascribe to the LORD, you sons of the mighty, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.
verses.zh: （大卫的诗。）神的众子啊，你们要将荣耀、能力归给耶和华，归给耶和华！

words.g: weight, but only figuratively in a good sense

verses.en: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due to his name. Worship the LORD in holy array.
verses.zh: 要将耶和华的名所当得的荣耀归给他，以圣洁的（的：或译为）妆饰敬拜耶和华。

words.g: weight, but only figuratively in a good sense

verses.en: The LORD’s voice is on the waters. The God of glory thunders, even the LORD on many waters.
verses.zh: 耶和华的声音发在水上；荣耀的神打雷，耶和华打雷在大水之上。

words.g: the + weight, but only figuratively in a good sense
to tumble, i.e. be violently agitated

verses.en: The LORD’s voice is powerful. The LORD’s voice is full of majesty.
verses.zh: 耶和华的声音大有能力；耶和华的声音满有威严。

words.g: in + magnificence, i.e. ornament or splendor

verses.en: The LORD’s voice breaks the cedars. Yes, the LORD breaks in pieces the cedars of Lebanon.
verses.zh: 耶和华的声音震破香柏树；耶和华震碎黎巴嫩的香柏树。

words.g: the + Lebanon, a mountain range in Palestine

verses.en: He makes them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young, wild ox.
verses.zh: 他也使之跳跃如牛犊，使黎巴嫩和西连跳跃如野牛犊。

words.g: and + to stamp, i.e. to spring about + +them/their
a form of the prefix 'k-', but used separately  as
a  calf , especially one nearly grown
Lebanon, a mountain range in Palestine
and + Shirjon or Sirjon, a peak of the Lebanon
a form of the prefix 'k-', but used separately  as

verses.en: The LORD’s voice strikes with flashes of lightning.
verses.zh: 耶和华的声音使火焰分岔。

verses.en: The LORD’s voice shakes the wilderness. The LORD shakes the wilderness of Kadesh.
verses.zh: 耶和华的声音震动旷野；耶和华震动加低斯的旷野。

words.g: to twist or whirl , i.e.  to dance
to twist or whirl , i.e.  to dance
Kadesh, a place in the Desert

verses.en: The LORD’s voice makes the deer calve, and strips the forests bare. In his temple everything says, “Glory!”
verses.zh: 耶和华的声音惊动母鹿落胎，树木也脱落净光。凡在他殿中的，都称说他的荣耀。

words.g: to twist or whirl , i.e.  to dance
and + to strip off, i.e. generally to make naked
weight, but only figuratively in a good sense

verses.en: The LORD sat enthroned at the Flood. Yes, the LORD sits as King forever.
verses.zh: 洪水泛滥之时，耶和华坐着为王；耶和华坐着为王，直到永远。

verses.en: The LORD will give strength to his people. The LORD will bless his people with peace.
verses.zh: 耶和华必赐力量给他的百姓；耶和华必赐平安的福给他的百姓。

verses.en: A Psalm. A Song for the Dedication of the Temple. By David.
verses.zh: （大卫在献殿的时候，作这诗歌。）

verses.en: I will extol you, LORD, for you have raised me up, and have not made my foes to rejoice over me.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，我要尊崇你，因为你曾提拔我，不叫仇敌向我夸耀。

words.g: to be high actively, to rise or raise + +you/your
to dangle, i.e. to let down abucket + +me/my

verses.en: LORD my God, I cried to you, and you have healed me.
verses.zh: 耶和华―我的神啊，我曾呼求你，你医治了我。

words.g: and + to mend , i.e.  to cure + +me/my

verses.en: LORD, you have brought up my soul from Sheol. You have kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，你曾把我的灵魂从阴间救上来，使我存活，不至于下坑。

words.g: to live, whether literally or figuratively + +me/my

verses.en: Sing praise to the LORD, you saints of his. Give thanks to his holy name.
verses.zh: 耶和华的圣民哪，你们要歌颂他，称赞他可记念的圣名。

verses.en: For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.
verses.zh: 因为，他的怒气不过是转眼之间；他的恩典乃是一生之久。一宿虽然有哭泣，早晨便必欢呼。

words.g: a wink , i.e. a very short space of time

verses.en: As for me, I said in my prosperity, “I shall never be moved.”
verses.zh: 至于我，我凡事平顺便说：我永不动摇。

verses.en: You, LORD, when you favored me, made my mountain stand strong; but when you hid your face, I was troubled.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，你曾施恩，叫我的江山稳固；你掩了面，我就惊惶。

words.g: to tremble inwardly , i.e.  be   alarmed or agitated

verses.en: I cried to you, LORD. I made supplication to the Lord:
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，我曾求告你；我向耶和华恳求，说：

verses.en: “What profit is there in my destruction, if I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise you? Shall it declare your truth?
verses.zh: 我被害流血，下到坑中，有甚么益处呢？尘土岂能称赞你，传说你的诚实么？

verses.en: Hear, LORD, and have mercy on me. LORD, be my helper.”
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，求你应允我，怜恤我！耶和华啊，求你帮助我！

words.g: to surround, i.e. protect or aid

verses.en: You have turned my mourning into dancing for me. You have removed my sackcloth, and clothed me with gladness,
verses.zh: 你已将我的哀哭变为跳舞，将我的麻衣脱去，给我披上喜乐，

verses.en: to the end that my heart may sing praise to you, and not be silent. LORD my God, I will give thanks to you forever!
verses.zh: 好叫我的灵（原文是荣耀）歌颂你，并不住声。耶和华―我的神啊，我要称谢你，直到永远！

words.g: weight, but only figuratively in a good sense

verses.en: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David.
verses.zh: （大卫的诗，交与伶长。）

words.g: to + to glitter from afar, i.e. to be eminent

verses.en: In you, LORD, I take refuge. Let me never be disappointed. Deliver me in your righteousness.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，我投靠你；求你使我永不羞愧；凭你的公义搭救我！

words.g: to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed

verses.en: Bow down your ear to me. Deliver me speedily. Be to me a strong rock, a house of defense to save me.
verses.zh: 求你侧耳而听，快快救我！作我坚固的磐石，拯救我的保障！

words.g: to + to be open, wide or free + +me/my

verses.en: For you are my rock and my fortress, therefore for your name’s sake lead me and guide me.
verses.zh: 因为你是我的岩石，我的山寨；所以，求你为你名的缘故引导我，指点我。

words.g: a craggy rock, literally or figuratively + +me/my
thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: Pluck me out of the net that they have laid secretly for me, for you are my stronghold.
verses.zh: 求你救我脱离人为我暗设的网罗，因为你是我的保障。

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: Into your hand I commend my spirit. You redeem me, LORD, God of truth.
verses.zh: 我将我的灵魂交在你手里；耶和华诚实的神啊，你救赎了我。

verses.en: I hate those who regard lying vanities, but I trust in the LORD.
verses.zh: 我恨恶那信奉虚无之神的人；我却倚靠耶和华。

verses.en: I will be glad and rejoice in your loving kindness, for you have seen my affliction. You have known my soul in adversities.
verses.zh: 我要为你的慈爱高兴欢喜；因为你见过我的困苦，知道我心中的艰难。

words.g: to spin round , i.e. usually rejoice

verses.en: You have not shut me up into the hand of the enemy. You have set my feet in a large place.
verses.zh: 你未曾把我交在仇敌手里；你使我的脚站在宽阔之处。

verses.en: Have mercy on me, LORD, for I am in distress. My eye, my soul, and my body waste away with grief.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，求你怜恤我，因为我在急难之中；我的眼睛因忧愁而干瘪，连我的身心也不安舒。

verses.en: For my life is spent with sorrow, my years with sighing. My strength fails because of my iniquity. My bones are wasted away.
verses.zh: 我的生命为愁苦所消耗；我的年岁为叹息所旷废。我的力量因我的罪孽衰败；我的骨头也枯干。

words.g: to end, whether intransitive  or transitived

verses.en: Because of all my adversaries I have become utterly contemptible to my neighbors, a horror to my acquaintances. Those who saw me on the street fled from me.
verses.zh: 我因一切敌人成了羞辱，在我的邻舍跟前更甚；那认识我的都惧怕我，在外头看见我的都躲避我。

words.g: in + separate by awall, i.e. outside

verses.en: I am forgotten from their hearts like a dead man. I am like broken pottery.
verses.zh: 我被人忘记，如同死人，无人记念；我好像破碎的器皿。

words.g: to mislay, i.e. to be oblivious of

verses.en: For I have heard the slander of many, terror on every side, while they conspire together against me, they plot to take away my life.
verses.zh: 我听见了许多人的谗谤，四围都是惊吓；他们一同商议攻击我的时候，就图谋要害我的性命。

words.g: to plan, usually in a bad sense

verses.en: But I trust in you, LORD. I said, “You are my God.”
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，我仍旧倚靠你；我说：你是我的神。

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: My times are in your hand. Deliver me from the hand of my enemies, and from those who persecute me.
verses.zh: 我终身的事在你手中；求你救我脱离仇敌的手和那些逼迫我的人。

verses.en: Make your face to shine on your servant. Save me in your loving kindness.
verses.zh: 求你使你的脸光照仆人，凭你的慈爱拯救我。

words.g: to be open, wide or free + +me/my

verses.en: Let me not be disappointed, LORD, for I have called on you. Let the wicked be disappointed. Let them be silent in Sheol.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，求你叫我不致羞愧，因为我曾呼吁你；求你使恶人羞愧，使他们在阴间缄默无声。

words.g: to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed
to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed

verses.en: Let the lying lips be mute, which speak against the righteous insolently, with pride and contempt.
verses.zh: 那撒谎的人逞骄傲轻慢，出狂妄的话攻击义人；愿他的嘴哑而无言。

verses.en: Oh how great is your goodness, which you have laid up for those who fear you, which you have worked for those who take refuge in you, before the sons of men!
verses.zh: 敬畏你、投靠你的人，你为他们所积存的，在世人面前所施行的恩惠是何等大呢！

words.g: to do or make , especially to practise

verses.en: In the shelter of your presence you will hide them from the plotting of man. You will keep them secretly in a dwelling away from the strife of tongues.
verses.zh: 你必把他们藏在你面前的隐密处，免得遇见人的计谋；你必暗暗地保守他们在亭子里，免受口舌的争闹。

verses.en: Praise be to the LORD, for he has shown me his marvelous loving kindness in a strong city.
verses.zh: 耶和华是应当称颂的，因为他在坚固城里向我施展奇妙的慈爱。

words.g: something hemming in, i.e.  a mound

verses.en: As for me, I said in my haste, “I am cut off from before your eyes.” Nevertheless you heard the voice of my petitions when I cried to you.
verses.zh: 至于我，我曾急促地说：我从你眼前被隔绝。然而，我呼求你的时候，你仍听我恳求的声音。

words.g: in + to start up suddenly, i.e.  to hasten away + +me/my

verses.en: Oh love the LORD, all you his saints! The LORD preserves the faithful, and fully recompenses him who behaves arrogantly.
verses.zh: 耶和华的圣民哪，你们都要爱他！耶和华保护诚实人，足足报应行事骄傲的人。

words.g: to guard, in a good sense  or a bad one

verses.en: Be strong, and let your heart take courage, all you who hope in the LORD.
verses.zh: 凡仰望耶和华的人，你们都要壮胆，坚固你们的心！

words.g: and + to be alert, physically  or mentally

verses.en: By David. A contemplative psalm. Blessed is he whose disobedience is forgiven, whose sin is covered.
verses.zh: （大卫的训诲诗。）得赦免其过、遮盖其罪的，这人是有福的！

words.g: an offence, or a sacrifice forit

verses.en: Blessed is the man to whom the LORD doesn’t impute iniquity, in whose spirit there is no deceit.
verses.zh: 凡心里没有诡诈、耶和华不算为有罪的，这人是有福的！

verses.en: When I kept silence, my bones wasted away through my groaning all day long.
verses.zh: 我闭口不认罪的时候，因终日唉哼而骨头枯干。

verses.en: For day and night your hand was heavy on me. My strength was sapped in the heat of summer. Selah.
verses.zh: 黑夜白日，你的手在我身上沉重；我的精液耗尽，如同夏天的干旱。（细拉）

words.g: harvest , whether the product  or the  season

verses.en: I acknowledged my sin to you. I didn’t hide my iniquity. I said, I will confess my transgressions to the LORD, and you forgave the iniquity of my sin. Selah.
verses.zh: 我向你陈明我的罪，不隐瞒我的恶。我说：我要向耶和华承认我的过犯，你就赦免我的罪恶。（细拉）

words.g: and + thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: For this, let everyone who is godly pray to you in a time when you may be found. Surely when the great waters overflow, they shall not reach to him.
verses.zh: 为此，凡虔诚人都当趁你可寻找的时候祷告你；大水泛溢的时候，必不能到他那里。

verses.en: You are my hiding place. You will preserve me from trouble. You will surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah.
verses.zh: 你是我藏身之处；你必保佑我脱离苦难，以得救的乐歌四面环绕我。（细拉）

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you
to guard, in a good sense  or a bad one + +me/my

verses.en: I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go. I will counsel you with my eye on you.
verses.zh: 我要教导你，指示你当行的路；我要定睛在你身上劝戒你。

words.g: to be  circumspect and hence, intelligent + +you/your

verses.en: Don’t be like the horse, or like the mule, which have no understanding, who are controlled by bit and bridle, or else they will not come near to you.
verses.zh: 你不可像那无知的骡马，必用嚼环辔头勒住它；不然，就不能驯服。

verses.en: Many sorrows come to the wicked, but loving kindness shall surround him who trusts in the LORD.
verses.zh: 恶人必多受苦楚；惟独倚靠耶和华的必有慈爱四面环绕他。

verses.en: Be glad in the LORD, and rejoice, you righteous! Shout for joy, all you who are upright in heart!
verses.zh: 你们义人应当靠耶和华欢喜快乐；你们心里正直的人都当欢呼。

words.g: and + to spin round , i.e. usually rejoice
and + to creak , i.e. to shout

verses.en: Rejoice in the LORD, you righteous! Praise is fitting for the upright.
verses.zh: 义人哪，你们应当靠耶和华欢乐；正直人的赞美是合宜的。

verses.en: Give thanks to the LORD with the lyre. Sing praises to him with the harp of ten strings.
verses.zh: 你们应当弹琴称谢耶和华，用十弦瑟歌颂他。

verses.en: Sing to him a new song. Play skillfully with a shout of joy!
verses.zh: 应当向他唱新歌，弹得巧妙，声音洪亮。

words.g: to thrum, i.e. beat atune with the fingers
in + clamor, i.e. acclamation of joy or a battle-cry

verses.en: For the LORD’s word is right. All his work is done in faithfulness.
verses.zh: 因为耶和华的言语正直；凡他所做的尽都诚实。

verses.en: He loves righteousness and justice. The earth is full of the loving kindness of the LORD.
verses.zh: 他喜爱仁义公平；遍地满了耶和华的慈爱。

verses.en: By the LORD’s word, the heavens were made: all their army by the breath of his mouth.
verses.zh: 诸天藉耶和华的命而造；万象藉他口中的气而成。

words.g: the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +him/his/it
a mass of persons , especially reg. organized forwar + +them/their

verses.en: He gathers the waters of the sea together as a heap. He lays up the deeps in storehouses.
verses.zh: 他聚集海水如垒，收藏深洋在库房。

verses.en: Let all the earth fear the LORD. Let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.
verses.zh: 愿全地都敬畏耶和华！愿世上的居民都惧怕他！

words.g: to turn aside from the road , i.e. sojourn

verses.en: For he spoke, and it was done. He commanded, and it stood firm.
verses.zh: 因为他说有，就有，命立，就立。

verses.en: The LORD brings the counsel of the nations to nothing. He makes the thoughts of the peoples to be of no effect.
verses.zh: 耶和华使列国的筹算归于无有，使众民的思念无有功效。

verses.en: The counsel of the LORD stands fast forever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.
verses.zh: 耶和华的筹算永远立定；他心中的思念万代常存。

verses.en: Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD, the people whom he has chosen for his own inheritance.
verses.zh: 以耶和华为神的，那国是有福的！他所拣选为自己产业的，那民是有福的！

verses.en: The LORD looks from heaven. He sees all the sons of men.
verses.zh: 耶和华从天上观看；他看见一切的世人。

verses.en: From the place of his habitation he looks out on all the inhabitants of the earth,
verses.zh: 从他的居所往外察看地上一切的居民。

words.g: from + a fixture, i.e. a basis
to peep, i.e. glance sharply at

verses.en: he who fashions all of their hearts; and he considers all of their works.
verses.zh: 他是那造成他们众人心的，留意他们一切作为的。

words.g: the + to mould into a form
the + to separate mentally , i.e. understand

verses.en: There is no king saved by the multitude of an army. A mighty man is not delivered by great strength.
verses.zh: 君王不能因兵多得胜；勇士不能因力大得救。

words.g: to be open, wide or free
probably a force, whether of men

verses.en: A horse is a vain thing for safety, neither does he deliver any by his great power.
verses.zh: 靠马得救是枉然的；马也不能因力大救人。

words.g: probably a force, whether of men + +him/his/it
to be smooth, i.e.  to escape

verses.en: Behold, the LORD’s eye is on those who fear him, on those who hope in his loving kindness,
verses.zh: 耶和华的眼目看顾敬畏他的人和仰望他慈爱的人，

verses.en: to deliver their soul from death, to keep them alive in famine.
verses.zh: 要救他们的命脱离死亡，并使他们在饥荒中存活。

words.g: and + to + to live, whether literally or figuratively + +them/their

verses.en: Our soul has waited for the LORD. He is our help and our shield.
verses.zh: 我们的心向来等候耶和华；他是我们的帮助，我们的盾牌。

verses.en: For our heart rejoices in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.
verses.zh: 我们的心必靠他欢喜，因为我们向来倚靠他的圣名。

verses.en: Let your loving kindness be on us, LORD, since we have hoped in you.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，求你照着我们所仰望你的，向我们施行慈爱！

verses.en: By David; when he pretended to be insane before Abimelech, who drove him away, and he departed.
verses.zh: （大卫在亚比米勒面前装疯，被他赶出去，就作这诗。）

words.g: Abimelek, the name of two Philistine kings and of two Israelites

verses.en: I will bless the LORD at all times. His praise will always be in my mouth.
verses.zh: 我要时时称颂耶和华；赞美他的话必常在我口中。

words.g: in + the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +me/my

verses.en: My soul shall boast in the LORD. The humble shall hear of it and be glad.
verses.zh: 我的心必因耶和华夸耀；谦卑人听见就要喜乐。

verses.en: Oh magnify the LORD with me. Let’s exalt his name together.
verses.zh: 你们和我当称耶和华为大，一同高举他的名。

words.g: and + to be high actively, to rise or raise

verses.en: I sought the LORD, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears.
verses.zh: 我曾寻求耶和华，他就应允我，救我脱离了一切的恐惧。

verses.en: They looked to him, and were radiant. Their faces shall never be covered with shame.
verses.zh: 凡仰望他的，便有光荣；他们的脸必不蒙羞。

words.g: and + to sparkle, i.e.  be cheerful

verses.en: This poor man cried, and the LORD heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.
verses.zh: 我这困苦人呼求，耶和华便垂听，救我脱离一切患难。

words.g: to be open, wide or free + +him/his/it

verses.en: The LORD’s angel encamps around those who fear him, and delivers them.
verses.zh: 耶和华的使者在敬畏他的人四围安营，搭救他们。

verses.en: Oh taste and see that the LORD is good. Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.
verses.zh: 你们要尝尝主恩的滋味，便知道他是美善；投靠他的人有福了！

words.g: the + a valiant man or warrior

verses.en: Oh fear the LORD, you his saints, for there is no lack with those who fear him.
verses.zh: 耶和华的圣民哪，你们当敬畏他，因敬畏他的一无所缺。

verses.en: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger, but those who seek the LORD shall not lack any good thing.
verses.zh: 少壮狮子还缺食忍饿，但寻求耶和华的甚么好处都不缺。

verses.en: Come, you children, listen to me. I will teach you the fear of the LORD.
verses.zh: 众弟子啊，你们当来听我的话！我要将敬畏耶和华的道教训你们。

verses.en: Who is someone who desires life, and loves many days, that he may see good?
verses.zh: 有何人喜好存活，爱慕长寿，得享美福，

verses.en: Keep your tongue from evil, and your lips from speaking lies.
verses.zh: 就要禁止舌头不出恶言，嘴唇不说诡诈的话。

words.g: to guard, in a good sense  or a bad one

verses.en: Depart from evil, and do good. Seek peace, and pursue it.
verses.zh: 要离恶行善，寻求和睦，一心追赶。

verses.en: The LORD’s eyes are toward the righteous. His ears listen to their cry.
verses.zh: 耶和华的眼目看顾义人；他的耳朵听他们的呼求。

verses.en: The LORD’s face is against those who do evil, to cut off their memory from the earth.
verses.zh: 耶和华向行恶的人变脸，要从世上除灭他们的名号。

verses.en: The righteous cry, and the LORD hears, and delivers them out of all their troubles.
verses.zh: 义人呼求，耶和华听见了，便救他们脱离一切患难。

verses.en: The LORD is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.
verses.zh: 耶和华靠近伤心的人，拯救灵性痛悔的人。

words.g: to be open, wide or free

verses.en: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but the LORD delivers him out of them all.
verses.zh: 义人多有苦难，但耶和华救他脱离这一切，

verses.en: He protects all of his bones. Not one of them is broken.
verses.zh: 又保全他一身的骨头，连一根也不折断。

verses.en: Evil shall kill the wicked. Those who hate the righteous shall be condemned.
verses.zh: 恶必害死恶人；恨恶义人的，必被定罪。

verses.en: The LORD redeems the soul of his servants. None of those who take refuge in him shall be condemned.
verses.zh: 耶和华救赎他仆人的灵魂；凡投靠他的，必不致定罪。

verses.en: By David. Contend, LORD, with those who contend with me. Fight against those who fight against me.
verses.zh: （大卫的诗。）耶和华啊，与我相争的，求你与他们相争！与我相战的，求你与他们相战！

verses.en: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for my help.
verses.zh: 拿着大小的盾牌，起来帮助我。

verses.en: Brandish the spear and block those who pursue me. Tell my soul, “I am your salvation.”
verses.zh: 抽出枪来，挡住那追赶我的；求你对我的灵魂说：我是拯救你的。

words.g: and + to pour out , i.e. empty

verses.en: Let those who seek after my soul be disappointed and brought to dishonor. Let those who plot my ruin be turned back and confounded.
verses.zh: 愿那寻索我命的，蒙羞受辱！愿那谋害我的，退后羞愧！

words.g: to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed
to flinch, i.e.  to go back

verses.en: Let them be as chaff before the wind, the LORD’s angel driving them on.
verses.zh: 愿他们像风前的糠，有耶和华的使者赶逐他们。

verses.en: Let their way be dark and slippery, the LORD’s angel pursuing them.
verses.zh: 愿他们的道路又暗又滑，有耶和华的使者追赶他们。

verses.en: For without cause they have hidden their net in a pit for me. Without cause they have dug a pit for my soul.
verses.zh: 因他们无故地为我暗设网罗，无故地挖坑，要害我的性命。

verses.en: Let destruction come on him unawares. Let his net that he has hidden catch himself. Let him fall into that destruction.
verses.zh: 愿灾祸忽然临到他身上！愿他暗设的网缠住自己！愿他落在其中遭灾祸！

verses.en: My soul shall be joyful in the LORD. It shall rejoice in his salvation.
verses.zh: 我的心必靠耶和华快乐，靠他的救恩高兴。

words.g: to spin round , i.e. usually rejoice

verses.en: All my bones shall say, “LORD, who is like you, who delivers the poor from him who is too strong for him; yes, the poor and the needy from him who robs him?”
verses.zh: 我的骨头都要说：耶和华啊，谁能像你救护困苦人脱离那比他强壮的，救护困苦穷乏人脱离那抢夺他的？

words.g: a form of the prefix 'k-', but used separately  as + +you/your
and + depressed, in mind or circumstances

verses.en: Unrighteous witnesses rise up. They ask me about things that I don’t know about.
verses.zh: 凶恶的见证人起来，盘问我所不知道的事。

verses.en: They reward me evil for good, to the bereaving of my soul.
verses.zh: 他们向我以恶报善，使我的灵魂孤苦。

verses.en: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth. I afflicted my soul with fasting. My prayer returned into my own bosom.
verses.zh: 至于我，当他们有病的时候，我便穿麻衣，禁食，刻苦己心；我所求的都归到自己的怀中。

verses.en: I behaved myself as though it had been my friend or my brother. I bowed down mourning, as one who mourns his mother.
verses.zh: 我这样行，好像他是我的朋友，我的弟兄；我屈身悲哀，如同人为母亲哀痛。

verses.en: But in my adversity, they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together. The attackers gathered themselves together against me, and I didn’t know it. They tore at me, and didn’t cease.
verses.zh: 我在患难中，他们却欢喜，大家聚集。我所不认识的那些下流人聚集攻击我；他们不住地把我撕裂。

words.g: and + in + a limping or full + +me/my
and + to gather for any purpose

verses.en: Like the profane mockers in feasts, they gnashed their teeth at me.
verses.zh: 他们如同席上好嬉笑的狂妄人向我咬牙。

verses.en: Lord, how long will you look on? Rescue my soul from their destruction, my precious life from the lions.
verses.zh: 主啊，你看着不理要到几时呢？求你救我的灵魂脱离他们的残害！救我的生命（生命：原文是独一者）脱离少壮狮子！

verses.en: I will give you thanks in the great assembly. I will praise you among many people.
verses.zh: 我在大会中要称谢你，在众民中要赞美你。

verses.en: Don’t let those who are my enemies wrongfully rejoice over me; neither let those who hate me without a cause wink their eyes.
verses.zh: 求你不容那无理与我为仇的向我夸耀！不容那无故恨我的向我挤眼！

words.g: to pinch, i.e.  to bite the lips

verses.en: For they don’t speak peace, but they devise deceitful words against those who are quiet in the land.
verses.zh: 因为他们不说和平话，倒想出诡诈的言语害地上的安静人。

verses.en: Yes, they opened their mouth wide against me. They said, “Aha! Aha! Our eye has seen it!”
verses.zh: 他们大大张口攻击我，说：阿哈，阿哈，我们的眼已经看见了！

words.g: the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +them/their

verses.en: You have seen it, LORD. Don’t keep silent. Lord, don’t be far from me.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，你已经看见了，求你不要闭口！主啊，求你不要远离我！

words.g: to widen , i.e.  recede or  remove

verses.en: Wake up! Rise up to defend me, my God! My Lord, contend for me!
verses.zh: 我的神我的主啊，求你奋兴醒起，判清我的事，伸明我的冤！

verses.en: Vindicate me, LORD my God, according to your righteousness. Don’t let them gloat over me.
verses.zh: 耶和华―我的神啊，求你按你的公义判断我，不容他们向我夸耀！

verses.en: Don’t let them say in their heart, “Aha! That’s the way we want it!” Don’t let them say, “We have swallowed him up!”
verses.zh: 不容他们心里说：阿哈，遂我们的心愿了！不容他们说：我们已经把他吞了！

verses.en: Let them be disappointed and confounded together who rejoice at my calamity. Let them be clothed with shame and dishonor who magnify themselves against me.
verses.zh: 愿那喜欢我遭难的一同抱愧蒙羞！愿那向我妄自尊大的披惭愧，蒙羞辱！

words.g: to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed

verses.en: Let those who favor my righteous cause shout for joy and be glad. Yes, let them say continually, “May the LORD be magnified, who has pleasure in the prosperity of his servant!”
verses.zh: 愿那喜悦我冤屈得伸的（冤屈得伸：原文是公义）欢呼快乐；愿他们常说：当尊耶和华为大！耶和华喜悦他的仆人平安。

verses.en: My tongue shall talk about your righteousness and about your praise all day long.
verses.zh: 我的舌头要终日论说你的公义，时常赞美你。

verses.en: For the Chief Musician. By David, the servant of the LORD.
verses.zh: （耶和华的仆人大卫的诗，交与伶长。）

words.g: to + to glitter from afar, i.e. to be eminent

verses.en: A revelation is within my heart about the disobedience of the wicked: There is no fear of God before his eyes.
verses.zh: 恶人的罪过在他心里说：我眼中不怕神！

words.g: in + the nearest part, i.e. the center

verses.en: For he flatters himself in his own eyes, too much to detect and hate his sin.
verses.zh: 他自夸自媚，以为他的罪孽终不显露，不被恨恶。

verses.en: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit. He has ceased to be wise and to do good.
verses.zh: 他口中的言语尽是罪孽诡诈；他与智慧善行已经断绝。

words.g: the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +him/his/it
to + to be  circumspect and hence, intelligent

verses.en: He plots iniquity on his bed. He sets himself in a way that is not good. He doesn’t abhor evil.
verses.zh: 他在床上图谋罪孽，定意行不善的道，不憎恶恶事。

verses.en: Your loving kindness, LORD, is in the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，你的慈爱上及诸天；你的信实达到穹苍。

verses.en: Your righteousness is like the mountains of God. Your judgments are like a great deep. LORD, you preserve man and animal.
verses.zh: 你的公义好像高山；你的判断如同深渊。耶和华啊，人民、牲畜，你都救护。

words.g: to be open, wide or free

verses.en: How precious is your loving kindness, God! The children of men take refuge under the shadow of your wings.
verses.zh: 神啊，你的慈爱何其宝贵！世人投靠在你翅膀的荫下。

verses.en: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the abundance of your house. You will make them drink of the river of your pleasures.
verses.zh: 他们必因你殿里的肥甘得以饱足；你也必叫他们喝你乐河的水。

words.g: and + a stream, especially a winter torrent
to quaff, i.e.  to irrigate or furnish apotion to + +them/their

verses.en: For with you is the spring of life. In your light we will see light.
verses.zh: 因为，在你那里有生命的源头；在你的光中，我们必得见光。

verses.en: Oh continue your loving kindness to those who know you, your righteousness to the upright in heart.
verses.zh: 愿你常施慈爱给认识你的人，常以公义待心里正直的人。

words.g: to draw, used in a great variety of applications

verses.en: Don’t let the foot of pride come against me. Don’t let the hand of the wicked drive me away.
verses.zh: 不容骄傲人的脚践踏我；不容凶恶人的手赶逐我。

verses.en: There the workers of iniquity are fallen. They are thrust down, and shall not be able to rise.
verses.zh: 在那里，作孽的人已经仆倒；他们被推倒，不能再起来。

words.g: to do or make , especially to practise

verses.en: By David. Don’t fret because of evildoers, neither be envious against those who work unrighteousness.
verses.zh: （大卫的诗。）不要为作恶的心怀不平，也不要向那行不义的生出嫉妒。

words.g: to be  zealous, i.e.  jealous or envious

verses.en: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither like the green herb.
verses.zh: 因为他们如草快被割下，又如青菜快要枯干。

verses.en: Trust in the LORD, and do good. Dwell in the land, and enjoy safe pasture.
verses.zh: 你当倚靠耶和华而行善，住在地上，以他的信实为粮；

verses.en: Also delight yourself in the LORD, and he will give you the desires of your heart.
verses.zh: 又要以耶和华为乐，他就将你心里所求的赐给你。

words.g: and + to be soft or pliable, i.e.  effeminate or luxurious

verses.en: Commit your way to the LORD. Trust also in him, and he will do this:
verses.zh: 当将你的事交托耶和华，并倚靠他，他就必成全。

verses.en: he will make your righteousness shine out like light, and your justice as the noon day sun.
verses.zh: 他要使你的公义如光发出，使你的公平明如正午。
