verses.en: Rest in the LORD, and wait patiently for him. Don’t fret because of him who prospers in his way, because of the man who makes wicked plots happen.
verses.zh: 你当默然倚靠耶和华，耐性等候他；不要因那道路通达的和那恶谋成就的心怀不平。

words.g: and + to twist or whirl , i.e.  to dance
in + to push forward, in various senses

verses.en: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath. Don’t fret; it leads only to evildoing.
verses.zh: 当止住怒气，离弃忿怒；不要心怀不平，以致作恶。

verses.en: For evildoers shall be cut off, but those who wait for the LORD shall inherit the land.
verses.zh: 因为作恶的必被剪除；惟有等候耶和华的必承受地土。

words.g: and + to bind together , i.e. collect

verses.en: For yet a little while, and the wicked will be no more. Yes, though you look for his place, he isn’t there.
verses.zh: 还有片时，恶人要归于无有；你就是细察他的住处也要归于无有。

words.g: and + to separate mentally , i.e. understand

verses.en: But the humble shall inherit the land, and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.
verses.zh: 但谦卑人必承受地土，以丰盛的平安为乐。

words.g: and + depressed , in mind  or circumstances
and + to be soft or pliable, i.e.  effeminate or luxurious

verses.en: The wicked plots against the just, and gnashes at him with his teeth.
verses.zh: 恶人设谋害义人，又向他咬牙。

words.g: to plan, usually in a bad sense

verses.en: The Lord will laugh at him, for he sees that his day is coming.
verses.zh: 主要笑他，因见他受罚的日子将要来到。

verses.en: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, to kill those who are upright on the path.
verses.zh: 恶人已经弓上弦，刀出鞘，要打倒困苦穷乏的人，要杀害行动正直的人。

words.g: a bow, forshooting  or the iris + +them/their

verses.en: Their sword shall enter into their own heart. Their bows shall be broken.
verses.zh: 他们的刀必刺入自己的心；他们的弓必被折断。

words.g: and + a bow, forshooting  or the iris + +them/their

verses.en: Better is a little that the righteous has, than the abundance of many wicked.
verses.zh: 一个义人所有的虽少，强过许多恶人的富余。

verses.en: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken, but the LORD upholds the righteous.
verses.zh: 因为恶人的膀臂必被折断；但耶和华是扶持义人。

verses.en: The LORD knows the days of the perfect. Their inheritance shall be forever.
verses.zh: 耶和华知道完全人的日子；他们的产业要存到永远。

verses.en: They shall not be disappointed in the time of evil. In the days of famine they shall be satisfied.
verses.zh: 他们在急难的时候不致羞愧，在饥荒的日子必得饱足。

words.g: to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed

verses.en: But the wicked shall perish. The enemies of the LORD shall be like the beauty of the fields. They will vanish— vanish like smoke.
verses.zh: 恶人却要灭亡。耶和华的仇敌要像羊羔的脂油（或译：像草地的华美）；他们要消灭，要如烟消灭。

words.g: to end, whether intransitive  or transitived
to end, whether intransitive  or transitived

verses.en: The wicked borrow, and don’t pay back, but the righteous give generously.
verses.zh: 恶人借贷而不偿还；义人却恩待人，并且施舍。

verses.en: For such as are blessed by him shall inherit the land. Those who are cursed by him shall be cut off.
verses.zh: 蒙耶和华赐福的必承受地土；被他咒诅的必被剪除。

verses.en: A man’s steps are established by the LORD. He delights in his way.
verses.zh: 义人的脚步被耶和华立定；他的道路，耶和华也喜爱。

verses.en: Though he stumble, he shall not fall, for the LORD holds him up with his hand.
verses.zh: 他虽失脚也不致全身仆倒，因为耶和华用手搀扶他（或译：搀扶他的手）。

verses.en: I have been young, and now am old, yet I have not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his children begging for bread.
verses.zh: 我从前年幼，现在年老，却未见过义人被弃，也未见过他的后裔讨饭。

words.g: a boy , from the age of infancy to adolescence

verses.en: All day long he deals graciously, and lends. His offspring is blessed.
verses.zh: 他终日恩待人，借给人；他的后裔也蒙福！

words.g: and + to twine, i.e.  to unite

verses.en: Depart from evil, and do good. Live securely forever.
verses.zh: 你当离恶行善，就可永远安居。

words.g: and + to reside or permanently stay

verses.en: For the LORD loves justice, and doesn’t forsake his saints. They are preserved forever, but the children of the wicked shall be cut off.
verses.zh: 因为，耶和华喜爱公平，不撇弃他的圣民；他们永蒙保佑，但恶人的后裔必被剪除。

verses.en: The righteous shall inherit the land, and live in it forever.
verses.zh: 义人必承受地土，永居其上。

words.g: and + to reside or permanently stay

verses.en: The mouth of the righteous talks of wisdom. His tongue speaks justice.
verses.zh: 义人的口谈论智慧；他的舌头讲说公平。

words.g: the mouth , whether literal or figurative

verses.en: The law of his God is in his heart. None of his steps shall slide.
verses.zh: 神的律法在他心里；他的脚总不滑跌。

verses.en: The wicked watch the righteous, and seek to kill him.
verses.zh: 恶人窥探义人，想要杀他。

words.g: to lean forward, i.e. to peer into the distance

verses.en: The LORD will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.
verses.zh: 耶和华必不撇他在恶人手中；当审判的时候，也不定他的罪。

verses.en: Wait for the LORD, and keep his way, and he will exalt you to inherit the land. When the wicked are cut off, you shall see it.
verses.zh: 你当等候耶和华，遵守他的道，他就抬举你，使你承受地土；恶人被剪除的时候，你必看见。

words.g: and + to be high actively, to rise or raise + +you/your

verses.en: I have seen the wicked in great power, spreading himself like a green tree in its native soil.
verses.zh: 我见过恶人大有势力，好像一根青翠树在本土生发。

words.g: like + a spontaneous growth, i.e. native

verses.en: But he passed away, and behold, he was not. Yes, I sought him, but he could not be found.
verses.zh: 有人从那里经过，不料，他没有了；我也寻找他，却寻不着。

verses.en: Mark the perfect man, and see the upright, for there is a future for the man of peace.
verses.zh: 你要细察那完全人，观看那正直人，因为和平人有好结局。

verses.en: As for transgressors, they shall be destroyed together. The future of the wicked shall be cut off.
verses.zh: 至于犯法的人，必一同灭绝；恶人终必剪除。

words.g: and + to break away , i.e. trespass

verses.en: But the salvation of the righteous is from the LORD. He is their stronghold in the time of trouble.
verses.zh: 但义人得救是由于耶和华；他在患难时作他们的营寨。

verses.en: The LORD helps them and rescues them. He rescues them from the wicked and saves them, because they have taken refuge in him.
verses.zh: 耶和华帮助他们，解救他们；他解救他们脱离恶人，把他们救出来，因为他们投靠他。

words.g: and + to surround, i.e. protect or aid + +them/their
and + to be open, wide or free + +them/their

verses.en: A Psalm by David, for a memorial.
verses.zh: （大卫的记念诗。）

verses.en: LORD, don’t rebuke me in your wrath, neither chasten me in your hot displeasure.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，求你不要在怒中责备我，不要在烈怒中惩罚我！

verses.en: For your arrows have pierced me, your hand presses hard on me.
verses.zh: 因为，你的箭射入我身；你的手压住我。

verses.en: There is no soundness in my flesh because of your indignation, neither is there any health in my bones because of my sin.
verses.zh: 因你的恼怒，我的肉无一完全；因我的罪过，我的骨头也不安宁。

words.g: strictly froth at the mouth, i.e.  fury + +you/your

verses.en: For my iniquities have gone over my head. As a heavy burden, they are too heavy for me.
verses.zh: 我的罪孽高过我的头，如同重担叫我担当不起。

verses.en: My wounds are loathsome and corrupt because of my foolishness.
verses.zh: 因我的愚昧，我的伤发臭流脓。

verses.en: I am in pain and bowed down greatly. I go mourning all day long.
verses.zh: 我疼痛，大大拳曲，终日哀痛。

verses.en: For my waist is filled with burning. There is no soundness in my flesh.
verses.zh: 我满腰是火；我的肉无一完全。

words.g: fatness, i.e. by implication  the loin  or  the viscera + +me/my
to toast, i.e. scorch partially or slowly

verses.en: I am faint and severely bruised. I have groaned by reason of the anguish of my heart.
verses.zh: 我被压伤，身体疲倦；因心里不安，我就唉哼。

verses.en: Lord, all my desire is before you. My groaning is not hidden from you.
verses.zh: 主啊，我的心愿都在你面前；我的叹息不向你隐瞒。

verses.en: My heart throbs. My strength fails me. As for the light of my eyes, it has also left me.
verses.zh: 我心跳动，我力衰微，连我眼中的光也没有了。

verses.en: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my plague. My kinsmen stand far away.
verses.zh: 我的良朋密友因我的灾病都躲在旁边站着；我的亲戚本家也远远地站立。

verses.en: They also who seek after my life lay snares. Those who seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and meditate deceits all day long.
verses.zh: 那寻索我命的设下网罗；那想要害我的口出恶言，终日思想诡计。

words.g: and + to entrap , literally or figuratively

verses.en: But I, as a deaf man, don’t hear. I am as a mute man who doesn’t open his mouth.
verses.zh: 但我如聋子不听，像哑巴不开口。

words.g: the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +him/his/it

verses.en: Yes, I am as a man who doesn’t hear, in whose mouth are no reproofs.
verses.zh: 我如不听见的人，口中没有回话。

words.g: in + the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +him/his/it

verses.en: For I hope in you, LORD. You will answer, Lord my God.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，我仰望你！主―我的神啊，你必应允我！

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: For I said, “Don’t let them gloat over me, or exalt themselves over me when my foot slips.”
verses.zh: 我曾说：恐怕他们向我夸耀；我失脚的时候，他们向我夸大。

verses.en: For I am ready to fall. My pain is continually before me.
verses.zh: 我几乎跌倒；我的痛苦常在我面前。

verses.en: For I will declare my iniquity. I will be sorry for my sin.
verses.zh: 我要承认我的罪孽；我要因我的罪忧愁。

words.g: from + an offence , and its penalty + +me/my

verses.en: But my enemies are vigorous and many. Those who hate me without reason are numerous.
verses.zh: 但我的仇敌又活泼又强壮，无理恨我的增多了。

words.g: and + to cast together , i.e. increase

verses.en: They who give evil for good are also adversaries to me, because I follow what is good.
verses.zh: 以恶报善的与我作对，因我是追求良善。

verses.en: Don’t forsake me, LORD. My God, don’t be far from me.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，求你不要撇弃我！我的神啊，求你不要远离我！

words.g: to widen , i.e.  recede or  remove

verses.en: Hurry to help me, Lord, my salvation.
verses.zh: 拯救我的主啊，求你快快帮助我！

verses.en: For the Chief Musician. For Jeduthun. A Psalm by David.
verses.zh: （大卫的诗，交与伶长耶杜顿。）

words.g: to + to glitter from afar, i.e. to be eminent

verses.en: I said, “I will watch my ways, so that I don’t sin with my tongue. I will keep my mouth with a bridle while the wicked is before me.”
verses.zh: 我曾说：我要谨慎我的言行，免得我舌头犯罪；恶人在我面前的时候，我要用嚼环勒住我的口。

words.g: to + the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +me/my

verses.en: I was mute with silence. I held my peace, even from good. My sorrow was stirred.
verses.zh: 我默然无声，连好话也不出口；我的愁苦就发动了，

verses.en: My heart was hot within me. While I meditated, the fire burned. I spoke with my tongue:
verses.zh: 我的心在我里面发热。我默想的时候，火就烧起，我便用舌头说话。

words.g: in + the nearest part, i.e. the center + +me/my

verses.en: “LORD, show me my end, what is the measure of my days. Let me know how frail I am.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，求你叫我晓得我身之终！我的寿数几何？叫我知道我的生命不长！

words.g: and + extension, i.e. height or breadth

verses.en: Behold, you have made my days hand widths. My lifetime is as nothing before you. Surely every man stands as a breath.” Selah.
verses.zh: 你使我的年日窄如手掌；我一生的年数，在你面前如同无有。各人最稳妥的时候，真是全然虚幻。（细拉）

words.g: a spread of the hand, i.e. a palm-breadth

verses.en: “Surely every man walks like a shadow. Surely they busy themselves in vain. He heaps up, and doesn’t know who shall gather.
verses.zh: 世人行动实系幻影。他们忙乱，真是枉然；积蓄财宝，不知将来有谁收取。

verses.en: Now, Lord, what do I wait for? My hope is in you.
verses.zh: 主啊，如今我等甚么呢？我的指望在乎你！

verses.en: Deliver me from all my transgressions. Don’t make me the reproach of the foolish.
verses.zh: 求你救我脱离一切的过犯，不要使我受愚顽人的羞辱。

verses.en: I was mute. I didn’t open my mouth, because you did it.
verses.zh: 因我所遭遇的是出于你，我就默然不语。

words.g: the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +me/my
thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: Remove your scourge away from me. I am overcome by the blow of your hand.
verses.zh: 求你把你的责罚从我身上免去；因你手的责打，我便消灭。

words.g: to end, whether intransitive  or transitived

verses.en: When you rebuke and correct man for iniquity, you consume his wealth like a moth. Surely every man is but a breath.” Selah.
verses.zh: 你因人的罪恶惩罚他的时候，叫他的笑容（的笑容：或译所喜爱的）消灭，如衣被虫所咬。世人真是虚幻！（细拉）

verses.en: “Hear my prayer, LORD, and give ear to my cry. Don’t be silent at my tears. For I am a stranger with you, a foreigner, as all my fathers were.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，求你听我的祷告，留心听我的呼求！我流泪，求你不要静默无声！因为我在你面前是客旅，是寄居的，像我列祖一般。

words.g: to broaden out the ear , i.e.  to listen
father, in a literal and immediate + +me/my

verses.en: Oh spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go away and exist no more.”
verses.zh: 求你宽容我，使我在去而不返之先可以力量复原。

words.g: and + to break off or loose , i.e. desist  or invade

verses.en: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David.
verses.zh: （大卫的诗，交与伶长。）

words.g: to + to glitter from afar, i.e. to be eminent

verses.en: I waited patiently for the LORD. He turned to me, and heard my cry.
verses.zh: 我曾耐性等候耶和华；他垂听我的呼求。

words.g: and + to stretch or spread out

verses.en: He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay. He set my feet on a rock, and gave me a firm place to stand.
verses.zh: 他从祸坑里，从淤泥中，把我拉上来，使我的脚立在磐石上，使我脚步稳当。

words.g: a craggy rock, literally or figuratively

verses.en: He has put a new song in my mouth, even praise to our God. Many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in the LORD.
verses.zh: 他使我口唱新歌，就是赞美我们神的话。许多人必看见而惧怕，并要倚靠耶和华。

words.g: in + the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +me/my

verses.en: Blessed is the man who makes the LORD his trust, and doesn’t respect the proud, nor such as turn away to lies.
verses.zh: 那倚靠耶和华、不理会狂傲和偏向虚假之辈的，这人便为有福！

words.g: the + a valiant man or warrior
and + to detrude, i.e.  become derelict

verses.en: Many, LORD, my God, are the wonderful works which you have done, and your thoughts which are toward us. They can’t be declared back to you. If I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be counted.
verses.zh: 耶和华―我的神啊，你所行的奇事，并你向我们所怀的意念甚多，不能向你陈明。若要陈明，其事不可胜数。

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you
and + a contrivance, i.e.  a texture + +you/your
to set in a row, i.e. arrange
from + to score with a mark as a tally or record, i.e.  to inscribe

verses.en: Sacrifice and offering you didn’t desire. You have opened my ears. You have not required burnt offering and sin offering.
verses.zh: 祭物和礼物，你不喜悦；你已经开通我的耳朵。燔祭和赎罪祭非你所要。

words.g: and + an offence, or a sacrifice forit

verses.en: Then I said, “Behold, I have come. It is written about me in the book in the scroll.
verses.zh: 那时我说：看哪，我来了！我的事在经卷上已经记载了。

verses.en: I delight to do your will, my God. Yes, your law is within my heart.”
verses.zh: 我的神啊，我乐意照你的旨意行；你的律法在我心里。

verses.en: I have proclaimed glad news of righteousness in the great assembly. Behold, I will not seal my lips, LORD, you know.
verses.zh: 我在大会中宣传公义的佳音；我必不止住我的嘴唇。耶和华啊，这是你所知道的。

words.g: to be fresh, i.e. full  cheerful)
to restrict, by act  or word
thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: I have not hidden your righteousness within my heart. I have declared your faithfulness and your salvation. I have not concealed your loving kindness and your truth from the great assembly.
verses.zh: 我未曾把你的公义藏在心里；我已陈明你的信实和你的救恩；我在大会中未曾隐瞒你的慈爱和诚实。

words.g: to secrete, by act or word

verses.en: Don’t withhold your tender mercies from me, LORD. Let your loving kindness and your truth continually preserve me.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，求你不要向我止住你的慈悲！愿你的慈爱和诚实常常保佑我！

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you
to restrict, by act  or word
to guard, in a good sense  or a bad one + +me/my

verses.en: For innumerable evils have surrounded me. My iniquities have overtaken me, so that I am not able to look up. They are more than the hairs of my head. My heart has failed me.
verses.zh: 因有无数的祸患围困我，我的罪孽追上了我，使我不能昂首；这罪孽比我的头发还多，我就心寒胆战。

verses.en: Be pleased, LORD, to deliver me. Hurry to help me, LORD.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，求你开恩搭救我！耶和华啊，求你速速帮助我！

verses.en: Let them be disappointed and confounded together who seek after my soul to destroy it. Let them be turned backward and brought to dishonor who delight in my hurt.
verses.zh: 愿那些寻找我、要灭我命的，一同抱愧蒙羞！愿那些喜悦我受害的，退后受辱！

words.g: to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed
to + to scrape  together  or away + +her/its
to flinch, i.e.  to go back

verses.en: Let them be desolate by reason of their shame that tell me, “Aha! Aha!”
verses.zh: 愿那些对我说阿哈、阿哈的，因羞愧而败亡！

words.g: to stun , i.e. devastate or  stupefy
a heel, i.e.  the last of anything

verses.en: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let such as love your salvation say continually, “Let the LORD be exalted!”
verses.zh: 愿一切寻求你的，因你高兴欢喜！愿那些喜爱你救恩的，常说：当尊耶和华为大！

verses.en: But I am poor and needy. May the Lord think about me. You are my help and my deliverer. Don’t delay, my God.
verses.zh: 但我是困苦穷乏的，主仍顾念我；你是帮助我的，搭救我的。神啊，求你不要耽延！

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David.
verses.zh: （大卫的诗，交与伶长。）

words.g: to + to glitter from afar, i.e. to be eminent

verses.en: Blessed is he who considers the poor. The LORD will deliver him in the day of evil.
verses.zh: 眷顾贫穷的有福了！他遭难的日子，耶和华必搭救他。

words.g: to be  circumspect and hence, intelligent
to be smooth, i.e.  to escape + +him/his/it

verses.en: The LORD will preserve him, and keep him alive. He shall be blessed on the earth, and he will not surrender him to the will of his enemies.
verses.zh: 耶和华必保全他，使他存活；他必在地上享福。求你不要把他交给仇敌，遂其所愿。

words.g: and + to live, whether literally or figuratively + +him/his/it

verses.en: The LORD will sustain him on his sickbed, and restore him from his bed of illness.
verses.zh: 他病重在榻，耶和华必扶持他；他在病中，你必给他铺床。

verses.en: I said, “LORD, have mercy on me! Heal me, for I have sinned against you.”
verses.zh: 我曾说：耶和华啊，求你怜恤我，医治我！因为我得罪了你。

verses.en: My enemies speak evil against me: “When will he die, and his name perish?”
verses.zh: 我的仇敌用恶言议论我说：他几时死，他的名才灭亡呢？

verses.en: If he comes to see me, he speaks falsehood. His heart gathers iniquity to itself. When he goes abroad, he tells it.
verses.zh: 他来看我就说假话；他心存奸恶，走到外边才说出来。

words.g: and + used very widely as demonstrative, lo!
to + separate by awall, i.e. outside

verses.en: All who hate me whisper together against me. They imagine the worst for me.
verses.zh: 一切恨我的，都交头接耳地议论我；他们设计要害我。

verses.en: “An evil disease”, they say, “has afflicted him. Now that he lies he shall rise up no more.”
verses.zh: 他们说：有怪病贴在他身上；他已躺卧，必不能再起来。

verses.en: Yes, my own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, who ate bread with me, has lifted up his heel against me.
verses.zh: 连我知己的朋友，我所倚靠、吃过我饭的也用脚踢我。

verses.en: But you, LORD, have mercy on me, and raise me up, that I may repay them.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，求你怜恤我，使我起来，好报复他们！

words.g: and + thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: By this I know that you delight in me, because my enemy doesn’t triumph over me.
verses.zh: 因我的仇敌不得向我夸胜，我从此便知道你喜爱我。

verses.en: As for me, you uphold me in my integrity, and set me in your presence forever.
verses.zh: 你因我纯正就扶持我，使我永远站在你的面前。

words.g: and + to station, in various applications + +me/my

verses.en: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting and to everlasting! Amen and amen.
verses.zh: 耶和华―以色列的神是应当称颂的，从亘古直到永远。阿们！阿们！

verses.en: For the Chief Musician. A contemplation by the sons of Korah.
verses.zh: （可拉后裔的训诲诗，交与伶长。）

words.g: to + to glitter from afar, i.e. to be eminent
Korach, the name of two Edomites and three Israelites

verses.en: As the deer pants for the water brooks, so my soul pants after you, God.
verses.zh: 神啊，我的心切慕你，如鹿切慕溪水。

words.g: like + a stag or male deer

verses.en: My soul thirsts for God, for the living God. When shall I come and appear before God?
verses.zh: 我的心渴想神，就是永生神；我几时得朝见神呢？

verses.en: My tears have been my food day and night, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”
verses.zh: 我昼夜以眼泪当饮食；人不住地对我说：你的神在哪里呢？

verses.en: These things I remember, and pour out my soul within me, how I used to go with the crowd, and led them to God’s house, with the voice of joy and praise, a multitude keeping a holy day.
verses.zh: 我从前与众人同往，用欢呼称赞的声音领他们到神的殿里，大家守节。我追想这些事，我的心极其悲伤。

words.g: in + a thicket of men, i.e. a crowd
to move in acircle, i.e.  to march in asacred procession

verses.en: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him for the saving help of his presence.
verses.zh: 我的心哪，你为何忧闷？为何在我里面烦躁？应当仰望神，因他笑脸帮助我；我还要称赞他。

words.g: and + to make a loud sound

verses.en: My God, my soul is in despair within me. Therefore I remember you from the land of the Jordan, the heights of Hermon, from the hill Mizar.
verses.zh: 我的神啊，我的心在我里面忧闷，所以我从约旦地，从黑门岭，从米萨山记念你。

words.g: Jarden, the principal river of Palestine

verses.en: Deep calls to deep at the noise of your waterfalls. All your waves and your billows have swept over me.
verses.zh: 你的瀑布发声，深渊就与深渊响应；你的波浪洪涛漫过我身。

verses.en: The LORD will command his loving kindness in the daytime. In the night his song shall be with me: a prayer to the God of my life.
verses.zh: 白昼，耶和华必向我施慈爱；黑夜，我要歌颂祷告赐我生命的神。

verses.en: I will ask God, my rock, “Why have you forgotten me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?”
verses.zh: 我要对神―我的磐石说：你为何忘记我呢？我为何因仇敌的欺压时常哀痛呢？

words.g: a craggy rock, literally or figuratively + +me/my
to mislay, i.e. to be oblivious of + +me/my

verses.en: As with a sword in my bones, my adversaries reproach me, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”
verses.zh: 我的敌人辱骂我，好像打碎我的骨头，不住地对我说：你的神在哪里呢？

words.g: to pull off, i.e.  to expose + +me/my

verses.en: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him, the saving help of my countenance, and my God.
verses.zh: 我的心哪，你为何忧闷？为何在我里面烦躁？应当仰望神，因我还要称赞他。他是我脸上的光荣（原文是帮助），是我的神。

verses.en: Vindicate me, God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation. Oh, deliver me from deceitful and wicked men.
verses.zh: 神啊，求你伸我的冤，向不虔诚的国为我辨屈；求你救我脱离诡诈不义的人。

verses.en: For you are the God of my strength. Why have you rejected me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
verses.zh: 因为你是赐我力量的神，为何丢弃我呢？我为何因仇敌的欺压时常哀痛呢？

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: Oh, send out your light and your truth. Let them lead me. Let them bring me to your holy hill, to your tents.
verses.zh: 求你发出你的亮光和真实，好引导我，带我到你的圣山，到你的居所！

verses.en: Then I will go to the altar of God, to God, my exceeding joy. I will praise you on the harp, God, my God.
verses.zh: 我就走到神的祭坛，到我最喜乐的神那里。神啊，我的神，我要弹琴称赞你！

verses.en: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him: my Savior, my helper, and my God.
verses.zh: 我的心哪，你为何忧闷？为何在我里面烦躁？应当仰望神，因我还要称赞他。他是我脸上的光荣（原文是帮助），是我的神。

verses.en: For the Chief Musician. By the sons of Korah. A contemplative psalm.
verses.zh: （可拉后裔的训诲诗，交与伶长。）

words.g: to + to glitter from afar, i.e. to be eminent
Korach, the name of two Edomites and three Israelites

verses.en: We have heard with our ears, God; our fathers have told us what work you did in their days, in the days of old.
verses.zh: 神啊，你在古时，我们列祖的日子所行的事，我们亲耳听见了；我们的列祖也给我们述说过。

words.g: father, in a literal and immediate + +us/our
to score with a mark as a tally or record, i.e.  to inscribe
to do or make , especially to practise

verses.en: You drove out the nations with your hand, but you planted them. You afflicted the peoples, but you spread them abroad.
verses.zh: 你曾用手赶出外邦人，却栽培了我们列祖；你苦待列邦，却叫我们列祖发达。

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you
and + to strike in, i.e. fix + +them/their

verses.en: For they didn’t get the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them; but your right hand, your arm, and the light of your face, because you were favorable to them.
verses.zh: 因为他们不是靠自己的刀剑得地土，也不是靠自己的膀臂得胜，乃是靠你的右手、你的膀臂，和你脸上的亮光，因为你喜悦他们。

words.g: and + the arm , or  the foreleg + +them/their
to be open, wide or free
and + the arm , or  the foreleg + +you/your

verses.en: God, you are my King. Command victories for Jacob!
verses.zh: 神啊，你是我的王；求你出令使雅各得胜。

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: Through you, we will push down our adversaries. Through your name, we will tread down those who rise up against us.
verses.zh: 我们靠你要推倒我们的敌人，靠你的名要践踏那起来攻击我们的人。

verses.en: For I will not trust in my bow, neither will my sword save me.
verses.zh: 因为，我必不靠我的弓；我的刀也不能使我得胜。

words.g: in + a bow, forshooting  or the iris + +me/my
to be open, wide or free + +me/my

verses.en: But you have saved us from our adversaries, and have shamed those who hate us.
verses.zh: 惟你救了我们脱离敌人，使恨我们的人羞愧。

words.g: to be open, wide or free + +us/our
to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed

verses.en: In God we have made our boast all day long. We will give thanks to your name forever. Selah.
verses.zh: 我们终日因神夸耀，还要永远称谢你的名。（细拉）

verses.en: But now you rejected us, and brought us to dishonor, and don’t go out with our armies.
verses.zh: 但如今你丢弃了我们，使我们受辱，不和我们的军兵同去。

words.g: in + a mass of persons , especially reg. organized forwar + +us/our

verses.en: You make us turn back from the adversary. Those who hate us take plunder for themselves.
verses.zh: 你使我们向敌人转身退后；那恨我们的人任意抢夺。

verses.en: You have made us like sheep for food, and have scattered us among the nations.
verses.zh: 你使我们当作快要被吃的羊，把我们分散在列邦中。

verses.en: You sell your people for nothing, and have gained nothing from their sale.
verses.zh: 你卖了你的子民也不赚利，所得的价值并不加添你的资财。

verses.en: You make us a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and a derision to those who are around us.
verses.zh: 你使我们受邻国的羞辱，被四围的人嗤笑讥刺。

verses.en: You make us a byword among the nations, a shaking of the head among the peoples.
verses.zh: 你使我们在列邦中作了笑谈，使众民向我们摇头。

words.g: a pithy maxim, usually of metaphorical nature

verses.en: All day long my dishonor is before me, and shame covers my face,
verses.zh: 我的凌辱终日在我面前，我脸上的羞愧将我遮蔽，

verses.en: at the taunt of one who reproaches and verbally abuses, because of the enemy and the avenger.
verses.zh: 都因那辱骂毁谤人的声音，又因仇敌和报仇人的缘故。

words.g: to pull off, i.e.  to expose
and + to grudge, i.e. avenge or punish

verses.en: All this has come on us, yet we haven’t forgotten you. We haven’t been false to your covenant.
verses.zh: 这都临到我们身上，我们却没有忘记你，也没有违背你的约。

words.g: to mislay, i.e. to be oblivious of + +you/your

verses.en: Our heart has not turned back, neither have our steps strayed from your path,
verses.zh: 我们的心没有退后；我们的脚也没有偏离你的路。

words.g: to flinch, i.e.  to go back
and + to stretch or spread out

verses.en: though you have crushed us in the haunt of jackals, and covered us with the shadow of death.
verses.zh: 你在野狗之处压伤我们，用死荫遮蔽我们。

words.g: a marine or land monster, i.e. sea-serpent or jackal

verses.en: If we have forgotten the name of our God, or spread out our hands to a strange god,
verses.zh: 倘若我们忘了神的名，或向别神举手，

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!
to mislay, i.e. to be oblivious of

verses.en: won’t God search this out? For he knows the secrets of the heart.
verses.zh: 神岂不鉴察这事吗？因为他晓得人心里的隐秘。

verses.en: Yes, for your sake we are killed all day long. We are regarded as sheep for the slaughter.
verses.zh: 我们为你的缘故终日被杀；人看我们如将宰的羊。

verses.en: Wake up! Why do you sleep, Lord? Arise! Don’t reject us forever.
verses.zh: 主啊，求你睡醒，为何尽睡呢？求你兴起，不要永远丢弃我们！

words.g: to + a goal, i.e. the bright object at adistance travelled towards

verses.en: Why do you hide your face, and forget our affliction and our oppression?
verses.zh: 你为何掩面，不顾我们所遭的苦难和所受的欺压？

words.g: to mislay, i.e. to be oblivious of

verses.en: For our soul is bowed down to the dust. Our body clings to the earth.
verses.zh: 我们的性命伏于尘土；我们的肚腹紧贴地面。

words.g: to impinge, i.e. cling or adhere

verses.en: Rise up to help us. Redeem us for your loving kindness’ sake.
verses.zh: 求你起来帮助我们！凭你的慈爱救赎我们！

verses.en: For the Chief Musician. Set to “The Lilies.” A contemplation by the sons of Korah. A wedding song.
verses.zh: （可拉后裔的训诲诗，又是爱慕歌，交与伶长。调用百合花。）

words.g: to + to glitter from afar, i.e. to be eminent
a lily , as aflower of architectural ornament
Korach, the name of two Edomites and three Israelites

verses.en: My heart overflows with a noble theme. I recite my verses for the king. My tongue is like the pen of a skillful writer.
verses.zh: 我心里涌出美辞；我论到我为王做的事，我的舌头是快手笔。

words.g: to score with a mark as a tally or record, i.e.  to inscribe

verses.en: You are the most excellent of the sons of men. Grace has anointed your lips, therefore God has blessed you forever.
verses.zh: 你比世人更美；在你嘴里满有恩惠；所以神赐福给你，直到永远。

verses.en: Strap your sword on your thigh, O mighty one, in your splendor and your majesty.
verses.zh: 大能者啊，愿你腰间佩刀，大有荣耀和威严！

words.g: and + magnificence, i.e. ornament or splendor + +you/your

verses.en: In your majesty ride on victoriously on behalf of truth, humility, and righteousness. Let your right hand display awesome deeds.
verses.zh: 为真理、谦卑、公义赫然坐车前往，无不得胜；你的右手必显明可畏的事。

words.g: and + magnificence, i.e. ornament or splendor + +you/your
to push forward, in various senses

verses.en: Your arrows are sharp. The nations fall under you, with arrows in the heart of the king’s enemies.
verses.zh: 你的箭锋快，射中王敌之心；万民仆倒在你以下。

verses.en: Your throne, God, is forever and ever. A scepter of equity is the scepter of your kingdom.
verses.zh: 神啊，你的宝座是永永远远的；你的国权是正直的。

words.g: a level, i.e. a plain  as a proper name of certain districts)

verses.en: You have loved righteousness, and hated wickedness. Therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.
verses.zh: 你喜爱公义，恨恶罪恶；所以神―就是你的神―用喜乐油膏你，胜过膏你的同伴。

words.g: to rub with oil, i.e. to anoint + +you/your

verses.en: All your garments smell like myrrh, aloes, and cassia. Out of ivory palaces stringed instruments have made you glad.
verses.zh: 你的衣服都有没药、沉香、肉桂的香气；象牙宫中有丝弦乐器的声音使你欢喜。

verses.en: Kings’ daughters are among your honorable women. At your right hand the queen stands in gold of Ophir.
verses.zh: 有君王的女儿在你尊贵妇女之中；王后佩戴俄斐金饰站在你右边。

words.g: in + something carved out, i.e. ore
Ophir, the name of a son of Joktan

verses.en: Listen, daughter, consider, and turn your ear. Forget your own people, and also your father’s house.
verses.zh: 女子啊，你要听，要想，要侧耳而听！不要记念你的民和你的父家，

words.g: and + to stretch or spread out
and + to mislay, i.e. to be oblivious of
father, in a literal and immediate + +you/your

verses.en: So the king will desire your beauty, honor him, for he is your lord.
verses.zh: 王就羡慕你的美貌；因为他是你的主，你当敬拜他。

verses.en: The daughter of Tyre comes with a gift. The rich among the people entreat your favor.
verses.zh: 泰尔的民（原文是女子）必来送礼；民中的富足人也必向你求恩。

verses.en: The princess inside is all glorious. Her clothing is interwoven with gold.
verses.zh: 王女在宫里极其荣华；她的衣服是用金线绣的。

verses.en: She shall be led to the king in embroidered work. The virgins, her companions who follow her, shall be brought to you.
verses.zh: 她要穿锦绣的衣服，被引到王前；随从她的陪伴童女也要被带到你面前。

verses.en: With gladness and rejoicing they shall be led. They shall enter into the king’s palace.
verses.zh: 她们要欢喜快乐被引导；她们要进入王宫。

verses.en: Your sons will take the place of your fathers. You shall make them princes in all the earth.
verses.zh: 你的子孙要接续你的列祖；你要立他们在全地作王。

words.g: father, in a literal and immediate + +you/your

verses.en: I will make your name to be remembered in all generations. Therefore the peoples shall give you thanks forever and ever.
verses.zh: 我必叫你的名被万代记念，所以万民要永永远远称谢你。

verses.en: For the Chief Musician. By the sons of Korah. According to Alamoth.46:0 Alamoth is a musical term.
verses.zh: （可拉后裔的诗歌，交与伶长。调用女音。）

words.g: to + to glitter from afar, i.e. to be eminent
Korach, the name of two Edomites and three Israelites
girls, i.e. the soprano or female voice

verses.en: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
verses.zh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

verses.en: Therefore we won’t be afraid, though the earth changes, though the mountains are shaken into the heart of the seas;
verses.zh: 所以，地虽改变，山虽摇动到海心，

verses.en: though its waters roar and are troubled, though the mountains tremble with their swelling. Selah.
verses.zh: 其中的水虽匉訇翻腾，山虽因海涨而战抖，我们也不害怕。（细拉）

verses.en: There is a river, the streams of which make the city of God glad, the holy place of the tents of the Most High.
verses.zh: 有一道河，这河的分汊使神的城欢喜；这城就是至高者居住的圣所。

verses.en: God is within her. She shall not be moved. God will help her at dawn.
verses.zh: 神在其中，城必不动摇；到天一亮，神必帮助这城。

words.g: in + the nearest part, i.e. the center + +her/its
to surround, i.e. protect or aid + +her/its

verses.en: The nations raged. The kingdoms were moved. He lifted his voice and the earth melted.
verses.zh: 外邦喧嚷，列国动摇；神发声，地便熔化。

words.g: dominion, i.e.  the estate  or  the country

verses.en: The LORD of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.
verses.zh: 万军之耶和华与我们同在；雅各的神是我们的避难所！（细拉）

words.g: a mass of persons , especially reg. organized forwar

verses.en: Come, see the LORD’s works, what desolations he has made on the earth.
verses.zh: 你们来看耶和华的作为，看他使地怎样荒凉。

verses.en: He makes wars cease to the end of the earth. He breaks the bow, and shatters the spear. He burns the chariots in the fire.
verses.zh: 他止息刀兵，直到地极；他折弓、断枪，把战车焚烧在火中。

words.g: to repose, i.e. desist from exertion
a bow, forshooting  or the iris
something revolving, i.e. a wheeled vehicle

verses.en: “Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted on the earth.”
verses.zh: 你们要休息，要知道我是神！我必在外邦中被尊崇，在遍地上也被尊崇。

words.g: to be high actively, to rise or raise
to be high actively, to rise or raise

verses.en: The LORD of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.
verses.zh: 万军之耶和华与我们同在；雅各的神是我们的避难所！

words.g: a mass of persons , especially reg. organized forwar

verses.zh: （可拉后裔的诗，交与伶长。）

words.g: to + to glitter from afar, i.e. to be eminent
Korach, the name of two Edomites and three Israelites

verses.en: Oh clap your hands, all you nations. Shout to God with the voice of triumph!
verses.zh: 万民哪，你们都要拍掌！要用夸胜的声音向神呼喊！

verses.en: For the LORD Most High is awesome. He is a great King over all the earth.
verses.zh: 因为耶和华至高者是可畏的；他是治理全地的大君王。

verses.en: He subdues nations under us, and peoples under our feet.
verses.zh: 他叫万民服在我们以下，又叫列邦服在我们脚下。

verses.en: He chooses our inheritance for us, the glory of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.
verses.zh: 他为我们选择产业，就是他所爱之雅各的荣耀。（细拉）

verses.en: God has gone up with a shout, the LORD with the sound of a trumpet.
verses.zh: 神上升，有喊声相送；耶和华上升，有角声相送。

words.g: in + clamor, i.e. acclamation of joy or a battle-cry

verses.en: Sing praises to God! Sing praises! Sing praises to our King! Sing praises!
verses.zh: 你们要向神歌颂，歌颂！向我们王歌颂，歌颂！

verses.en: For God is the King of all the earth. Sing praises with understanding.
verses.zh: 因为神是全地的王；你们要用悟性歌颂。

words.g: to be  circumspect and hence, intelligent

verses.en: God reigns over the nations. God sits on his holy throne.
verses.zh: 神作王治理万国；神坐在他的圣宝座上。

verses.en: The princes of the peoples are gathered together, the people of the God of Abraham. For the shields of the earth belong to God. He is greatly exalted!
verses.zh: 列邦的君王聚集要作亚伯拉罕之神的民。因为世界的盾牌是属神的；他为至高！

words.g: Abraham, the later name of Abram

verses.en: A Song. A Psalm by the sons of Korah.
verses.zh: （可拉后裔的诗歌。）

words.g: Korach, the name of two Edomites and three Israelites

verses.en: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised, in the city of our God, in his holy mountain.
verses.zh: 耶和华本为大！在我们神的城中，在他的圣山上，该受大赞美。

verses.en: Beautiful in elevation, the joy of the whole earth, is Mount Zion, on the north sides, the city of the great King.
verses.zh: 锡安山―大君王的城，在北面居高华美，为全地所喜悦。

verses.en: God has shown himself in her citadels as a refuge.
verses.zh: 神在其宫中，自显为避难所。

verses.en: For, behold, the kings assembled themselves, they passed by together.
verses.zh: 看哪，众王会合，一同经过。

verses.en: They saw it, then they were amazed. They were dismayed. They hurried away.
verses.zh: 他们见了这城就惊奇丧胆，急忙逃跑。

words.g: to tremble inwardly , i.e.  be   alarmed or agitated
to start up suddenly, i.e.  to hasten away

verses.en: Trembling took hold of them there, pain, as of a woman in travail.
verses.zh: 他们在那里被战兢疼痛抓住，好像产难的妇人一样。

verses.en: With the east wind, you break the ships of Tarshish.
verses.zh: 神啊，你用东风打破他施的船只。

verses.en: As we have heard, so we have seen, in the city of the LORD of Armies, in the city of our God. God will establish it forever. Selah.
verses.zh: 我们在万军之耶和华的城中―就是我们神的城中―所看见的，正如我们所听见的。神必坚立这城，直到永远。（细拉）

verses.en: We have thought about your loving kindness, God, in the middle of your temple.
verses.zh: 神啊，我们在你的殿中想念你的慈爱。

words.g: in + the nearest part, i.e. the center

verses.en: As is your name, God, so is your praise to the ends of the earth. Your right hand is full of righteousness.
verses.zh: 神啊，你受的赞美正与你的名相称，直到地极！你的右手满了公义。

verses.en: Let Mount Zion be glad! Let the daughters of Judah rejoice because of your judgments.
verses.zh: 因你的判断，锡安山应当欢喜，犹大的城邑（原文是女子）应当快乐。

words.g: to spin round , i.e. usually rejoice
Jehudah , the name of five Israelites

verses.en: Walk about Zion, and go around her. Number its towers.
verses.zh: 你们当周游锡安，四围旋绕，数点城楼，

verses.en: Notice her bulwarks. Consider her palaces, that you may tell it to the next generation.

verses.zh: 愿神怜悯我们，赐福与我们，用脸光照我们，（细拉）

verses.en: That your way may be known on earth, and your salvation among all nations,
verses.zh: 好叫世界得知你的道路，万国得知你的救恩。

verses.en: let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you.
verses.zh: 神啊，愿列邦称赞你！愿万民都称赞你！

verses.en: Oh let the nations be glad and sing for joy, for you will judge the peoples with equity, and govern the nations on earth. Selah.
verses.zh: 愿万国都快乐欢呼；因为你必按公正审判万民，引导世上的万国。（细拉）

words.g: and + to creak , i.e. to shout
a level, i.e. a plain  as a proper name of certain districts)

verses.en: Let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you.
verses.zh: 神啊，愿列邦称赞你！愿万民都称赞你！

verses.en: The earth has yielded its increase. God, even our own God, will bless us.
verses.zh: 地已经出了土产；神―就是我们的神要赐福与我们。

words.g: produce, i.e. a crop or  wealth + +her/its

verses.en: God will bless us. All the ends of the earth shall fear him.
verses.zh: 神要赐福与我们；地的四极都要敬畏他！

verses.en: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. A song.
verses.zh: （大卫的诗歌，交与伶长。）

words.g: to + to glitter from afar, i.e. to be eminent

verses.en: Let God arise! Let his enemies be scattered! Let them who hate him also flee before him.
verses.zh: 愿神兴起，使他的仇敌四散，叫那恨他的人从他面前逃跑。

words.g: to dash in pieces, literally or figuratively
and + to flit, i.e. vanish away

verses.en: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away. As wax melts before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God.
verses.zh: 他们被驱逐，如烟被风吹散；恶人见神之面而消灭，如蜡被火熔化。

verses.en: But let the righteous be glad. Let them rejoice before God. Yes, let them rejoice with gladness.
verses.zh: 惟有义人必然欢喜，在神面前高兴快乐。

words.g: to jump for joy, i.e. exult
and + to be bright, i.e. cheerful

verses.en: Sing to God! Sing praises to his name! Extol him who rides on the clouds: to the LORD, his name! Rejoice before him!
verses.zh: 你们当向神唱诗，歌颂他的名；为那坐车行过旷野的修平大路。他的名是耶和华，要在他面前欢乐！

words.g: and + to jump for joy, i.e. exult

verses.en: A father of the fatherless, and a defender of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.
verses.zh: 神在他的圣所作孤儿的父，作寡妇的伸冤者。

words.g: father, in a literal and immediate

verses.en: God sets the lonely in families. He brings out the prisoners with singing, but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land.
verses.zh: 神叫孤独的有家，使被囚的出来享福；惟有悖逆的住在干燥之地。

words.g: to turn away, i.e.  be refractory
a parched region, i.e. the desert

verses.en: God, when you went out before your people, when you marched through the wilderness... Selah.
verses.zh: 神啊，你曾在你百姓前头出来，在旷野行走。（细拉）

words.g: in + to pace, i.e. step regularly + +you/your

verses.en: The earth trembled. The sky also poured down rain at the presence of the God of Sinai— at the presence of God, the God of Israel.
verses.zh: 那时，地见神的面而震动，天也落雨；西奈山见以色列神的面也震动。

verses.en: You, God, sent a plentiful rain. You confirmed your inheritance when it was weary.
verses.zh: 神啊，你降下大雨；你产业以色列疲乏的时候，你使他坚固。

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: Your congregation lived therein. You, God, prepared your goodness for the poor.
verses.zh: 你的会众住在其中；神啊，你的恩惠是为困苦人预备的。

words.g: to + depressed, in mind or circumstances

verses.en: The Lord announced the word. The ones who proclaim it are a great company.
verses.zh: 主发命令，传好信息的妇女成了大群。

words.g: the + to be fresh, i.e. full  cheerful)
a mass of persons , especially reg. organized forwar

verses.en: “Kings of armies flee! They flee!” She who waits at home divides the plunder,
verses.zh: 统兵的君王逃跑了，逃跑了；在家等候的妇女分受所夺的。

words.g: a mass of persons , especially reg. organized forwar

verses.en: while you sleep among the camp fires, the wings of a dove sheathed with silver, her feathers with shining gold.
verses.zh: 你们安卧在羊圈的时候，好像鸽子的翅膀镀白银，翎毛镀黄金一般。

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: When the Almighty scattered kings in her, it snowed on Zalmon.
verses.zh: 全能者在境内赶散列王的时候，势如飘雪在撒们。

words.g: in + Tsalmon, the name of a place in Palestine and of an Israelite

verses.en: The mountains of Bashan are majestic mountains. The mountains of Bashan are rugged.
verses.zh: 巴珊山是神的山；巴珊山是多峰多岭的山。

words.g: Bashan , a region East of the Jordan
a hump or peak of hills
Bashan , a region East of the Jordan

verses.en: Why do you look in envy, you rugged mountains, at the mountain where God chooses to reign? Yes, the LORD will dwell there forever.
verses.zh: 你们多峰多岭的山哪，为何斜看神所愿居住的山？耶和华必住这山，直到永远！

words.g: probably to look askant, i.e.  be jealous
a hump or peak of hills
to + a goal, i.e. the bright object at adistance travelled towards

verses.en: The chariots of God are tens of thousands and thousands of thousands. The Lord is among them, from Sinai, into the sanctuary.
verses.zh: 神的车辇累万盈千；主在其中，好像在西奈圣山一样。

verses.en: You have ascended on high. You have led away captives. You have received gifts among people, yes, among the rebellious also, that the LORD God might dwell there.
verses.zh: 你已经升上高天，掳掠仇敌；你在人间，就是在悖逆的人间，受了供献，叫耶和华神可以与他们同住。

words.g: to turn away, i.e.  be refractory
to + to reside or permanently stay

verses.en: Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burdens, even the God who is our salvation. Selah.
verses.zh: 天天背负我们重担的主，就是拯救我们的神，是应当称颂的！（细拉）

verses.en: God is to us a God of deliverance. To GOD, the Lord, belongs escape from death.
verses.zh: 神是为我们施行诸般救恩的神；人能脱离死亡是在乎主耶和华。

verses.en: But God will strike through the head of his enemies, the hairy scalp of such a one as still continues in his guiltiness.
verses.zh: 但神要打破他仇敌的头，就是那常犯罪之人的发顶。

verses.en: The Lord said, “I will bring you again from Bashan, I will bring you again from the depths of the sea,
verses.zh: 主说：我要使众民从巴珊而归，使他们从深海而回，

words.g: from + Bashan , a region East of the Jordan

verses.en: that you may crush them, dipping your foot in blood, that the tongues of your dogs may have their portion from your enemies.”
verses.zh: 使你打碎仇敌，你的脚踹在血中，使你狗的舌头从其中得分。

verses.en: They have seen your processions, God, even the processions of my God, my King, into the sanctuary.
verses.zh: 神啊，你是我的神，我的王；人已经看见你行走，进入圣所。

verses.en: The singers went before, the minstrels followed after, among the ladies playing with tambourines,
verses.zh: 歌唱的行在前，作乐的随在后，都在击鼓的童女中间。

words.g: to thrum, i.e. beat atune with the fingers
to drum, i.e. play  on the tambourine

verses.en: “Bless God in the congregations, even the Lord in the assembly of Israel!”
verses.zh: 从以色列源头而来的，当在各会中称颂主神！

words.g: from + something dug, i.e. a  source

verses.en: There is little Benjamin, their ruler, the princes of Judah, their council, the princes of Zebulun, and the princes of Naphtali.
verses.zh: 在那里，有统管他们的小便雅悯，有犹大的首领和他们的群众，有西布伦的首领，有拿弗他利的首领。

words.g: Jehudah , the name of five Israelites

verses.en: Your God has commanded your strength. Strengthen, God, that which you have done for us.
verses.zh: 以色列的能力是神所赐的；神啊，求你坚固你为我们所成全的事！

words.g: to do or make , especially to practise

verses.en: Because of your temple at Jerusalem, kings will bring presents to you.
verses.zh: 因你耶路撒冷的殿，列王必带贡物献给你。

words.g: Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine

verses.en: Rebuke the wild animal of the reeds, the multitude of the bulls with the calves of the peoples. Trample under foot the bars of silver. Scatter the nations who delight in war.
verses.zh: 求你叱喝芦苇中的野兽和群公牛，并列邦中的牛犊。把银块踹在脚下；神已经赶散好争战的列邦。

words.g: in + a  calf , especially one nearly grown

verses.en: Princes shall come out of Egypt. Ethiopia shall hurry to stretch out her hands to God.
verses.zh: 埃及的公侯要出来朝见神；古实人要急忙举手祷告。

words.g: Mitsrajim, i.e. Upper and Lower Egypt
Cush , the name of a son of Ham

verses.en: Sing to God, you kingdoms of the earth! Sing praises to the Lord—Selah—
verses.zh: 世上的列国啊，你们要向神歌唱；愿你们歌颂主！

words.g: dominion, i.e.  the estate  or  the country

verses.en: to him who rides on the heaven of heavens, which are of old; behold, he utters his voice, a mighty voice.
verses.zh: 歌颂那自古驾行在诸天以上的主！他发出声音，是极大的声音。

verses.en: Ascribe strength to God! His excellency is over Israel, his strength is in the skies.
verses.zh: 你们要将能力归给神。他的威荣在以色列之上；他的能力是在穹苍。

verses.en: You are awesome, God, in your sanctuaries. The God of Israel gives strength and power to his people. Praise be to God!
verses.zh: 神啊，你从圣所显为可畏；以色列的神是那将力量权能赐给他百姓的。神是应当称颂的！

words.g: from + a consecrated thing or place, especially + +you/your

verses.en: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Lilies.” By David.
verses.zh: （大卫的诗，交与伶长。调用百合花。）

words.g: to + to glitter from afar, i.e. to be eminent
a lily , as aflower of architectural ornament

verses.en: Save me, God, for the waters have come up to my neck!
verses.zh: 神啊，求你救我！因为众水要淹没我。

words.g: to be open, wide or free + +me/my

verses.en: I sink in deep mire, where there is no foothold. I have come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.
verses.zh: 我陷在深淤泥中，没有立脚之地；我到了深水中，大水漫过我身。

verses.en: I am weary with my crying. My throat is dry. My eyes fail looking for my God.
verses.zh: 我因呼求困乏，喉咙发干；我因等候神，眼睛失明。

words.g: to glow, i.e. literally  or figuratively
to end, whether intransitive  or transitived

verses.en: Those who hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head. Those who want to cut me off, being my enemies wrongfully, are mighty. I have to restore what I didn’t take away.
verses.zh: 无故恨我的，比我头发还多；无理与我为仇、要把我剪除的，甚为强盛。我没有抢夺的，要叫我偿还。

verses.en: God, you know my foolishness. My sins aren’t hidden from you.
verses.zh: 神啊，我的愚昧，你原知道；我的罪愆不能隐瞒。

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you
to secrete, by act or word

verses.en: Don’t let those who wait for you be shamed through me, Lord GOD of Armies. Don’t let those who seek you be brought to dishonor through me, God of Israel.
verses.zh: 万军的主―耶和华啊，求你叫那等候你的，不要因我蒙羞！以色列的神啊，求你叫那寻求你的，不要因我受辱！

words.g: to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed
a mass of persons , especially reg. organized forwar

verses.en: Because for your sake, I have borne reproach. Shame has covered my face.
verses.zh: 因我为你的缘故受了辱骂，满面羞愧。

verses.en: I have become a stranger to my brothers, an alien to my mother’s children.
verses.zh: 我的弟兄看我为外路人；我的同胞看我为外邦人。

words.g: and + strange, in a variety of degrees and applications

verses.en: For the zeal of your house consumes me. The reproaches of those who reproach you have fallen on me.
verses.zh: 因我为你的殿心里焦急，如同火烧，并且辱骂你人的辱骂都落在我身上。

words.g: to pull off, i.e.  to expose + +you/your

verses.en: When I wept and I fasted, that was to my reproach.
verses.zh: 我哭泣，以禁食刻苦我心；这倒算为我的羞辱。

verses.en: When I made sackcloth my clothing, I became a byword to them.
verses.zh: 我拿麻布当衣裳，就成了他们的笑谈。

words.g: to + a pithy maxim, usually of metaphorical nature

verses.en: Those who sit in the gate talk about me. I am the song of the drunkards.
verses.zh: 坐在城门口的谈论我；酒徒也以我为歌曲。

words.g: to ponder, i.e.  converse  or  utter
an intoxicant, i.e. intensely alcoholic liquor

verses.en: But as for me, my prayer is to you, LORD, in an acceptable time. God, in the abundance of your loving kindness, answer me in the truth of your salvation.
verses.zh: 但我在悦纳的时候向你―耶和华祈祷。神啊，求你按你丰盛的慈爱，凭你拯救的诚实应允我！

verses.en: Deliver me out of the mire, and don’t let me sink. Let me be delivered from those who hate me, and out of the deep waters.
verses.zh: 求你搭救我出离淤泥，不叫我陷在其中；求你使我脱离那些恨我的人，使我出离深水。

verses.en: Don’t let the flood waters overwhelm me, neither let the deep swallow me up. Don’t let the pit shut its mouth on me.
verses.zh: 求你不容大水漫过我，不容深渊吞灭我，不容坑坎在我以上合口。

words.g: the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +her/its

verses.en: Answer me, LORD, for your loving kindness is good. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, turn to me.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，求你应允我！因为你的慈爱本为美好；求你按你丰盛的慈悲回转眷顾我！

verses.en: Don’t hide your face from your servant, for I am in distress. Answer me speedily!
verses.zh: 不要掩面不顾你的仆人；我是在急难之中，求你速速地应允我！

verses.en: Draw near to my soul and redeem it. Ransom me because of my enemies.
verses.zh: 求你亲近我，救赎我！求你因我的仇敌把我赎回！

words.g: to be the next of kin + +her/its

verses.en: You know my reproach, my shame, and my dishonor. My adversaries are all before you.
verses.zh: 你知道我受的辱骂、欺凌、羞辱；我的敌人都在你面前。

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: Reproach has broken my heart, and I am full of heaviness. I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; for comforters, but I found none.
verses.zh: 辱骂伤破了我的心，我又满了忧愁。我指望有人体恤，却没有一个；我指望有人安慰，却找不着一个。

words.g: and + to be sick, i.e.  distressed
and + to bind together , i.e. collect

verses.en: They also gave me poison for my food. In my thirst, they gave me vinegar to drink.
verses.zh: 他们拿苦胆给我当食物；我渴了，他们拿醋给我喝。

words.g: a poisonous plant, probably the poppy
to quaff, i.e.  to irrigate or furnish apotion to + +me/my

verses.en: Let their table before them become a snare. May it become a retribution and a trap.
verses.zh: 愿他们的筵席在他们面前变为网罗，在他们平安的时候变为机槛。

verses.en: Let their eyes be darkened, so that they can’t see. Let their backs be continually bent.
verses.zh: 愿他们的眼睛昏蒙，不得看见；愿你使他们的腰常常战抖。

words.g: and + the waist or small of the back + +them/their

verses.en: Pour out your indignation on them. Let the fierceness of your anger overtake them.
verses.zh: 求你将你的恼恨倒在他们身上，叫你的烈怒追上他们。

words.g: strictly froth at the mouth, i.e.  fury + +you/your

verses.en: Let their habitation be desolate. Let no one dwell in their tents.
verses.zh: 愿他们的住处变为荒场；愿他们的帐棚无人居住。

words.g: to stun , i.e. devastate or  stupefy

verses.en: For they persecute him whom you have wounded. They tell of the sorrow of those whom you have hurt.
verses.zh: 因为，你所击打的，他们就逼迫；你所击伤的，他们戏说他的愁苦。

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you
to score with a mark as a tally or record, i.e.  to inscribe

verses.en: Charge them with crime upon crime. Don’t let them come into your righteousness.
verses.zh: 愿你在他们的罪上加罪，不容他们在你面前称义。

verses.en: Let them be blotted out of the book of life, and not be written with the righteous.
verses.zh: 愿他们从生命册上被涂抹，不得记录在义人之中。

verses.en: But I am in pain and distress. Let your salvation, God, protect me.
verses.zh: 但我是困苦忧伤的；神啊，愿你的救恩将我安置在高处。

verses.en: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.
verses.zh: 我要以诗歌赞美神的名，以感谢称他为大！

verses.en: It will please the LORD better than an ox, or a bull that has horns and hoofs.
verses.zh: 这便叫耶和华喜悦，胜似献牛，或是献有角有蹄的公牛。

words.g: to break in pieces, i.e.  to split

verses.en: The humble have seen it, and are glad. You who seek after God, let your heart live.
verses.zh: 谦卑的人看见了就喜乐；寻求神的人，愿你们的心苏醒。

words.g: and + to live, whether literally or figuratively

verses.en: For the LORD hears the needy, and doesn’t despise his captive people.
verses.zh: 因为耶和华听了穷乏人，不藐视被囚的人。

verses.en: Let heaven and earth praise him; the seas, and everything that moves therein!
verses.zh: 愿天和地、洋海和其中一切的动物都赞美他！

verses.en: For God will save Zion, and build the cities of Judah. They shall settle there, and own it.
verses.zh: 因为神要拯救锡安，建造犹大的城邑；他的民要在那里居住，得以为业。

words.g: to be open, wide or free
Jehudah , the name of five Israelites

verses.en: The children also of his servants shall inherit it. Those who love his name shall dwell therein.
verses.zh: 他仆人的后裔要承受为业；爱他名的人也要住在其中。

words.g: to inherit  mode of descent), or  to occupy + +her/its

verses.en: For the Chief Musician. By David. A reminder.
verses.zh: （大卫的记念诗，交与伶长。）

words.g: to + to glitter from afar, i.e. to be eminent

verses.en: Hurry, God, to deliver me. Come quickly to help me, LORD.
verses.zh: 神啊，求你快快搭救我！耶和华啊，求你速速帮助我！

verses.en: Let them be disappointed and confounded who seek my soul. Let those who desire my ruin be turned back in disgrace.
verses.zh: 愿那些寻索我命的，抱愧蒙羞；愿那些喜悦我遭害的，退后受辱。

words.g: to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed
to flinch, i.e.  to go back

verses.en: Let them be turned because of their shame who say, “Aha! Aha!”
verses.zh: 愿那些对我说阿哈、阿哈的，因羞愧退后。

words.g: a heel, i.e.  the last of anything

verses.en: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let those who love your salvation continually say, “Let God be exalted!”
verses.zh: 愿一切寻求你的，因你高兴欢喜；愿那些喜爱你救恩的，常说：当尊神为大！

verses.en: But I am poor and needy. Come to me quickly, God. You are my help and my deliverer. LORD, don’t delay.
verses.zh: 但我是困苦穷乏的；神啊，求你速速到我这里来！你是帮助我的，搭救我的。耶和华啊，求你不要耽延！

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: In you, LORD, I take refuge. Never let me be disappointed.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，我投靠你；求你叫我永不羞愧！

words.g: to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed

verses.en: Deliver me in your righteousness, and rescue me. Turn your ear to me, and save me.
verses.zh: 求你凭你的公义搭救我，救拔我；侧耳听我，拯救我！

words.g: and + to be open, wide or free + +me/my

verses.en: Be to me a rock of refuge to which I may always go. Give the command to save me, for you are my rock and my fortress.
verses.zh: 求你作我常住的磐石；你已经命定要救我，因为你是我的岩石，我的山寨。

words.g: to + to be open, wide or free + +me/my
a craggy rock, literally or figuratively + +me/my
thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: Rescue me, my God, from the hand of the wicked, from the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.
verses.zh: 我的神啊，求你救我脱离恶人的手，脱离不义和残暴之人的手。

verses.en: For you are my hope, Lord GOD, my confidence from my youth.
verses.zh: 主―耶和华啊，你是我所盼望的；从我年幼，你是我所倚靠的。

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you
from + youth, the state  or the persons + +me/my

verses.en: I have relied on you from the womb. You are he who took me out of my mother’s womb. I will always praise you.
verses.zh: 我从出母胎被你扶持；使我出母腹的是你。我必常常赞美你！

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you
to cut off, i.e. portion out + +me/my

verses.en: I am a marvel to many, but you are my strong refuge.
verses.zh: 许多人以我为怪，但你是我坚固的避难所。

words.g: and + thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: My mouth shall be filled with your praise, with your honor all day long.
verses.zh: 你的赞美，你的荣耀终日必满了我的口。

words.g: the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +me/my

verses.en: Don’t reject me in my old age. Don’t forsake me when my strength fails.
verses.zh: 我年老的时候，求你不要丢弃我！我力气衰弱的时候，求你不要离弃我！

words.g: like + to end, whether intransitive  or transitived

verses.en: For my enemies talk about me. Those who watch for my soul conspire together,
verses.zh: 我的仇敌议论我；那些窥探要害我命的彼此商议，

verses.en: saying, “God has forsaken him. Pursue and take him, for no one will rescue him.”
verses.zh: 说：神已经离弃他；我们追赶他，捉拿他吧！因为没有人搭救。

verses.en: God, don’t be far from me. My God, hurry to help me.
verses.zh: 神啊，求你不要远离我！我的神啊，求你速速帮助我！

words.g: to widen , i.e.  recede or  remove

verses.en: Let my accusers be disappointed and consumed. Let them be covered with disgrace and scorn who want to harm me.
verses.zh: 愿那与我性命为敌的，羞愧被灭；愿那谋害我的，受辱蒙羞。

words.g: to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed
to end, whether intransitive  or transitived

verses.en: But I will always hope, and will add to all of your praise.
verses.zh: 我却要常常盼望，并要越发赞美你。

verses.en: My mouth will tell about your righteousness, and of your salvation all day, though I don’t know its full measure.
verses.zh: 我的口终日要述说你的公义和你的救恩，因我不计其数。

words.g: the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +me/my

verses.en: I will come with the mighty acts of the Lord GOD. I will make mention of your righteousness, even of yours alone.
verses.zh: 我要来说主―耶和华大能的事；我单要提说你的公义。

verses.en: God, you have taught me from my youth. Until now, I have declared your wondrous works.
verses.zh: 神啊，自我年幼时，你就教训我；直到如今，我传扬你奇妙的作为。

words.g: from + youth, the state  or the persons + +me/my

verses.en: Yes, even when I am old and gray-haired, God, don’t forsake me, until I have declared your strength to the next generation, your might to everyone who is to come.
verses.zh: 神啊，我到年老发白的时候，求你不要离弃我！等我将你的能力指示下代，将你的大能指示后世的人。

verses.en: God, your righteousness also reaches to the heavens. You have done great things. God, who is like you?
verses.zh: 神啊，你的公义甚高；行过大事的神啊，谁能像你！

words.g: a form of the prefix 'k-', but used separately  as + +you/your

verses.en: You, who have shown us many and bitter troubles, you will let me live. You will bring us up again from the depths of the earth.
verses.zh: 你是叫我们多经历重大急难的，必使我们复活，从地的深处救上来。

words.g: to live, whether literally or figuratively + +me/my

verses.en: Increase my honor and comfort me again.
verses.zh: 求你使我越发昌大，又转来安慰我。

verses.en: I will also praise you with the harp for your faithfulness, my God. I sing praises to you with the lyre, Holy One of Israel.
verses.zh: 我的神啊，我要鼓瑟称赞你，称赞你的诚实！以色列的圣者啊，我要弹琴歌颂你！

verses.en: My lips shall shout for joy! My soul, which you have redeemed, sings praises to you!
verses.zh: 我歌颂你的时候，我的嘴唇和你所赎我的灵魂都必欢呼；

verses.en: My tongue will also talk about your righteousness all day long, for they are disappointed, and they are confounded, who want to harm me.
verses.zh: 并且我的舌头必终日讲论你的公义，因为那些谋害我的人已经蒙羞受辱了。

words.g: to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed

verses.en: By Solomon. God, give the king your justice; your righteousness to the royal son.
verses.zh: （所罗门的诗。）神啊，求你将判断的权柄赐给王，将公义赐给王的儿子。

verses.en: He will judge your people with righteousness, and your poor with justice.
verses.zh: 他要按公义审判你的民，按公平审判你的困苦人。

words.g: a straight course, i.e. sail direct

verses.en: The mountains shall bring prosperity to the people. The hills bring the fruit of righteousness.
verses.zh: 大山小山都要因公义使民得享平安。

verses.en: He will judge the poor of the people. He will save the children of the needy, and will break the oppressor in pieces.
verses.zh: 他必为民中的困苦人伸冤，拯救穷乏之辈，压碎那欺压人的。

words.g: to be open, wide or free

verses.zh: 太阳还存，月亮还在，人要敬畏你，直到万代！

verses.en: He will come down like rain on the mown grass, as showers that water the earth.
verses.zh: 他必降临，像雨降在已割的草地上，如甘霖滋润田地。

verses.en: In his days, the righteous shall flourish, and abundance of peace, until the moon is no more.
verses.zh: 在他的日子，义人要发旺，大有平安，好像月亮长存。

words.g: to break forth as a bud, i.e. bloom

verses.en: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, from the River to the ends of the earth.
verses.zh: 他要执掌权柄，从这海直到那海，从大河直到地极。

words.g: and + to tread down, i.e. subjugate

verses.en: Those who dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him. His enemies shall lick the dust.
verses.zh: 住在旷野的，必在他面前下拜；他的仇敌必要舔土。

words.g: a desert-dweller, i.e. nomad or wild beast

verses.en: The kings of Tarshish and of the islands will bring tribute. The kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.
verses.zh: 他施和海岛的王要进贡；示巴和西巴的王要献礼物。

words.g: Sheba, the name of three early progenitors of tribes and of an Ethiopian district

verses.zh: 诸王都要叩拜他；万国都要事奉他。

verses.zh: 因为，穷乏人呼求的时候，他要搭救；没有人帮助的困苦人，他也要搭救。

words.g: and + depressed, in mind or circumstances

verses.zh: 他要怜恤贫寒和穷乏的人，拯救穷苦人的性命。

verses.zh: 他要救赎他们脱离欺压和强暴；他们的血在他眼中看为宝贵。

words.g: to be the next of kin

verses.en: He will live; and Sheba’s gold will be given to him. Men will pray for him continually. They will bless him all day long.
verses.zh: 他们要存活。示巴的金子要奉给他；人要常常为他祷告，终日称颂他。

words.g: and + to live, whether literally or figuratively

verses.zh: 在地的山顶上，五谷必然茂盛（或译：有一把五谷）；所结的谷实要响动，如黎巴嫩的树林；城里的人要发旺，如地上的草。

words.g: like + Lebanon, a mountain range in Palestine

verses.en: His name endures forever. His name continues as long as the sun. Men shall be blessed by him. All nations will call him blessed.
verses.zh: 他的名要存到永远，要留传如日之久。人要因他蒙福；万国要称他有福。

verses.zh: 独行奇事的耶和华―以色列的神是应当称颂的！

verses.en: Blessed be his glorious name forever! Let the whole earth be filled with his glory! Amen and amen.
verses.zh: 他荣耀的名也当称颂，直到永远。愿他的荣耀充满全地！阿们！阿们！

words.g: weight, but only figuratively in a good sense + +him/his/it
weight, but only figuratively in a good sense + +him/his/it

verses.en: This ends the prayers by David, the son of Jesse.
verses.zh: 耶西的儿子―大卫的祈祷完毕。

words.g: to end, whether intransitive  or transitived

verses.zh: （亚萨的诗。）神实在恩待以色列那些清心的人！

verses.zh: 至于我，我的脚几乎失闪；我的脚险些滑跌。

verses.zh: 我见恶人和狂傲人享平安就心怀不平。

words.g: to be  zealous, i.e.  jealous or envious

verses.en: For there are no struggles in their death, but their strength is firm.
verses.zh: 他们死的时候没有疼痛；他们的力气却也壮实。

verses.en: They are free from burdens of men, neither are they plagued like other men.
verses.zh: 他们不像别人受苦，也不像别人遭灾。

verses.en: Therefore pride is like a chain around their neck. Violence covers them like a garment.
verses.zh: 所以，骄傲如链子戴在他们的项上；强暴像衣裳遮住他们的身体。

words.g: to collar, i.e. adorn with anecklace + +them/their

verses.en: Their eyes bulge with fat. Their minds pass the limits of conceit.
verses.zh: 他们的眼睛因体胖而凸出；他们所得的，过于心里所想的。

words.g: from + fat, whether literally or figuratively

verses.en: They scoff and speak with malice. In arrogance, they threaten oppression.
verses.zh: 他们讥笑人，凭恶意说欺压人的话；他们说话自高。

verses.en: They have set their mouth in the heavens. Their tongue walks through the earth.
verses.zh: 他们的口亵渎上天；他们的舌毁谤全地。

words.g: the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +them/their

verses.en: Therefore their people return to them, and they drink up waters of abundance.
verses.zh: 所以神的民归到这里，喝尽了满杯的苦水。

verses.en: They say, “How does God know? Is there knowledge in the Most High?”
verses.zh: 他们说：神怎能晓得？至高者岂有知识呢？

verses.en: Behold, these are the wicked. Being always at ease, they increase in riches.
verses.zh: 看哪，这就是恶人；他们既是常享安逸，财宝便加增。

words.g: probably a force, whether of men

verses.en: Surely I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocence,
verses.zh: 我实在徒然洁净了我的心，徒然洗手表明无辜。

verses.en: For all day long I have been plagued, and punished every morning.
verses.zh: 因为，我终日遭灾难；每早晨受惩治。

verses.en: If I had said, “I will speak thus”, behold, I would have betrayed the generation of your children.
verses.zh: 我若说，我要这样讲，这就是以奸诈待你的众子。

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: When I tried to understand this, it was too painful for me—
verses.zh: 我思索怎能明白这事，眼看实系为难，

verses.en: until I entered God’s sanctuary, and considered their latter end.
verses.zh: 等我进了神的圣所，思想他们的结局。

words.g: a consecrated thing or place, especially
to + the last or end, hence + +them/their

verses.en: Surely you set them in slippery places. You throw them down to destruction.
verses.zh: 你实在把他们安在滑地，使他们掉在沉沦之中。

verses.en: How they are suddenly destroyed! They are completely swept away with terrors.
verses.zh: 他们转眼之间成了何等的荒凉！他们被惊恐灭尽了。

words.g: like + a wink , i.e. a very short space of time

verses.zh: 人睡醒了，怎样看梦；主啊，你醒了也必照样轻看他们的影像。

verses.en: For my soul was grieved. I was embittered in my heart.
verses.zh: 因而，我心里发酸，肺腑被刺。

verses.en: I was so senseless and ignorant. I was a brute beast before you.
verses.zh: 我这样愚昧无知，在你面前如畜类一般。

verses.en: Nevertheless, I am continually with you. You have held my right hand.
verses.zh: 然而，我常与你同在；你搀着我的右手。

verses.en: You will guide me with your counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.
verses.zh: 你要以你的训言引导我，以后必接我到荣耀里。

words.g: weight, but only figuratively in a good sense

verses.en: Whom do I have in heaven? There is no one on earth whom I desire besides you.
verses.zh: 除你以外，在天上我有谁呢？除你以外，在地上我也没有所爱慕的。

verses.en: My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
verses.zh: 我的肉体和我的心肠衰残；但神是我心里的力量，又是我的福分，直到永远。

words.g: to end, whether intransitive  or transitived

verses.en: For, behold, those who are far from you shall perish. You have destroyed all those who are unfaithful to you.
verses.zh: 远离你的，必要死亡；凡离弃你行邪淫的，你都灭绝了。

verses.en: But it is good for me to come close to God. I have made the Lord GOD my refuge, that I may tell of all your works.
verses.zh: 但我亲近神是与我有益；我以主耶和华为我的避难所，好叫我述说你一切的作为。

words.g: to + to score with a mark as a tally or record, i.e.  to inscribe

verses.en: A contemplation by Asaph. God, why have you rejected us forever? Why does your anger smolder against the sheep of your pasture?
verses.zh: （亚萨的训诲诗。）神啊，你为何永远丢弃我们呢？你为何向你草场的羊发怒，如烟冒出呢？

words.g: to + Asaph, the name of three Israelites
to + a goal, i.e. the bright object at adistance travelled towards

verses.zh: 求你记念你古时所得来的会众，就是你所赎、作你产业支派的，并记念你向来所居住的锡安山。

words.g: to be the next of kin

verses.en: Lift up your feet to the perpetual ruins, all the evil that the enemy has done in the sanctuary.
verses.zh: 求你举步去看那日久荒凉之地，仇敌在圣所中所行的一切恶事。

verses.zh: 你的敌人在你会中吼叫；他们竖了自己的旗为记号。

words.g: in + the nearest part, i.e. the center

verses.zh: 他们好像人扬起斧子，砍伐林中的树。

verses.zh: 圣所中一切雕刻的，他们现在用斧子锤子打坏了。

verses.zh: 他们用火焚烧你的圣所，亵渎你名的居所，拆毁到地。

words.g: a consecrated thing or place, especially + +you/your

verses.zh: 他们心里说：我们要尽行毁灭；他们就在遍地把神的会所都烧毁了。

verses.en: We see no miraculous signs. There is no longer any prophet, neither is there among us anyone who knows how long.
verses.zh: 我们不见我们的标帜，不再有先知；我们内中也没有人知道这灾祸要到几时呢！

verses.en: How long, God, shall the adversary reproach? Shall the enemy blaspheme your name forever?
verses.zh: 神啊，敌人辱骂要到几时呢？仇敌亵渎你的名要到永远吗？

verses.zh: 神啊，求你起来为自己伸诉！要记念愚顽人怎样终日辱骂你。
