words.g: clamor, i.e. acclamation of joy or a battle-cry

verses.en: In your name they rejoice all day. In your righteousness, they are exalted.
verses.zh: 他们因你的名终日欢乐，因你的公义得以高举。

words.g: to spin round , i.e. usually rejoice
to be high actively, to rise or raise

verses.en: For you are the glory of their strength. In your favor, our horn will be exalted.
verses.zh: 你是他们力量的荣耀；因为你喜悦我们，我们的角必被高举。

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you
to be high actively, to rise or raise

verses.en: For our shield belongs to the LORD, our king to the Holy One of Israel.
verses.zh: 我们的盾牌属耶和华；我们的王属以色列的圣者。

verses.en: Then you spoke in vision to your saints, and said, “I have given strength to the warrior. I have exalted a young man from the people.
verses.zh: 当时，你在异象中晓谕你的圣民，说：我已把救助之力加在那有能者的身上；我高举那从民中所拣选的。

words.g: in + a sight , i.e. a dream
to be high actively, to rise or raise

verses.en: I have found David, my servant. I have anointed him with my holy oil,
verses.zh: 我寻得我的仆人大卫，用我的圣膏膏他。

words.g: to rub with oil, i.e. to anoint + +him/his/it

verses.en: with whom my hand shall be established. My arm will also strengthen him.
verses.zh: 我的手必使他坚立；我的膀臂也必坚固他。

words.g: to be alert, physically  or mentally + +him/his/it

verses.en: No enemy will tax him. No wicked man will oppress him.
verses.zh: 仇敌必不勒索他；凶恶之子也不苦害他。

verses.en: I will beat down his adversaries before him, and strike those who hate him.
verses.zh: 我要在他面前打碎他的敌人，击杀那恨他的人。

words.g: and + to bruise or violently strike

verses.en: But my faithfulness and my loving kindness will be with him. In my name, his horn will be exalted.
verses.zh: 只是我的信实和我的慈爱要与他同在；因我的名，他的角必被高举。

words.g: to be high actively, to rise or raise

verses.en: I will set his hand also on the sea, and his right hand on the rivers.
verses.zh: 我要使他的左手伸到海上，右手伸到河上。

verses.en: He will call to me, ‘You are my Father, my God, and the rock of my salvation!’
verses.zh: 他要称呼我说：你是我的父，是我的神，是拯救我的磐石。

words.g: father, in a literal and immediate + +me/my
thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: I will also appoint him my firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.
verses.zh: 我也要立他为长子，为世上最高的君王。

verses.en: I will keep my loving kindness for him forever more. My covenant will stand firm with him.
verses.zh: 我要为他存留我的慈爱，直到永远；我与他立的约必要坚定。

verses.en: I will also make his offspring endure forever, and his throne as the days of heaven.
verses.zh: 我也要使他的后裔存到永远，使他的宝座如天之久。

verses.en: If his children forsake my law, and don’t walk in my ordinances;
verses.zh: 倘若他的子孙离弃我的律法，不照我的典章行，

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: if they break my statutes, and don’t keep my commandments;
verses.zh: 背弃我的律例，不遵守我的诫命，

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!
and + a command, whether human or divine + +me/my

verses.en: then I will punish their sin with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.
verses.zh: 我就要用杖责罚他们的过犯，用鞭责罚他们的罪孽。

verses.en: But I will not completely take my loving kindness from him, nor allow my faithfulness to fail.
verses.zh: 只是我必不将我的慈爱全然收回，也必不叫我的信实废弃。

verses.en: I will not break my covenant, nor alter what my lips have uttered.
verses.zh: 我必不背弃我的约，也不改变我口中所出的。

words.g: and + a going forth, i.e.  an egress

verses.en: Once I have sworn by my holiness, I will not lie to David.
verses.zh: 我一次指着自己的圣洁起誓：我决不向大卫说谎！

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: His offspring will endure forever, his throne like the sun before me.
verses.zh: 他的后裔要存到永远；他的宝座在我面前如日之恒一般，

verses.en: It will be established forever like the moon, the faithful witness in the sky.” Selah.
verses.zh: 又如月亮永远坚立，如天上确实的见证。（细拉）

verses.en: But you have rejected and spurned. You have been angry with your anointed.
verses.zh: 但你恼怒你的受膏者，就丢掉弃绝他。

words.g: and + thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: You have renounced the covenant of your servant. You have defiled his crown in the dust.
verses.zh: 你厌恶了与仆人所立的约，将他的冠冕践踏于地。

verses.en: You have broken down all his hedges. You have brought his strongholds to ruin.
verses.zh: 你拆毁了他一切的篱笆，使他的保障变为荒场。

verses.en: All who pass by the way rob him. He has become a reproach to his neighbors.
verses.zh: 凡过路的人都抢夺他；他成为邻邦的羞辱。

verses.en: You have exalted the right hand of his adversaries. You have made all of his enemies rejoice.
verses.zh: 你高举了他敌人的右手；你叫他一切的仇敌欢喜。

words.g: to be high actively, to rise or raise

verses.en: Yes, you turn back the edge of his sword, and haven’t supported him in battle.
verses.zh: 你叫他的刀剑卷刃，叫他在争战之中站立不住。

verses.en: You have ended his splendor, and thrown his throne down to the ground.
verses.zh: 你使他的光辉止息，将他的宝座推倒于地。

words.g: to repose, i.e. desist from exertion

verses.en: You have shortened the days of his youth. You have covered him with shame. Selah.
verses.zh: 你减少他青年的日子，又使他蒙羞。（细拉）

verses.en: How long, LORD? Will you hide yourself forever? Will your wrath burn like fire?
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，这要到几时呢？你要将自己隐藏到永远吗？你的忿怒如火焚烧要到几时呢？

words.g: to + a goal, i.e. the bright object at adistance travelled towards
a form of the prefix 'k-', but used separately  as

verses.en: Remember how short my time is, for what vanity you have created all the children of men!
verses.zh: 求你想念我的时候是何等的短少；你创造世人，要使他们归何等的虚空呢？

verses.en: What man is he who shall live and not see death, who shall deliver his soul from the power of Sheol? Selah.
verses.zh: 谁能常活免死、救他的灵魂脱离阴间的权柄呢？（细拉）

words.g: to live, whether literally or figuratively
to be smooth, i.e.  to escape

verses.en: Lord, where are your former loving kindnesses, which you swore to David in your faithfulness?
verses.zh: 主啊，你从前凭你的信实向大卫立誓要施行的慈爱在哪里呢？

verses.en: Remember, Lord, the reproach of your servants, how I bear in my heart the taunts of all the mighty peoples,
verses.zh: 主啊，求你记念仆人们所受的羞辱，记念我怎样将一切强盛民的羞辱存在我怀里。

verses.en: With which your enemies have mocked, LORD, with which they have mocked the footsteps of your anointed one.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，你的仇敌用这羞辱羞辱了你的仆人，羞辱了你受膏者的脚踪。

words.g: to pull off, i.e.  to expose
to pull off, i.e.  to expose

verses.en: Blessed be the LORD forever more. Amen, and Amen.
verses.zh: 耶和华是应当称颂的，直到永远。阿们！阿们！

verses.en: A Prayer by Moses, the man of God.90:0 The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “אֱלֹהִ֑ים” (Elohim). Lord, you have been our dwelling place for all generations.
verses.zh: （神人摩西的祈祷）主啊，你世世代代作我们的居所。

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: Before the mountains were born, before you had formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, you are God.
verses.zh: 诸山未曾生出，地与世界你未曾造成，从亘古到永远，你是神。

words.g: and + to twist or whirl , i.e.  to dance
thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: You turn man to destruction, saying, “Return, you children of men.”
verses.zh: 你使人归于尘土，说：你们世人要归回。

verses.en: For a thousand years in your sight are just like yesterday when it is past, like a watch in the night.
verses.zh: 在你看来，千年如已过的昨日，又如夜间的一更。

verses.en: You sweep them away as they sleep. In the morning they sprout like new grass.
verses.zh: 你叫他们如水冲去；他们如睡一觉。早晨，他们如生长的草，

words.g: to slide by, i.e.  to hasten away

verses.en: In the morning it sprouts and springs up. By evening, it is withered and dry.
verses.zh: 早晨发芽生长，晚上割下枯干。

words.g: and + to slide by, i.e.  to hasten away

verses.en: For we are consumed in your anger. We are troubled in your wrath.
verses.zh: 我们因你的怒气而消灭，因你的忿怒而惊惶。

words.g: to end, whether intransitive  or transitived
to tremble inwardly , i.e.  be   alarmed or agitated

verses.en: You have set our iniquities before you, our secret sins in the light of your presence.
verses.zh: 你将我们的罪孽摆在你面前，将我们的隐恶摆在你面光之中。

words.g: to veil from sight, i.e. conceal + +us/our

verses.en: For all our days have passed away in your wrath. We bring our years to an end as a sigh.
verses.zh: 我们经过的日子都在你震怒之下；我们度尽的年岁好像一声叹息。

words.g: to end, whether intransitive  or transitived
a form of the prefix 'k-', but used separately  as

verses.en: The days of our years are seventy, or even by reason of strength eighty years; yet their pride is but labor and sorrow, for it passes quickly, and we fly away.
verses.zh: 我们一生的年日是七十岁，若是强壮可到八十岁；但其中所矜夸的不过是劳苦愁烦，转眼成空，我们便如飞而去。

words.g: and + used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: Who knows the power of your anger, your wrath according to the fear that is due to you?
verses.zh: 谁晓得你怒气的权势？谁按着你该受的敬畏晓得你的忿怒呢？

verses.en: So teach us to count our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.
verses.zh: 求你指教我们怎样数算自己的日子，好叫我们得着智慧的心。

verses.en: Relent, LORD! How long? Have compassion on your servants!
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，我们要等到几时呢？求你转回，为你的仆人后悔。

verses.en: Satisfy us in the morning with your loving kindness, that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.
verses.zh: 求你使我们早早饱得你的慈爱，好叫我们一生一世欢呼喜乐。

words.g: and + to creak , i.e. to shout

verses.en: Make us glad for as many days as you have afflicted us, for as many years as we have seen evil.
verses.zh: 求你照着你使我们受苦的日子，和我们遭难的年岁，叫我们喜乐。

verses.en: Let your work appear to your servants, your glory to their children.
verses.zh: 愿你的作为向你仆人显现；愿你的荣耀向他们子孙显明。

words.g: and + magnificence, i.e. ornament or splendor + +you/your

verses.en: Let the favor of the Lord our God be on us. Establish the work of our hands for us. Yes, establish the work of our hands.
verses.zh: 愿主―我们神的荣美归于我们身上。愿你坚立我们手所做的工；我们手所做的工，愿你坚立。

verses.en: He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.
verses.zh: 住在至高者隐密处的，必住在全能者的荫下。

words.n: Shaddai — an ancient name of God, traditionally 'the Almighty'. What it originally meant is still argued over.

verses.en: I will say of the LORD, “He is my refuge and my fortress; my God, in whom I trust.”
verses.zh: 我要论到耶和华说：他是我的避难所，是我的山寨，是我的神，是我所倚靠的。

verses.en: For he will deliver you from the snare of the fowler, and from the deadly pestilence.
verses.zh: 他必救你脱离捕鸟人的网罗和毒害的瘟疫。

verses.en: He will cover you with his feathers. Under his wings you will take refuge. His faithfulness is your shield and rampart.
verses.zh: 他必用自己的翎毛遮蔽你；你要投靠在他的翅膀底下；他的诚实是大小的盾牌。

verses.en: You shall not be afraid of the terror by night, nor of the arrow that flies by day,
verses.zh: 你必不怕黑夜的惊骇，或是白日飞的箭，

verses.en: nor of the pestilence that walks in darkness, nor of the destruction that wastes at noonday.
verses.zh: 也不怕黑夜行的瘟疫，或是午间灭人的毒病。

verses.en: A thousand may fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand; but it will not come near you.
verses.zh: 虽有千人仆倒在你旁边，万人仆倒在你右边，这灾却不得临近你。

verses.en: You will only look with your eyes, and see the recompense of the wicked.
verses.zh: 你惟亲眼观看，见恶人遭报。

verses.en: Because you have made the LORD your refuge, and the Most High your dwelling place,
verses.zh: 耶和华是我的避难所；你已将至高者当你的居所，

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: no evil shall happen to you, neither shall any plague come near your dwelling.
verses.zh: 祸患必不临到你，灾害也不挨近你的帐棚。

verses.en: For he will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you in all your ways.
verses.zh: 因他要为你吩咐他的使者，在你行的一切道路上保护你。

verses.en: They will bear you up in their hands, so that you won’t dash your foot against a stone.
verses.zh: 他们要用手托着你，免得你的脚碰在石头上。

verses.en: You will tread on the lion and cobra. You will trample the young lion and the serpent underfoot.
verses.zh: 你要踹在狮子和虺蛇的身上，践踏少壮狮子和大蛇。

words.g: and + a marine or land monster, i.e. sea-serpent or jackal

verses.en: “Because he has set his love on me, therefore I will deliver him. I will set him on high, because he has known my name.
verses.zh: 神说：因为他专心爱我，我就要搭救他；因为他知道我的名，我要把他安置在高处。

verses.en: He will call on me, and I will answer him. I will be with him in trouble. I will deliver him, and honor him.
verses.zh: 他若求告我，我就应允他；他在急难中，我要与他同在；我要搭救他，使他尊贵。

verses.en: I will satisfy him with long life, and show him my salvation.”
verses.zh: 我要使他足享长寿，将我的救恩显明给他。

verses.en: A Psalm. A song for the Sabbath day.
verses.zh: （安息日的诗歌。）

verses.en: It is a good thing to give thanks to the LORD, to sing praises to your name, Most High,
verses.zh: 称谢耶和华！歌颂你至高者的名！

verses.en: to proclaim your loving kindness in the morning, and your faithfulness every night,
verses.zh: 用十弦的乐器和瑟，用琴弹幽雅的声音，早晨传扬你的慈爱；每夜传扬你的信实。这本为美事。

verses.en: with the ten-stringed lute, with the harp, and with the melody of the lyre.
verses.zh: a

words.g: a murmuring sound, i.e. a musical notation

verses.en: For you, LORD, have made me glad through your work. I will triumph in the works of your hands.
verses.zh: 因你―耶和华藉着你的作为叫我高兴，我要因你手的工作欢呼。

verses.en: How great are your works, LORD! Your thoughts are very deep.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，你的工作何其大！你的心思极其深！

verses.en: A senseless man doesn’t know, neither does a fool understand this:
verses.zh: 畜类人不晓得；愚顽人也不明白。

words.g: and + fat, i.e.  stupid or silly

verses.en: though the wicked spring up as the grass, and all the evildoers flourish, they will be destroyed forever.
verses.zh: 恶人茂盛如草，一切作孽之人发旺的时候，正是他们要灭亡，直到永远。

words.g: in + to break forth as a bud, i.e. bloom
a form of the prefix 'k-', but used separately  as
to do or make , especially to practise

verses.en: But you, LORD, are on high forever more.
verses.zh: 惟你―耶和华是至高，直到永远。

words.g: and + thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: For behold, your enemies, LORD, for behold, your enemies shall perish. All the evildoers will be scattered.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，你的仇敌都要灭亡；一切作孽的也要离散。

words.g: to break through, i.e. spread or separate
to do or make , especially to practise

verses.en: But you have exalted my horn like that of the wild ox. I am anointed with fresh oil.
verses.zh: 你却高举了我的角，如野牛的角；我是被新油膏了的。

words.g: and + to be high actively, to rise or raise

verses.en: My eye has also seen my enemies. My ears have heard of the wicked enemies who rise up against me.
verses.zh: 我眼睛看见仇敌遭报；我耳朵听见那些起来攻击我的恶人受罚。

verses.en: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree. He will grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
verses.zh: 义人要发旺如棕树，生长如黎巴嫩的香柏树。

words.g: to break forth as a bud, i.e. bloom
in + Lebanon, a mountain range in Palestine

verses.en: They are planted in the LORD’s house. They will flourish in our God’s courts.
verses.zh: 他们栽于耶和华的殿中，发旺在我们神的院里。

words.g: to break forth as a bud, i.e. bloom

verses.en: They will still produce fruit in old age. They will be full of sap and green,
verses.zh: 他们年老的时候仍要结果子，要满了汁浆而常发青，

verses.en: to show that the LORD is upright. He is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.
verses.zh: 好显明耶和华是正直的。他是我的磐石，在他毫无不义。

verses.en: The LORD reigns! He is clothed with majesty! The LORD is armed with strength. The world also is established. It can’t be moved.
verses.zh: 耶和华作王！他以威严为衣穿上；耶和华以能力为衣，以能力束腰，世界就坚定，不得动摇。

verses.en: Your throne is established from long ago. You are from everlasting.
verses.zh: 你的宝座从太初立定；你从亘古就有。

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: The floods have lifted up, LORD, the floods have lifted up their voice. The floods lift up their waves.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，大水扬起，大水发声，波浪澎湃。

verses.en: Above the voices of many waters, the mighty breakers of the sea, the LORD on high is mighty.
verses.zh: 耶和华在高处大有能力，胜过诸水的响声，洋海的大浪。

verses.en: Your statutes stand firm. Holiness adorns your house, LORD, forever more.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，你的法度最的确；你的殿永称为圣，是合宜的。

words.g: to be at home, i.e.  to be pleasant

verses.en: LORD, you God to whom vengeance belongs, you God to whom vengeance belongs, shine out.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，你是伸冤的神；伸冤的神啊，求你发出光来！

words.g: avengement, whether the act of the passion
avengement, whether the act of the passion

verses.en: Rise up, you judge of the earth. Pay back the proud what they deserve.
verses.zh: 审判世界的主啊，求你挺身而立，使骄傲人受应得的报应！

verses.en: LORD, how long will the wicked, how long will the wicked triumph?
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，恶人夸胜要到几时呢？要到几时呢？

words.g: to jump for joy, i.e. exult

verses.en: They pour out arrogant words. All the evildoers boast.
verses.zh: 他们絮絮叨叨说傲慢的话；一切作孽的人都自己夸张。

words.g: to do or make , especially to practise

verses.en: They break your people in pieces, LORD, and afflict your heritage.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，他们强压你的百姓，苦害你的产业。

verses.en: They kill the widow and the alien, and murder the fatherless.
verses.zh: 他们杀死寡妇和寄居的，又杀害孤儿。

words.g: to dash in pieces, i.e. kill

verses.en: They say, “The LORD will not see, neither will Jacob’s God consider.”
verses.zh: 他们说：耶和华必不看见；雅各的神必不思念。

verses.en: Consider, you senseless among the people; you fools, when will you be wise?
verses.zh: 你们民间的畜类人当思想；你们愚顽人到几时才有智慧呢？

words.g: and + fat, i.e.  stupid or silly
to be  circumspect and hence, intelligent

verses.en: He who implanted the ear, won’t he hear? He who formed the eye, won’t he see?
verses.zh: 造耳朵的，难道自己不听见吗？造眼睛的，难道自己不看见吗？

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: He who disciplines the nations, won’t he punish? He who teaches man knows.
verses.zh: 管教列邦的，就是叫人得知识的，难道自己不惩治人吗？

words.g: the + to goad, i.e.  to teach

verses.en: The LORD knows the thoughts of man, that they are futile.
verses.zh: 耶和华知道人的意念是虚妄的。

verses.en: Blessed is the man whom you discipline, LORD, and teach out of your law,
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，你所管教、用律法所教训的人是有福的！

words.g: the + a valiant man or warrior

verses.en: that you may give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit is dug for the wicked.
verses.zh: 你使他在遭难的日子得享平安；惟有恶人陷在所挖的坑中。

verses.en: For the LORD won’t reject his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.
verses.zh: 因为耶和华必不丢弃他的百姓，也不离弃他的产业。

verses.en: For judgment will return to righteousness. All the upright in heart shall follow it.
verses.zh: 审判要转向公义；心里正直的，必都随从。

verses.en: Who will rise up for me against the wicked? Who will stand up for me against the evildoers?
verses.zh: 谁肯为我起来攻击作恶的？谁肯为我站起抵挡作孽的？

words.g: to do or make , especially to practise

verses.en: Unless the LORD had been my help, my soul would have soon lived in silence.
verses.zh: 若不是耶和华帮助我，我就住在寂静之中了。

verses.en: When I said, “My foot is slipping!” Your loving kindness, LORD, held me up.
verses.zh: 我正说我失了脚，耶和华啊，那时你的慈爱扶助我。

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: In the multitude of my thoughts within me, your comforts delight my soul.
verses.zh: 我心里多忧多疑，你安慰我，就使我欢乐。

words.g: in + the nearest part, i.e. the center + +me/my

verses.en: Shall the throne of wickedness have fellowship with you, which brings about mischief by statute?
verses.zh: 那藉着律例架弄残害、在位上行奸恶的，岂能与你相交吗？

verses.en: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.
verses.zh: 他们大家聚集攻击义人，将无辜的人定为死罪。

verses.en: But the LORD has been my high tower, my God, the rock of my refuge.
verses.zh: 但耶和华向来作了我的高台；我的神作了我投靠的磐石。

verses.en: He has brought on them their own iniquity, and will cut them off in their own wickedness. The LORD, our God, will cut them off.
verses.zh: 他叫他们的罪孽归到他们身上。他们正在行恶之中，他要剪除他们；耶和华―我们的神要把他们剪除。

verses.en: Oh come, let’s sing to the LORD. Let’s shout aloud to the rock of our salvation!
verses.zh: 来啊，我们要向耶和华歌唱，向拯救我们的磐石欢呼！

verses.en: Let’s come before his presence with thanksgiving. Let’s extol him with songs!
verses.zh: 我们要来感谢他，用诗歌向他欢呼！

words.g: in + a song to be accompanied with instrumental music

verses.en: For the LORD is a great God, a great King above all gods.
verses.zh: 因耶和华为大神，为大王，超乎万神之上。

verses.en: In his hand are the deep places of the earth. The heights of the mountains are also his.
verses.zh: 地的深处在他手中；山的高峰也属他。

words.g: and + weariness, i.e.  toil  or speed

verses.en: The sea is his, and he made it. His hands formed the dry land.
verses.zh: 海洋属他，是他造的；旱地也是他手造成的。

verses.en: Oh come, let’s worship and bow down. Let’s kneel before the LORD, our Maker,
verses.zh: 来啊，我们要屈身敬拜，在造我们的耶和华面前跪下。

verses.en: for he is our God. We are the people of his pasture, and the sheep in his care. Today, oh that you would hear his voice!
verses.zh: 因为他是我们的神；我们是他草场的羊，是他手下的民。惟愿你们今天听他的话：

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: Don’t harden your heart, as at Meribah, as in the day of Massah in the wilderness,
verses.zh: 你们不可硬着心，像当日在米利巴，就是在旷野的玛撒。

words.g: to be dense, i.e. tough or severe
a testing, of men  or of God

verses.en: when your fathers tempted me, tested me, and saw my work.
verses.zh: 那时，你们的祖宗试我探我，并且观看我的作为。

words.g: father, in a literal and immediate + +you/your

verses.en: Forty long years I was grieved with that generation, and said, “They are a people who err in their heart. They have not known my ways.”
verses.zh: 四十年之久，我厌烦那世代，说：这是心里迷糊的百姓，竟不晓得我的作为！

words.g: to vacillate, i.e. reel or stray

verses.en: Therefore I swore in my wrath, “They won’t enter into my rest.”
verses.zh: 所以，我在怒中起誓，说：他们断不可进入我的安息！

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: Sing to the LORD a new song! Sing to the LORD, all the earth.
verses.zh: 你们要向耶和华唱新歌！全地都要向耶和华歌唱！

verses.en: Sing to the LORD! Bless his name! Proclaim his salvation from day to day!
verses.zh: 要向耶和华歌唱，称颂他的名！天天传扬他的救恩！

words.g: to be fresh, i.e. full  cheerful)

verses.en: Declare his glory among the nations, his marvelous works among all the peoples.
verses.zh: 在列邦中述说他的荣耀！在万民中述说他的奇事！

words.g: to score with a mark as a tally or record, i.e.  to inscribe
weight, but only figuratively in a good sense + +him/his/it

verses.en: For the LORD is great, and greatly to be praised! He is to be feared above all gods.
verses.zh: 因耶和华为大，当受极大的赞美；他在万神之上，当受敬畏。

verses.en: For all the gods of the peoples are idols, but the LORD made the heavens.
verses.zh: 外邦的神都属虚无；惟独耶和华创造诸天。

words.g: good for nothing, by anal. vain or vanity

verses.en: Honor and majesty are before him. Strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.
verses.zh: 有尊荣和威严在他面前；有能力与华美在他圣所。

words.g: and + magnificence, i.e. ornament or splendor
in + a consecrated thing or place, especially + +him/his/it

verses.en: Ascribe to the LORD, you families of nations, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.
verses.zh: 民中的万族啊，你们要将荣耀、能力归给耶和华，都归给耶和华！

words.g: a family, i.e. circle of relatives
weight, but only figuratively in a good sense

verses.en: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due to his name. Bring an offering, and come into his courts.
verses.zh: 要将耶和华的名所当得的荣耀归给他，拿供物来进入他的院宇。

words.g: weight, but only figuratively in a good sense

verses.en: Worship the LORD in holy array. Tremble before him, all the earth.
verses.zh: 当以圣洁的（的：或译为）妆饰敬拜耶和华；全地要在他面前战抖！

words.g: to twist or whirl , i.e.  to dance

verses.en: Say among the nations, “The LORD reigns.” The world is also established. It can’t be moved. He will judge the peoples with equity.
verses.zh: 人在列邦中要说：耶和华作王！世界就坚定，不得动摇；他要按公正审判众民。

words.g: a straight course, i.e. sail direct
in + evenness, i.e.  prosperity or concord

verses.en: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice. Let the sea roar, and its fullness!
verses.zh: 愿天欢喜，愿地快乐！愿海和其中所充满的澎湃！

words.g: and + to spin round , i.e. usually rejoice
to tumble, i.e. be violently agitated

verses.en: Let the field and all that is in it exult! Then all the trees of the woods shall sing for joy
verses.zh: 愿田和其中所有的都欢乐！那时，林中的树木都要在耶和华面前欢呼。

words.g: to jump for joy, i.e. exult

verses.en: before the LORD; for he comes, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, the peoples with his truth.
verses.zh: 因为他来了，他来要审判全地。他要按公义审判世界，按他的信实审判万民。

verses.en: The LORD reigns! Let the earth rejoice! Let the multitude of islands be glad!
verses.zh: 耶和华作王！愿地快乐！愿众海岛欢喜！

words.g: to spin round , i.e. usually rejoice

verses.en: Clouds and darkness are around him. Righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.
verses.zh: 密云和幽暗在他的四围；公义和公平是他宝座的根基。

words.g: a cloud , i.e. the nimbus or thunder-cloud

verses.en: A fire goes before him, and burns up his adversaries on every side.
verses.zh: 有烈火在他前头行，烧灭他四围的敌人。

words.g: and + to lick, i.e.  to blaze

verses.en: His lightning lights up the world. The earth sees, and trembles.
verses.zh: 他的闪电光照世界，大地看见便震动。

words.g: and + to twist or whirl , i.e.  to dance

verses.en: The mountains melt like wax at the presence of the LORD, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.
verses.zh: 诸山见耶和华的面，就是全地之主的面，便消化如蜡。

verses.en: The heavens declare his righteousness. All the peoples have seen his glory.
verses.zh: 诸天表明他的公义；万民看见他的荣耀。

words.g: weight, but only figuratively in a good sense + +him/his/it

verses.en: Let all them be shamed who serve engraved images, who boast in their idols. Worship him, all you gods!
verses.zh: 愿一切事奉雕刻的偶像、靠虚无之神自夸的，都蒙羞愧。万神哪，你们都当拜他。

words.g: to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed
in + good for nothing, by anal. vain or vanity

verses.en: Zion heard and was glad. The daughters of Judah rejoiced because of your judgments, LORD.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，锡安听见你的判断就欢喜；犹大的城邑（原文是女子）也都快乐。

words.g: and + to spin round , i.e. usually rejoice
Jehudah , the name of five Israelites

verses.en: For you, LORD, are most high above all the earth. You are exalted far above all gods.
verses.zh: 因为你―耶和华至高，超乎全地；你被尊崇，远超万神之上。

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: You who love the LORD, hate evil! He preserves the souls of his saints. He delivers them out of the hand of the wicked.
verses.zh: 你们爱耶和华的，都当恨恶罪恶；他保护圣民的性命，搭救他们脱离恶人的手。

verses.en: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.
verses.zh: 散布亮光是为义人；预备喜乐是为正直人。

verses.en: Be glad in the LORD, you righteous people! Give thanks to his holy Name.
verses.zh: 你们义人当靠耶和华欢喜，称谢他可记念的圣名。

verses.en: A Psalm. Sing to the LORD a new song, for he has done marvelous things! His right hand and his holy arm have worked salvation for him.
verses.zh: （一篇诗。）你们要向耶和华唱新歌！因为他行过奇妙的事；他的右手和圣臂施行救恩。

words.g: to be open, wide or free
and + the arm , or  the foreleg

verses.en: The LORD has made known his salvation. He has openly shown his righteousness in the sight of the nations.
verses.zh: 耶和华发明了他的救恩，在列邦人眼前显出公义；

verses.en: He has remembered his loving kindness and his faithfulness toward the house of Israel. All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
verses.zh: 记念他向以色列家所发的慈爱，所凭的信实。地的四极都看见我们神的救恩。

verses.en: Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth! Burst out and sing for joy, yes, sing praises!
verses.zh: 全地都要向耶和华欢乐；要发起大声，欢呼歌颂！

words.g: and + to creak , i.e. to shout

verses.en: Sing praises to the LORD with the harp, with the harp and the voice of melody.
verses.zh: 要用琴歌颂耶和华，用琴和诗歌的声音歌颂他！

words.g: a musical piece or song to be accompanied by an instrument

verses.en: With trumpets and sound of the ram’s horn, make a joyful noise before the King, the LORD.
verses.zh: 用号和角声，在大君王耶和华面前欢呼！

verses.en: Let the sea roar with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell therein.
verses.zh: 愿海和其中所充满的澎湃；世界和住在其间的也要发声。

words.g: to tumble, i.e. be violently agitated

verses.en: Let the rivers clap their hands. Let the mountains sing for joy together.
verses.zh: 愿大水拍手；愿诸山在耶和华面前一同欢呼；

words.g: to rub or strike the hands together

verses.en: Let them sing before the LORD, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, and the peoples with equity.
verses.zh: 因为他来要审判遍地。他要按公义审判世界，按公正审判万民。

words.g: in + evenness, i.e.  prosperity or concord

verses.en: The LORD reigns! Let the peoples tremble. He sits enthroned among the cherubim. Let the earth be moved.
verses.zh: 耶和华作王；万民当战抖！他坐在二基路伯上，地当动摇。

verses.en: The LORD is great in Zion. He is high above all the peoples.
verses.zh: 耶和华在锡安为大；他超乎万民之上。

words.g: in + Tsijon , a mountain of Jerusalem
and + to be high actively, to rise or raise

verses.en: Let them praise your great and awesome name. He is Holy!
verses.zh: 他们当称赞他大而可畏的名；他本为圣！

verses.en: The King’s strength also loves justice. You establish equity. You execute justice and righteousness in Jacob.
verses.zh: 王有能力，喜爱公平，坚立公正，在雅各中施行公平和公义。

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you
thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: Exalt the LORD our God. Worship at his footstool. He is Holy!
verses.zh: 你们当尊崇耶和华―我们的神，在他脚凳前下拜。他本为圣！

words.g: to be high actively, to rise or raise

verses.en: Moses and Aaron were among his priests, Samuel was among those who call on his name. They called on the LORD, and he answered them.
verses.zh: 在他的祭司中有摩西和亚伦；在求告他名的人中有撒母耳。他们求告耶和华，他就应允他们。

words.g: and + Aharon, the brother of Moses
and + Shemuel, the name of three Israelites

verses.en: He spoke to them in the pillar of cloud. They kept his testimonies, the statute that he gave them.
verses.zh: 他在云柱中对他们说话；他们遵守他的法度和他所赐给他们的律例。

words.g: a cloud , i.e. the nimbus or thunder-cloud

verses.en: You answered them, LORD our God. You are a God who forgave them, although you took vengeance for their doings.
verses.zh: 耶和华―我们的神啊，你应允他们；你是赦免他们的神，却按他们所行的报应他们。

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you
and + to grudge, i.e. avenge or punish

verses.en: Exalt the LORD, our God. Worship at his holy hill, for the LORD, our God, is holy!
verses.zh: 你们要尊崇耶和华―我们的神，在他的圣山下拜，因为耶和华―我们的神本为圣！

words.g: to be high actively, to rise or raise

verses.en: A Psalm of thanksgiving. Shout for joy to the LORD, all you lands!
verses.zh: （称谢诗。）普天下当向耶和华欢呼！

verses.en: Serve the LORD with gladness. Come before his presence with singing.
verses.zh: 你们当乐意事奉耶和华，当来向他歌唱！

verses.en: Know that the LORD, he is God. It is he who has made us, and we are his. We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.
verses.zh: 你们当晓得耶和华是神！我们是他造的，也是属他的；我们是他的民，也是他草场的羊。

words.n: anachnu — 'we'. Hebrew normally hides the pronoun inside the verb, so spelling it out is emphatic.

verses.en: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise. Give thanks to him, and bless his name.
verses.zh: 当称谢进入他的门；当赞美进入他的院。当感谢他，称颂他的名！

verses.en: For the LORD is good. His loving kindness endures forever, his faithfulness to all generations.
verses.zh: 因为耶和华本为善。他的慈爱存到永远；他的信实直到万代。

verses.en: A Psalm by David. I will sing of loving kindness and justice. To you, LORD, I will sing praises.
verses.zh: （大卫的诗）。我要歌唱慈爱和公平；耶和华啊，我要向你歌颂！

verses.en: I will be careful to live a blameless life. When will you come to me? I will walk within my house with a blameless heart.
verses.zh: 我要用智慧行完全的道。你几时到我这里来呢？我要存完全的心行在我家中。

words.g: to be  circumspect and hence, intelligent
in + the nearest part, i.e. the center

verses.en: I will set no vile thing before my eyes. I hate the deeds of faithless men. They will not cling to me.
verses.zh: 邪僻的事，我都不摆在我眼前；悖逆人所做的事，我甚恨恶，不容沾在我身上。

words.g: to impinge, i.e. cling or adhere

verses.en: A perverse heart will be far from me. I will have nothing to do with evil.
verses.zh: 弯曲的心思，我必远离；一切的恶人（或译：恶事），我不认识。

verses.en: I will silence whoever secretly slanders his neighbor. I won’t tolerate one who is arrogant and conceited.
verses.zh: 在暗中谗谤他邻居的，我必将他灭绝；眼目高傲、心里骄纵的，我必不容他。

words.g: to wag the tongue, i.e. to calumniate

verses.en: My eyes will be on the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me. He who walks in a perfect way, he will serve me.
verses.zh: 我眼要看国中的诚实人，叫他们与我同住；行为完全的，他要伺候我。

words.g: to attend as a menial or worshipper + +me/my

verses.en: He who practices deceit won’t dwell within my house. He who speaks falsehood won’t be established before my eyes.
verses.zh: 行诡诈的，必不得住在我家里；说谎话的，必不得立在我眼前。

words.g: in + the nearest part, i.e. the center

verses.en: Morning by morning, I will destroy all the wicked of the land, to cut off all the workers of iniquity from the LORD’s city.
verses.zh: 我每日早晨要灭绝国中所有的恶人，好把一切作孽的从耶和华的城里剪除。

words.g: to do or make , especially to practise

verses.en: A Prayer of the afflicted, when he is overwhelmed and pours out his complaint before the LORD.
verses.zh: （困苦人发昏的时候，在耶和华面前吐露苦情的祷告。）

words.g: to + depressed, in mind or circumstances

verses.en: Hear my prayer, LORD! Let my cry come to you.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，求你听我的祷告，容我的呼求达到你面前！

verses.en: Don’t hide your face from me in the day of my distress. Turn your ear to me. Answer me quickly in the day when I call.
verses.zh: 我在急难的日子，求你向我侧耳；不要向我掩面！我呼求的日子，求你快快应允我！

verses.en: For my days consume away like smoke. My bones are burned as a torch.
verses.zh: 因为，我的年日如烟云消灭；我的骨头如火把烧着。

words.g: to end, whether intransitive  or transitived
like + a form of the prefix 'k-', but used separately  as
to glow, i.e. literally  or figuratively

verses.en: My heart is blighted like grass, and withered, for I forget to eat my bread.
verses.zh: 我的心被伤，如草枯干，甚至我忘记吃饭。

words.g: to mislay, i.e. to be oblivious of

verses.en: By reason of the voice of my groaning, my bones stick to my skin.
verses.zh: 因我唉哼的声音，我的肉紧贴骨头。

words.g: to impinge, i.e. cling or adhere

verses.en: I am like a pelican of the wilderness. I have become as an owl of the waste places.
verses.zh: 我如同旷野的鹈鹕；我好像荒场的鴞鸟。

verses.en: I watch, and have become like a sparrow that is alone on the housetop.
verses.zh: 我警醒不睡；我像房顶上孤单的麻雀。

verses.en: My enemies reproach me all day. Those who are mad at me use my name as a curse.
verses.zh: 我的仇敌终日辱骂我；向我猖狂的人指着我赌咒。

words.g: to pull off, i.e.  to expose + +me/my

verses.en: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mixed my drink with tears,
verses.zh: 我吃过炉灰，如同吃饭；我所喝的与眼泪搀杂。

verses.en: because of your indignation and your wrath; for you have taken me up and thrown me away.
verses.zh: 这都因你的恼恨和忿怒；你把我拾起来，又把我摔下去。

words.g: strictly froth at the mouth, i.e.  fury + +you/your

verses.en: My days are like a long shadow. I have withered like grass.
verses.zh: 我的年日如日影偏斜；我也如草枯干。

verses.en: But you, LORD, will remain forever; your renown endures to all generations.
verses.zh: 惟你―耶和华必存到永远；你可记念的名也存到万代。

words.g: and + thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: You will arise and have mercy on Zion, for it is time to have pity on her. Yes, the set time has come.
verses.zh: 你必起来怜恤锡安，因现在是可怜她的时候，日期已经到了。

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: For your servants take pleasure in her stones, and have pity on her dust.
verses.zh: 你的仆人原来喜悦她的石头，可怜她的尘土。

verses.en: So the nations will fear the LORD’s name, all the kings of the earth your glory.
verses.zh: 列国要敬畏耶和华的名；世上诸王都敬畏你的荣耀。

words.g: weight, but only figuratively in a good sense + +you/your

verses.en: For the LORD has built up Zion. He has appeared in his glory.
verses.zh: 因为耶和华建造了锡安，在他荣耀里显现。

words.g: in + weight, but only figuratively in a good sense + +him/his/it

verses.en: He has responded to the prayer of the destitute, and has not despised their prayer.
verses.zh: 他垂听穷人的祷告，并不藐视他们的祈求。

verses.en: This will be written for the generation to come. A people which will be created will praise the LORD,
verses.zh: 这必为后代的人记下，将来受造的民要赞美耶和华。

verses.en: for he has looked down from the height of his sanctuary. From heaven, the LORD saw the earth,
verses.zh: 因为，他从至高的圣所垂看；耶和华从天向地观察，

words.g: to lean out , i.e.  peep or gaze

verses.en: to hear the groans of the prisoner, to free those who are condemned to death,
verses.zh: 要垂听被囚之人的叹息，要释放将要死的人，

verses.en: that men may declare the LORD’s name in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem,
verses.zh: 使人在锡安传扬耶和华的名，在耶路撒冷传扬赞美他的话，

words.g: to + to score with a mark as a tally or record, i.e.  to inscribe
in + Tsijon , a mountain of Jerusalem
in + Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine

verses.en: when the peoples are gathered together, the kingdoms, to serve the LORD.
verses.zh: 就是在万民和列国聚会事奉耶和华的时候。

words.g: and + dominion, i.e.  the estate  or  the country

verses.en: He weakened my strength along the course. He shortened my days.
verses.zh: 他使我的力量中道衰弱，使我的年日短少。

verses.en: I said, “My God, don’t take me away in the middle of my days. Your years are throughout all generations.
verses.zh: 我说：我的神啊，不要使我中年去世。你的年数世世无穷！

verses.en: Of old, you laid the foundation of the earth. The heavens are the work of your hands.
verses.zh: 你起初立了地的根基；天也是你手所造的。

verses.en: They will perish, but you will endure. Yes, all of them will wear out like a garment. You will change them like a cloak, and they will be changed.
verses.zh: 天地都要灭没，你却要长存；天地都要如外衣渐渐旧了。你要将天地如里衣更换，天地就都改变了。

words.g: and + thou and thee, or  ye and you
to slide by, i.e.  to hasten away + +them/their
and + to slide by, i.e.  to hasten away

verses.en: But you are the same. Your years will have no end.
verses.zh: 惟有你永不改变；你的年数没有穷尽。

words.g: and + thou and thee, or  ye and you
to complete, in a good or a bad sense

verses.en: The children of your servants will continue. Their offspring will be established before you.”
verses.zh: 你仆人的子孙要长存；他们的后裔要坚立在你面前。

verses.en: By David. Praise the LORD, my soul! All that is within me, praise his holy name!
verses.zh: （大卫的诗。）我的心哪，你要称颂耶和华！凡在我里面的，也要称颂他的圣名！

words.g: the nearest part, i.e. the center + +me/my

verses.en: Praise the LORD, my soul, and don’t forget all his benefits,
verses.zh: 我的心哪，你要称颂耶和华！不可忘记他的一切恩惠！

words.g: to mislay, i.e. to be oblivious of

verses.en: who forgives all your sins, who heals all your diseases,
verses.zh: 他赦免你的一切罪孽，医治你的一切疾病。

words.g: the + to mend , i.e.  to cure

verses.en: who redeems your life from destruction, who crowns you with loving kindness and tender mercies,
verses.zh: 他救赎你的命脱离死亡，以仁爱和慈悲为你的冠冕。

words.g: the + to be the next of kin

verses.en: who satisfies your desire with good things, so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.
verses.zh: 他用美物使你所愿的得以知足，以致你如鹰返老还童。

words.g: youth, the state  or the persons + +you/your

verses.en: The LORD executes righteous acts, and justice for all who are oppressed.
verses.zh: 耶和华施行公义，为一切受屈的人伸冤。

verses.en: He made known his ways to Moses, his deeds to the children of Israel.
verses.zh: 他使摩西知道他的法则，叫以色列人晓得他的作为。

verses.en: The LORD is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness.
verses.zh: 耶和华有怜悯，有恩典，不轻易发怒，且有丰盛的慈爱。

verses.en: He will not always accuse; neither will he stay angry forever.
verses.zh: 他不长久责备，也不永远怀怒。

words.g: to + a goal, i.e. the bright object at adistance travelled towards

verses.en: He has not dealt with us according to our sins, nor repaid us for our iniquities.
verses.zh: 他没有按我们的罪过待我们，也没有照我们的罪孽报应我们。

words.g: like + a crime or its penalty + +us/our
to treat a person , i.e. benefit or requite

verses.en: For as the heavens are high above the earth, so great is his loving kindness toward those who fear him.
verses.zh: 天离地何等的高，他的慈爱向敬畏他的人也是何等的大！

words.g: like + to soar, i.e. be lofty

verses.en: As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.
verses.zh: 东离西有多远，他叫我们的过犯离我们也有多远！

words.g: like + to widen , i.e.  recede or  remove
to widen , i.e.  recede or  remove

verses.en: Like a father has compassion on his children, so the LORD has compassion on those who fear him.
verses.zh: 父亲怎样怜恤他的儿女，耶和华也怎样怜恤敬畏他的人！

words.g: father, in a literal and immediate

verses.en: For he knows how we are made. He remembers that we are dust.
verses.zh: 因为他知道我们的本体，思念我们不过是尘土。

verses.en: As for man, his days are like grass. As a flower of the field, so he flourishes.
verses.zh: 至于世人，他的年日如草一样。他发旺如野地的花，

words.g: like + glistening, i.e. a burnished plate

verses.en: For the wind passes over it, and it is gone. Its place remembers it no more.
verses.zh: 经风一吹，便归无有；它的原处也不再认识它。

words.g: to scrutinize, i.e. look intently at + +him/his/it

verses.en: But the LORD’s loving kindness is from everlasting to everlasting with those who fear him, his righteousness to children’s children,
verses.zh: 但耶和华的慈爱归于敬畏他的人，从亘古到永远；他的公义也归于子子孙孙―

verses.en: to those who keep his covenant, to those who remember to obey his precepts.
verses.zh: 就是那些遵守他的约、记念他的训词而遵行的人。

verses.en: The LORD has established his throne in the heavens. His kingdom rules over all.
verses.zh: 耶和华在天上立定宝座；他的权柄（原文是国）统管万有。

verses.en: Praise the LORD, you angels of his, who are mighty in strength, who fulfill his word, obeying the voice of his word.
verses.zh: 听从他命令、成全他旨意、有大能的天使，都要称颂耶和华！

verses.en: Praise the LORD, all you armies of his, you servants of his, who do his pleasure.
verses.zh: 你们作他的诸军，作他的仆役，行他所喜悦的，都要称颂耶和华！

words.g: a mass of persons , especially reg. organized forwar + +him/his/it
to attend as a menial or worshipper + +him/his/it

verses.en: Praise the LORD, all you works of his, in all places of his dominion. Praise the LORD, my soul!
verses.zh: 你们一切被他造的，在他所治理的各处，都要称颂耶和华！我的心哪，你要称颂耶和华！

verses.en: Bless the LORD, my soul. The LORD, my God, you are very great. You are clothed with honor and majesty.
verses.zh: 我的心哪，你要称颂耶和华！耶和华―我的神啊，你为至大！你以尊荣威严为衣服，

words.g: and + magnificence, i.e. ornament or splendor

verses.en: He covers himself with light as with a garment. He stretches out the heavens like a curtain.
verses.zh: 披上亮光，如披外袍，铺张穹苍，如铺幔子，

verses.en: He lays the beams of his rooms in the waters. He makes the clouds his chariot. He walks on the wings of the wind.
verses.zh: 在水中立楼阁的栋梁，用云彩为车辇，藉着风的翅膀而行，

verses.en: He makes his messengers winds, and his servants flames of fire.
verses.zh: 以风为使者，以火焰为仆役，

words.g: to attend as a menial or worshipper + +him/his/it

verses.en: He laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be moved forever.
verses.zh: 将地立在根基上，使地永不动摇。

verses.en: You covered it with the deep as with a cloak. The waters stood above the mountains.
verses.zh: 你用深水遮盖地面，犹如衣裳；诸水高过山岭。

verses.en: At your rebuke they fled. At the voice of your thunder they hurried away.
verses.zh: 你的斥责一发，水便奔逃；你的雷声一发，水便奔流。

words.g: to start up suddenly, i.e.  to hasten away

verses.en: The mountains rose, the valleys sank down, to the place which you had assigned to them.
verses.zh: 诸山升上，诸谷沉下（或译：随山上翻，随谷下流），归你为它所安定之地。

words.g: a split, i.e. a wide level valley between mountains

verses.en: You have set a boundary that they may not pass over, that they don’t turn again to cover the earth.
verses.zh: 你定了界限，使水不能过去，不再转回遮盖地面。

verses.en: He sends springs into the valleys. They run among the mountains.
verses.zh: 耶和华使泉源涌在山谷，流在山间，

words.g: in + a stream, especially a winter torrent

verses.en: They give drink to every animal of the field. The wild donkeys quench their thirst.
verses.zh: 使野地的走兽有水喝，野驴得解其渴。

words.g: to quaff, i.e.  to irrigate or furnish apotion to

verses.en: The birds of the sky nest by them. They sing among the branches.
verses.zh: 天上的飞鸟在水旁住宿，在树枝上啼叫。

verses.en: He waters the mountains from his rooms. The earth is filled with the fruit of your works.
verses.zh: 他从楼阁中浇灌山岭；因他作为的功效，地就丰足。

words.g: to quaff, i.e.  to irrigate or furnish apotion to
from + something lofty, i.e. a stair-way + +him/his/it

verses.en: He causes the grass to grow for the livestock, and plants for man to cultivate, that he may produce food out of the earth:
verses.zh: 他使草生长，给六畜吃，使菜蔬发长，供给人用，使人从地里能得食物，

verses.en: wine that makes the heart of man glad, oil to make his face to shine, and bread that strengthens man’s heart.
verses.zh: 又得酒能悦人心，得油能润人面，得粮能养人心。

words.g: to + to gleam, i.e.  be cheerful

verses.en: The LORD’s trees are well watered, the cedars of Lebanon, which he has planted,
verses.zh: 佳美的树木，就是黎巴嫩的香柏树，是耶和华所栽种的，都满了汁浆。

words.g: Lebanon, a mountain range in Palestine

verses.en: where the birds make their nests. The stork makes its home in the cypress trees.
verses.zh: 雀鸟在其上搭窝；至于鹤，松树是它的房屋。

words.g: to nestle, i.e. build or occupy as anest
the kind  bird, i.e. a stork

verses.en: The high mountains are for the wild goats. The rocks are a refuge for the rock badgers.
verses.zh: 高山为野山羊的住所；岩石为沙番的藏处。

words.g: a craggy rock, literally or figuratively
to + a species of rockrabbit , i.e. probably the hyrax

verses.en: He appointed the moon for seasons. The sun knows when to set.
verses.zh: 你安置月亮为定节令；日头自知沉落。

verses.en: You make darkness, and it is night, in which all the animals of the forest prowl.
verses.zh: 你造黑暗为夜，林中的百兽就都爬出来。

verses.en: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their food from God.
verses.zh: 少壮狮子吼叫，要抓食，向神寻求食物。

words.g: to + something torn, i.e. a fragment

verses.en: The sun rises, and they steal away, and lie down in their dens.
verses.zh: 日头一出，兽便躲避，卧在洞里。

verses.en: Man goes out to his work, to his labor until the evening.
verses.zh: 人出去做工，劳碌直到晚上。

words.g: and + to + work of any kind + +him/his/it

verses.en: LORD, how many are your works! In wisdom, you have made them all. The earth is full of your riches.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

verses.en: There is the sea, great and wide, in which are innumerable living things, both small and large animals.
verses.zh: 那里有海，又大又广；其中有无数的动物，大小活物都有。

verses.en: There the ships go, and leviathan, whom you formed to play there.
verses.zh: 那里有船行走，有你所造的鳄鱼游泳在其中。

words.g: a wreathed animal, i.e. a serpent

verses.en: These all wait for you, that you may give them their food in due season.
verses.zh: 这都仰望你按时给它食物。

verses.en: You give to them; they gather. You open your hand; they are satisfied with good.
verses.zh: 你给它们，它们便拾起来；你张手，它们饱得美食。

words.g: to pick up, i.e.  to gather

verses.en: You hide your face; they are troubled. You take away their breath; they die and return to the dust.
verses.zh: 你掩面，它们便惊惶；你收回它们的气，它们就死亡，归于尘土。

words.g: to tremble inwardly , i.e.  be   alarmed or agitated

verses.en: You send out your Spirit and they are created. You renew the face of the ground.
verses.zh: 你发出你的灵，它们便受造；你使地面更换为新。

verses.en: Let the LORD’s glory endure forever. Let the LORD rejoice in his works.
verses.zh: 愿耶和华的荣耀存到永远！愿耶和华喜悦自己所造的！

words.g: weight, but only figuratively in a good sense

verses.en: He looks at the earth, and it trembles. He touches the mountains, and they smoke.
verses.zh: 他看地，地便震动；他摸山，山就冒烟。

words.g: and + to smoke, whether literal or figurative

verses.en: I will sing to the LORD as long as I live. I will sing praise to my God while I have any being.
verses.zh: 我要一生向耶和华唱诗！我还活的时候，要向我神歌颂！

verses.en: Let my meditation be sweet to him. I will rejoice in the LORD.
verses.zh: 愿他以我的默念为甘甜！我要因耶和华欢喜！

verses.en: Let sinners be consumed out of the earth. Let the wicked be no more. Bless the LORD, my soul. Praise the LORD!
verses.zh: 愿罪人从世上消灭！愿恶人归于无有！我的心哪，要称颂耶和华！你们要赞美耶和华（原文是哈利路亚；下同）！

words.g: to complete, in a good or a bad sense

verses.en: Give thanks to the LORD! Call on his name! Make his doings known among the peoples.
verses.zh: 你们要称谢耶和华，求告他的名，在万民中传扬他的作为！

verses.en: Sing to him, sing praises to him! Tell of all his marvelous works.
verses.zh: 要向他唱诗歌颂，谈论他一切奇妙的作为！

words.g: to ponder, i.e.  converse  or  utter

verses.en: Glory in his holy name. Let the heart of those who seek the LORD rejoice.
verses.zh: 要以他的圣名夸耀！寻求耶和华的人，心中应当欢喜！

verses.en: Seek the LORD and his strength. Seek his face forever more.
verses.zh: 要寻求耶和华与他的能力，时常寻求他的面。

verses.en: Remember his marvelous works that he has done: his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,
verses.zh: 他仆人亚伯拉罕的后裔，他所拣选雅各的子孙哪，你们要记念他奇妙的作为和他的奇事，并他口中的判语。

words.g: the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +him/his/it

verses.en: you offspring of Abraham, his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen ones.
verses.zh: a

words.g: Abraham, the later name of Abram

verses.en: He is the LORD, our God. His judgments are in all the earth.
verses.zh: 他是耶和华―我们的神；全地都有他的判断。

verses.en: He has remembered his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations,
verses.zh: 他记念他的约，直到永远；他所吩咐的话，直到千代―

verses.en: the covenant which he made with Abraham, his oath to Isaac,
verses.zh: 就是与亚伯拉罕所立的约，向以撒所起的誓。

words.g: Abraham, the later name of Abram
and + something sworn, i.e. an oath + +him/his/it
to + Jischak, the heir of Abraham

verses.en: and confirmed it to Jacob for a statute; to Israel for an everlasting covenant,
verses.zh: 他又将这约向雅各定为律例，向以色列定为永远的约，

verses.en: saying, “To you I will give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance,”
verses.zh: 说：我必将迦南地赐给你，作你产业的分。

words.g: a rope , especially a measuring line

verses.en: when they were but a few men in number, yes, very few, and foreigners in it.
verses.zh: 当时，他们人丁有限，数目稀少，并且在那地为寄居的。

words.g: and + to turn aside from the road , i.e. sojourn

verses.en: They went about from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people.
verses.zh: 他们从这邦游到那邦，从这国行到那国。

words.g: from + dominion, i.e.  the estate  or  the country

verses.en: He allowed no one to do them wrong. Yes, he reproved kings for their sakes,
verses.zh: 他不容甚么人欺负他们，为他们的缘故责备君王，

words.g: to + to press upon, i.e. oppress + +them/their

verses.en: “Don’t touch my anointed ones! Do my prophets no harm!”
verses.zh: 说：不可难为我受膏的人，也不可恶待我的先知。

words.g: and + to + a prophet or  inspired man + +me/my

verses.en: He called for a famine on the land. He destroyed the food supplies.
verses.zh: 他命饥荒降在那地上，将所倚靠的粮食全行断绝，

verses.en: He sent a man before them. Joseph was sold for a slave.
verses.zh: 在他们以先打发一个人去―约瑟被卖为奴仆。

words.g: Joseph, the name of seven Israelites

verses.en: They bruised his feet with shackles. His neck was locked in irons,
verses.zh: 人用脚镣伤他的脚；他被铁链捆拘。

verses.en: until the time that his word happened, and the LORD’s word proved him true.
verses.zh: 耶和华的话试炼他，直等到他所说的应验了。

verses.en: The king sent and freed him, even the ruler of peoples, and let him go free.
verses.zh: 王打发人把他解开，就是治理众民的，把他释放，

words.g: and + to jump, i.e. be violently agitated + +him/his/it

verses.en: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all of his possessions,
verses.zh: 立他作王家之主，掌管他一切所有的，

verses.en: to discipline his princes at his pleasure, and to teach his elders wisdom.
verses.zh: 使他随意捆绑他的臣宰，将智慧教导他的长老。

verses.en: Israel also came into Egypt. Jacob lived in the land of Ham.
verses.zh: 以色列也到了埃及；雅各在含地寄居。

words.g: Mitsrajim, i.e. Upper and Lower Egypt
to turn aside from the road , i.e. sojourn

verses.en: He increased his people greatly, and made them stronger than their adversaries.
verses.zh: 耶和华使他的百姓生养众多，使他们比敌人强盛，

words.g: and + to bind fast, i.e. close + +him/his/it

verses.en: He turned their heart to hate his people, to conspire against his servants.
verses.zh: 使敌人的心转去恨他的百姓，并用诡计待他的仆人。

words.g: to + to defraud, i.e. act treacherously

verses.en: He sent Moses, his servant, and Aaron, whom he had chosen.
verses.zh: 他打发他的仆人摩西和他所拣选的亚伦，

verses.en: They performed miracles among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.
verses.zh: 在敌人中间显他的神迹，在含地显他的奇事。

verses.en: He sent darkness, and made it dark. They didn’t rebel against his words.
verses.zh: 他命黑暗，就有黑暗；没有违背他话的。

verses.en: He turned their waters into blood, and killed their fish.
verses.zh: 他叫埃及的水变为血，叫他们的鱼死了。

verses.en: Their land swarmed with frogs, even in the rooms of their kings.
verses.zh: 在他们的地上以及王宫的内室，青蛙多多滋生。

verses.en: He spoke, and swarms of flies came, and lice in all their borders.
verses.zh: 他说一声，苍蝇就成群而来，并有虱子进入他们四境。

verses.en: He gave them hail for rain, with lightning in their land.
verses.zh: 他给他们降下冰雹为雨，在他们的地上降下火焰。

verses.en: He struck their vines and also their fig trees, and shattered the trees of their country.
verses.zh: 他也击打他们的葡萄树和无花果树，毁坏他们境内的树木。

verses.en: He spoke, and the locusts came with the grasshoppers, without number.
verses.zh: 他说一声，就有蝗虫蚂蚱上来，不计其数，

verses.en: They ate up every plant in their land, and ate up the fruit of their ground.
verses.zh: 吃尽了他们地上各样的菜蔬和田地的出产。

verses.en: He struck also all the firstborn in their land, the first fruits of all their manhood.
verses.zh: 他又击杀他们国内一切的长子，就是他们强壮时头生的。

verses.en: He brought them out with silver and gold. There was not one feeble person among his tribes.
verses.zh: 他领自己的百姓带银子金子出来；他支派中没有一个软弱的。

verses.en: Egypt was glad when they departed, for the fear of them had fallen on them.
verses.zh: 他们出来的时候，埃及人便欢喜；原来埃及人惧怕他们。

words.g: Mitsrajim, i.e. Upper and Lower Egypt

verses.en: He spread a cloud for a covering, fire to give light in the night.
verses.zh: 他铺张云彩当遮盖，夜间使火光照。

words.g: a cloud , i.e. the nimbus or thunder-cloud

verses.en: They asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of the sky.
verses.zh: 他们一求，他就使鹌鹑飞来，并用天上的粮食叫他们饱足。

verses.en: He opened the rock, and waters gushed out. They ran as a river in the dry places.
verses.zh: 他打开磐石，水就涌出；在干旱之处，水流成河。

words.g: and + to flow freely , i.e.  to have a  flux

verses.en: For he remembered his holy word, and Abraham, his servant.
verses.zh: 这都因他记念他的圣言和他的仆人亚伯拉罕。

words.g: Abraham, the later name of Abram

verses.en: He brought his people out with joy, his chosen with singing.
verses.zh: 他带领百姓欢乐而出，带领选民欢呼前往。

verses.en: He gave them the lands of the nations. They took the labor of the peoples in possession,
verses.zh: 他将列国的地赐给他们，他们便承受众民劳碌得来的，

verses.en: that they might keep his statutes, and observe his laws. Praise the LORD!
verses.zh: 好使他们遵他的律例，守他的律法。你们要赞美耶和华！

words.g: to guard, in a good sense  or a bad one

verses.en: Praise the LORD! Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
verses.zh: 你们要赞美耶和华！要称谢耶和华，因他本为善；他的慈爱永远长存！

verses.en: Who can utter the mighty acts of the LORD, or fully declare all his praise?
verses.zh: 谁能传说耶和华的大能？谁能表明他一切的美德？

verses.en: Blessed are those who keep justice. Blessed is one who does what is right at all times.
verses.zh: 凡遵守公平、常行公义的，这人便为有福！

verses.en: Remember me, LORD, with the favor that you show to your people. Visit me with your salvation,
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，你用恩惠待你的百姓；求你也用这恩惠记念我，开你的救恩眷顾我，

verses.en: that I may see the prosperity of your chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of your nation, that I may glory with your inheritance.
verses.zh: 使我见你选民的福，乐你国民的乐，与你的产业一同夸耀。

verses.en: We have sinned with our fathers. We have committed iniquity. We have done wickedly.
verses.zh: 我们与我们的祖宗一同犯罪；我们作了孽，行了恶。

words.g: father, in a literal and immediate + +us/our

verses.en: Our fathers didn’t understand your wonders in Egypt. They didn’t remember the multitude of your loving kindnesses, but were rebellious at the sea, even at the Red Sea.
verses.zh: 我们的祖宗在埃及不明白你的奇事，不记念你丰盛的慈爱，反倒在红海行了悖逆。

words.g: father, in a literal and immediate + +us/our
in + Mitsrajim, i.e. Upper and Lower Egypt
to be  circumspect and hence, intelligent

verses.en: Nevertheless he saved them for his name’s sake, that he might make his mighty power known.
verses.zh: 然而，他因自己的名拯救他们，为要彰显他的大能，

words.g: and + to be open, wide or free + +them/their

verses.en: He rebuked the Red Sea also, and it was dried up; so he led them through the depths, as through a desert.
verses.zh: 并且斥责红海，海便干了；他带领他们经过深处，如同经过旷野。

words.g: and + to parch  i.e.  to desolate, destroy

verses.en: He saved them from the hand of him who hated them, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
verses.zh: 他拯救他们脱离恨他们人的手，从仇敌手中救赎他们。

words.g: and + to be open, wide or free + +them/their
and + to be the next of kin + +them/their

verses.en: The waters covered their adversaries. There was not one of them left.
verses.zh: 水淹没他们的敌人，没有一个存留。

verses.en: Then they believed his words. They sang his praise.
verses.zh: 那时，他们才信了他的话，歌唱赞美他。

verses.en: They soon forgot his works. They didn’t wait for his counsel,
verses.zh: 等不多时，他们就忘了他的作为，不仰望他的指教，

to mislay, i.e. to be oblivious of

verses.en: but gave in to craving in the desert, and tested God in the wasteland.
verses.zh: 反倒在旷野大起欲心，在荒地试探神。

verses.en: He gave them their request, but sent leanness into their soul.
verses.zh: 他将他们所求的赐给他们，却使他们的心灵软弱。

verses.en: They envied Moses also in the camp, and Aaron, the LORD’s saint.
verses.zh: 他们又在营中嫉妒摩西和耶和华的圣者亚伦。

words.g: and + to be  zealous, i.e.  jealous or envious
to + Aharon, the brother of Moses

verses.en: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram.
verses.zh: 地裂开，吞下大坍，掩盖亚比兰一党的人。

words.g: Abiram, the name of two Israelites

verses.en: A fire was kindled in their company. The flame burned up the wicked.
verses.zh: 有火在他们的党中发起；有火焰烧毁了恶人。

verses.en: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshiped a molten image.
verses.zh: 他们在何烈山造了牛犊，叩拜铸成的像。

words.g: a  calf , especially one nearly grown
in + Choreb, a  name for the Sinaitic mountains
to + a pouring over, i.e. fusion of metal

verses.en: Thus they exchanged their glory for an image of a bull that eats grass.
verses.zh: 如此将他们荣耀的主换为吃草之牛的像，

words.g: weight, but only figuratively in a good sense + +them/their

verses.en: They forgot God, their Savior, who had done great things in Egypt,
verses.zh: 忘了神―他们的救主；他曾在埃及行大事，

words.g: to mislay, i.e. to be oblivious of
to be open, wide or free + +them/their

verses.en: wondrous works in the land of Ham, and awesome things by the Red Sea.
verses.zh: 在含地行奇事，在红海行可畏的事。

verses.en: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, had Moses, his chosen, not stood before him in the breach, to turn away his wrath, so that he wouldn’t destroy them.
verses.zh: 所以，他说要灭绝他们；若非有他所拣选的摩西站在当中（原文是破口），使他的忿怒转消，恐怕他就灭绝他们。

verses.en: Yes, they despised the pleasant land. They didn’t believe his word,
verses.zh: 他们又藐视那美地，不信他的话，

verses.en: but murmured in their tents, and didn’t listen to the LORD’s voice.
verses.zh: 在自己帐棚内发怨言，不听耶和华的声音。

verses.en: Therefore he swore to them that he would overthrow them in the wilderness,
verses.zh: 所以，他对他们起誓：必叫他们倒在旷野，

verses.en: that he would overthrow their offspring among the nations, and scatter them in the lands.
verses.zh: 叫他们的后裔倒在列国之中，分散在各地。

verses.en: They joined themselves also to Baal Peor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead.
verses.zh: 他们又与巴力•毗珥连合，且吃了祭死神（或译：人）的物。

verses.en: Thus they provoked him to anger with their deeds. The plague broke in on them.
verses.zh: 他们这样行，惹耶和华发怒，便有瘟疫流行在他们中间。

verses.en: Then Phinehas stood up and executed judgment, so the plague was stopped.
verses.zh: 那时，非尼哈站起，刑罚恶人，瘟疫这才止息。

words.g: Pinechas, the name of three Israelites

verses.en: That was credited to him for righteousness, for all generations to come.
verses.zh: 那就算为他的义，世世代代，直到永远。

verses.en: They angered him also at the waters of Meribah, so that Moses was troubled for their sakes;
verses.zh: 他们在米利巴水又叫耶和华发怒，甚至摩西也受了亏损，

words.g: and + to crack off, i.e.  burst out in rage

verses.en: because they were rebellious against his spirit, he spoke rashly with his lips.
verses.zh: 是因他们惹动他的灵，摩西（原文是他）用嘴说了急躁的话。

verses.en: They didn’t destroy the peoples, as the LORD commanded them,
verses.zh: 他们不照耶和华所吩咐的灭绝外邦人，

verses.en: but mixed themselves with the nations, and learned their works.
verses.zh: 反与他们混杂相合，学习他们的行为，

words.g: and + to goad, i.e.  to teach

verses.en: They served their idols, which became a snare to them.
verses.zh: 事奉他们的偶像，这就成了自己的网罗，

verses.en: Yes, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons.
verses.zh: 把自己的儿女祭祀鬼魔，

verses.en: They shed innocent blood, even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan. The land was polluted with blood.
verses.zh: 流无辜人的血，就是自己儿女的血，把他们祭祀迦南的偶像，那地就被血污秽了。

words.g: and + to soil, especially in a moral sense

verses.en: Thus they were defiled with their works, and prostituted themselves in their deeds.
verses.zh: 这样，他们被自己所做的污秽了，在行为上犯了邪淫。

words.g: and + to be foul, especially in a ceremial or moral sense

verses.en: Therefore the LORD burned with anger against his people. He abhorred his inheritance.
verses.zh: 所以，耶和华的怒气向他的百姓发作，憎恶他的产业，

verses.en: He gave them into the hand of the nations. Those who hated them ruled over them.
verses.zh: 将他们交在外邦人的手里；恨他们的人就辖制他们。

verses.en: Their enemies also oppressed them. They were brought into subjection under their hand.
verses.zh: 他们的仇敌也欺压他们，他们就伏在敌人手下。

words.g: and + to press, i.e.  to distress + +them/their

verses.en: He rescued them many times, but they were rebellious in their counsel, and were brought low in their iniquity.
verses.zh: 他屡次搭救他们，他们却设谋背逆，因自己的罪孽降为卑下。

verses.en: Nevertheless he regarded their distress, when he heard their cry.
verses.zh: 然而，他听见他们哀告的时候，就眷顾他们的急难，

verses.en: He remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.
verses.zh: 为他们记念他的约，照他丰盛的慈爱后悔。

verses.en: He made them also to be pitied by all those who carried them captive.
verses.zh: 他也使他们在凡掳掠他们的人面前蒙怜恤。

verses.en: Save us, LORD, our God, gather us from among the nations, to give thanks to your holy name, to triumph in your praise!
verses.zh: 耶和华―我们的神啊，求你拯救我们，从外邦中招聚我们，我们好称赞你的圣名，以赞美你为夸胜。

words.g: to be open, wide or free + +us/our
to + to address in aloud tone, i.e.  loud

verses.en: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting even to everlasting! Let all the people say, “Amen.” Praise the LORD!
verses.zh: 耶和华―以色列的神是应当称颂的，从亘古直到永远。愿众民都说：阿们！你们要赞美耶和华！

verses.en: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
verses.zh: 你们要称谢耶和华，因他本为善；他的慈爱永远长存！

verses.en: Let the redeemed by the LORD say so, whom he has redeemed from the hand of the adversary,
verses.zh: 愿耶和华的赎民说这话，就是他从敌人手中所救赎的，

words.g: to be the next of kin
to be the next of kin + +them/their

verses.en: and gathered out of the lands, from the east and from the west, from the north and from the south.
verses.zh: 从各地，从东从西，从南从北，所招聚来的。

verses.en: They wandered in the wilderness in a desert way. They found no city to live in.
verses.zh: 他们在旷野荒地漂流，寻不见可住的城邑，

words.g: to vacillate, i.e. reel or stray

verses.en: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.
verses.zh: 又饥又渴，心里发昏。

verses.en: Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses.
verses.zh: 于是，他们在苦难中哀求耶和华；他从他们的祸患中搭救他们，

verses.en: He led them also by a straight way, that they might go to a city to live in.
verses.zh: 又领他们行走直路，使他们往可居住的城邑。

verses.en: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!
verses.zh: 但愿人因耶和华的慈爱和他向人所行的奇事都称赞他；

words.g: and + perhaps to separate, i.e. distinguish + +him/his/it

verses.en: For he satisfies the longing soul. He fills the hungry soul with good.
verses.zh: 因他使心里渴慕的人得以知足，使心里饥饿的人得饱美物。

verses.en: Some sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron,
verses.zh: 那些坐在黑暗中、死荫里的人被困苦和铁链捆锁，

verses.en: because they rebelled against the words of God, and condemned the counsel of the Most High.
verses.zh: 是因他们违背神的话语，藐视至高者的旨意。

verses.en: Therefore he brought down their heart with labor. They fell down, and there was no one to help.
verses.zh: 所以，他用劳苦治服他们的心；他们仆倒，无人扶助。

words.g: to surround, i.e. protect or aid

verses.en: Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.
verses.zh: 于是，他们在苦难中哀求耶和华；他从他们的祸患中拯救他们。

words.g: to be open, wide or free + +them/their

verses.en: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and broke away their chains.
verses.zh: 他从黑暗中和死荫里领他们出来，折断他们的绑索。

verses.en: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!
verses.zh: 但愿人因耶和华的慈爱和他向人所行的奇事都称赞他；

words.g: and + perhaps to separate, i.e. distinguish + +him/his/it

verses.zh: 因为他打破了铜门，砍断了铁闩。

verses.zh: 愚妄人因自己的过犯和自己的罪孽便受苦楚。

verses.en: Their soul abhors all kinds of food. They draw near to the gates of death.
verses.zh: 他们心里厌恶各样的食物，就临近死门。

verses.en: Then they cry to the LORD in their trouble, and he saves them out of their distresses.
verses.zh: 于是，他们在苦难中哀求耶和华；他从他们的祸患中拯救他们。

words.g: to be open, wide or free + +them/their

verses.zh: 他发命医治他们，救他们脱离死亡。

verses.zh: 但愿人因耶和华的慈爱和他向人所行的奇事都称赞他。

words.g: and + perhaps to separate, i.e. distinguish + +him/his/it

verses.zh: 愿他们以感谢为祭献给他，欢呼述说他的作为！

verses.zh: 在海上坐船，在大水中经理事务的，

verses.en: these see the LORD’s deeds, and his wonders in the deep.
verses.zh: 他们看见耶和华的作为，并他在深水中的奇事。

words.g: and + perhaps to separate, i.e. distinguish + +him/his/it

verses.en: For he commands, and raises the stormy wind, which lifts up its waves.
verses.zh: 因他一吩咐，狂风就起来，海中的波浪也扬起。

words.g: and + to be high actively, to rise or raise

verses.en: They mount up to the sky; they go down again to the depths. Their soul melts away because of trouble.
verses.zh: 他们上到天空，下到海底；他们的心因患难便消化。

verses.en: They reel back and forth, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits’ end.
verses.zh: 他们摇摇晃晃，东倒西歪，好像醉酒的人；他们的智慧无法可施。

verses.zh: 于是，他们在苦难中哀求耶和华，他从他们的祸患中领出他们来。

verses.en: He makes the storm a calm, so that its waves are still.
verses.zh: 他使狂风止息，波浪就平静。

words.g: and + to hush or keep quiet

verses.en: Then they are glad because it is calm, so he brings them to their desired haven.
verses.zh: 风息浪静，他们便欢喜；他就引他们到所愿去的海口。

verses.en: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds for the children of men!
verses.zh: 但愿人因耶和华的慈爱和他向人所行的奇事都称赞他。

words.g: and + perhaps to separate, i.e. distinguish + +him/his/it

verses.en: Let them exalt him also in the assembly of the people, and praise him in the seat of the elders.
verses.zh: 愿他们在民的会中尊崇他，在长老的位上赞美他！

words.g: and + to be high actively, to rise or raise + +him/his/it

verses.zh: 他使江河变为旷野，叫水泉变为干渴之地，

words.g: and + a going forth, i.e.  an egress
to + a thirsty place, i.e. desert

verses.en: and a fruitful land into a salt waste, for the wickedness of those who dwell in it.
verses.zh: 使肥地变为硷地；这都因其间居民的罪恶。

verses.en: He turns a desert into a pool of water, and a dry land into water springs.
verses.zh: 他使旷野变为水潭，叫旱地变为水泉。

words.g: to + a going forth, i.e.  an egress

verses.en: There he makes the hungry live, that they may prepare a city to live in,
verses.zh: 他使饥饿的人住在那里，好建造可住的城邑，

verses.en: sow fields, plant vineyards, and reap the fruits of increase.
verses.zh: 又种田地，栽葡萄园，得享所出的土产。

words.g: and + to strike in, i.e. fix

verses.en: He blesses them also, so that they are multiplied greatly. He doesn’t allow their livestock to decrease.
verses.zh: 他又赐福给他们，叫他们生养众多，也不叫他们的牲畜减少。

verses.en: Again, they are diminished and bowed down through oppression, trouble, and sorrow.
verses.zh: 他们又因暴虐、患难、愁苦，就减少且卑下。

words.g: and + to pare off, i.e. lessen

verses.zh: 他使君王蒙羞被辱，使他们在荒废无路之地漂流。

words.g: and + to vacillate, i.e. reel or stray + +them/their

verses.zh: 他却将穷乏人安置在高处，脱离苦难，使他的家属多如羊群。

words.g: and + to set on high, protect

verses.zh: 正直人看见就欢喜；罪孽之辈必塞口无言。

verses.zh: 凡有智慧的，必在这些事上留心，也必思想耶和华的慈爱。

verses.zh: （大卫的诗歌。）

verses.zh: 神啊，我心坚定；我口（原文是荣耀）要唱诗歌颂！

verses.zh: 琴瑟啊，你们当醒起！我自己要极早醒起！

verses.en: I will give thanks to you, LORD, among the nations. I will sing praises to you among the peoples.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，我要在万民中称谢你，在列邦中歌颂你！

verses.en: For your loving kindness is great above the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.
verses.zh: 因为，你的慈爱大过诸天；你的诚实达到穹苍。

verses.en: Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be over all the earth.
verses.zh: 神啊，愿你崇高过于诸天！愿你的荣耀高过全地！

words.g: to be high actively, to rise or raise

verses.zh: 求你应允我们，用右手拯救我们，好叫你所亲爱的人得救。

words.g: to be open, wide or free

verses.zh: 神已经指着他的圣洁说（说：或译应许我）：我要欢乐；我要分开示剑，丈量疏割谷。

words.g: to jump for joy, i.e. exult
Succoth, the name of a place in Egypt and of three in Palestine

verses.en: Gilead is mine. Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is my helmet. Judah is my scepter.
verses.zh: 基列是我的；玛拿西是我的；以法莲是护卫我头的；犹大是我的杖；

words.g: Gilad, a region East of the Jordan
and + Ephrajim, a son of Joseph
Jehudah , the name of five Israelites

verses.en: Moab is my wash pot. I will toss my sandal on Edom. I will shout over Philistia.”
verses.zh: 摩押是我的沐浴盆；我要向以东抛鞋；我必因胜非利士呼喊。

words.g: Moab, an incestuous son of Lot
Edom, the elder twin-brother of Jacob

verses.zh: 谁能领我进坚固城？谁能引我到以东地？

words.g: Edom, the elder twin-brother of Jacob

verses.en: Haven’t you rejected us, God? You don’t go out, God, with our armies.
verses.zh: 神啊，你不是丢弃了我们吗？神啊，你不和我们的军兵同去吗？

verses.en: Give us help against the enemy, for the help of man is vain.
verses.zh: 求你帮助我们攻击敌人，因为人的帮助是枉然的。

verses.en: Through God, we will do valiantly, for it is he who will tread down our enemies.
verses.zh: 我们倚靠神才得施展大能，因为践踏我们敌人的就是他。

verses.en: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. God of my praise, don’t remain silent,
verses.zh: （大卫的诗，交与伶长。）我所赞美的神啊，求你不要闭口不言。

verses.en: for they have opened the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of deceit against me. They have spoken to me with a lying tongue.
verses.zh: 因为恶人的嘴和诡诈人的口已经张开攻击我；他们用撒谎的舌头对我说话。

words.g: the mouth , whether literal or figurative
and + the mouth , whether literal or figurative

verses.en: They have also surrounded me with words of hatred, and fought against me without a cause.
verses.zh: 他们围绕我，说怨恨的话，又无故地攻打我。

verses.en: In return for my love, they are my adversaries; but I am in prayer.
verses.zh: 他们与我为敌以报我爱，但我专心祈祷。

verses.en: They have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.
verses.zh: 他们向我以恶报善，以恨报爱。

verses.en: Set a wicked man over him. Let an adversary stand at his right hand.
verses.zh: 愿你派一个恶人辖制他，派一个对头站在他右边！

verses.en: When he is judged, let him come out guilty. Let his prayer be turned into sin.
verses.zh: 他受审判的时候，愿他出来担当罪名！愿他的祈祷反成为罪！

words.g: to + an offence, or a sacrifice forit

verses.en: Let his days be few. Let another take his office.
verses.zh: 愿他的年日短少！愿别人得他的职分！

verses.en: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.
verses.zh: 愿他的儿女为孤儿，他的妻子为寡妇！

verses.en: Let his children be wandering beggars. Let them be sought from their ruins.
verses.zh: 愿他的儿女漂流讨饭，从他们荒凉之处出来求食！

to waver, in a great variety of applications

verses.en: Let the creditor seize all that he has. Let strangers plunder the fruit of his labor.
verses.zh: 愿强暴的债主牢笼他一切所有的！愿外人抢他劳碌得来的！

verses.zh: 愿无人向他延绵施恩！愿无人可怜他的孤儿！

verses.en: Let his posterity be cut off. In the generation following let their name be blotted out.
verses.zh: 愿他的后人断绝，名字被涂抹，不传于下代！

verses.en: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered by the LORD. Don’t let the sin of his mother be blotted out.
verses.zh: 愿他祖宗的罪孽被耶和华记念！愿他母亲的罪过不被涂抹！

words.g: father, in a literal and immediate + +him/his/it

verses.zh: 愿这些罪常在耶和华面前，使他的名号断绝于世！

verses.en: because he didn’t remember to show kindness, but persecuted the poor and needy man, the broken in heart, to kill them.
verses.zh: 因为他不想施恩，却逼迫困苦穷乏的和伤心的人，要把他们治死。

verses.en: Yes, he loved cursing, and it came to him. He didn’t delight in blessing, and it was far from him.
verses.zh: 他爱咒骂，咒骂就临到他；他不喜爱福乐，福乐就与他远离！

words.g: and + to widen , i.e.  recede or  remove

verses.zh: 他拿咒骂当衣服穿上；这咒骂就如水进他里面，像油入他的骨头。

words.g: in + the nearest part, i.e. the center + +him/his/it

verses.en: Let it be to him as the clothing with which he covers himself, for the belt that is always around him.
verses.zh: 愿这咒骂当他遮身的衣服，当他常束的腰带！

verses.en: This is the reward of my adversaries from the LORD, of those who speak evil against my soul.
verses.zh: 这就是我对头和用恶言议论我的人从耶和华那里所受的报应。

verses.en: But deal with me, GOD the Lord, for your name’s sake, because your loving kindness is good, deliver me;
verses.zh: 主―耶和华啊，求你为你的名恩待我；因你的慈爱美好，求你搭救我！

words.g: and + thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: for I am poor and needy. My heart is wounded within me.
verses.zh: 因为我困苦穷乏，内心受伤。

words.g: in + the nearest part, i.e. the center + +me/my

verses.zh: 我如日影渐渐偏斜而去；我如蝗虫被抖出来。

words.g: like + to stretch or spread out + +him/his/it

verses.en: My knees are weak through fasting. My body is thin and lacks fat.
verses.zh: 我因禁食，膝骨软弱；我身上的肉也渐渐瘦了。

words.g: to be untrue, in word  or deed

verses.en: I have also become a reproach to them. When they see me, they shake their head.
verses.zh: 我受他们的羞辱，他们看见我便摇头。

verses.zh: 耶和华―我的神啊，求你帮助我，照你的慈爱拯救我，

to be open, wide or free + +me/my

verses.en: that they may know that this is your hand; that you, LORD, have done it.
verses.zh: 使他们知道这是你的手，是你―耶和华所行的事。

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: They may curse, but you bless. When they arise, they will be shamed, but your servant shall rejoice.
verses.zh: 任凭他们咒骂，惟愿你赐福；他们几时起来就必蒙羞，你的仆人却要欢喜。

words.g: and + thou and thee, or  ye and you
and + to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed

verses.en: Let my adversaries be clothed with dishonor. Let them cover themselves with their own shame as with a robe.
verses.zh: 愿我的对头披戴羞辱！愿他们以自己的羞愧为外袍遮身！

verses.en: I will give great thanks to the LORD with my mouth. Yes, I will praise him among the multitude.
verses.zh: 我要用口极力称谢耶和华；我要在众人中间赞美他；

words.g: in + the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +me/my

verses.en: For he will stand at the right hand of the needy, to save him from those who judge his soul.
verses.zh: 因为他必站在穷乏人的右边，要救他脱离审判他灵魂的人。

words.g: to + to be open, wide or free

verses.en: A Psalm by David. The LORD says to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies your footstool for your feet.”
verses.zh: （大卫的诗。）耶和华对我主说：你坐在我的右边，等我使你仇敌作你的脚凳。

verses.en: The LORD will send out the rod of your strength out of Zion. Rule among your enemies.
verses.zh: 耶和华必使你从锡安伸出能力的杖来；你要在你仇敌中掌权。

words.g: from + Tsijon , a mountain of Jerusalem
in + the nearest part, i.e. the center

verses.zh: 当你掌权的日子（或译：行军的日子），你的民要以圣洁的妆饰为衣（或译：以圣洁为妆饰），甘心牺牲自己；你的民多如清晨的甘露（或译：你少年时光耀如清晨的甘露）。

in + magnificence, i.e. ornament or splendor

verses.en: The LORD has sworn, and will not change his mind: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”
verses.zh: 耶和华起了誓，决不后悔，说：你是照着麦基洗德的等次永远为祭司。

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you

Malki-Tsedek, an early king in Palestine

verses.zh: 在你右边的主，当他发怒的日子，必打伤列王。

verses.en: He will judge among the nations. He will heap up dead bodies. He will crush the ruler of the whole earth.
verses.zh: 他要在列邦中刑罚恶人，尸首就遍满各处；他要在许多国中打破仇敌的头。

words.g: a straight course, i.e. sail direct
a body, whether alive or dead

verses.zh: 他要喝路旁的河水，因此必抬起头来。

to be high actively, to rise or raise

verses.en: Praise the LORD! I will give thanks to the LORD with my whole heart, in the council of the upright, and in the congregation.
verses.zh: 你们要赞美耶和华！我要在正直人的大会中，并公会中，一心称谢耶和华。

verses.en: The LORD’s works are great, pondered by all those who delight in them.
verses.zh: 耶和华的作为本为大；凡喜爱的都必考察。

verses.en: His work is honor and majesty. His righteousness endures forever.
verses.zh: 他所行的是尊荣和威严；他的公义存到永远。

words.g: and + magnificence, i.e. ornament or splendor

verses.zh: 他行了奇事，使人记念；耶和华有恩惠，有怜悯。

words.g: to + perhaps to separate, i.e. distinguish + +him/his/it

verses.en: He has given food to those who fear him. He always remembers his covenant.
verses.zh: 他赐粮食给敬畏他的人；他必永远记念他的约。

verses.en: He has shown his people the power of his works, in giving them the heritage of the nations.
verses.zh: 他向百姓显出大能的作为，把外邦的地赐给他们为业。

verses.en: The works of his hands are truth and justice. All his precepts are sure.
verses.zh: 他手所行的是诚实公平；他的训词都是确实的，

verses.en: They are established forever and ever. They are done in truth and uprightness.
verses.zh: 是永永远远坚定的，是按诚实正直设立的。

verses.en: He has sent redemption to his people. He has ordained his covenant forever. His name is holy and awesome!
verses.zh: 他向百姓施行救赎，命定他的约，直到永远；他的名圣而可畏。

verses.en: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom. All those who do his work have a good understanding. His praise endures forever!
verses.zh: 敬畏耶和华是智慧的开端；凡遵行他命令的是聪明人。耶和华是永远当赞美的！

verses.en: Praise the LORD! Blessed is the man who fears the LORD, who delights greatly in his commandments.
verses.zh: 你们要赞美耶和华！敬畏耶和华，甚喜爱他命令的，这人便为有福！

verses.zh: 他的后裔在世必强盛；正直人的后代必要蒙福。

verses.en: Wealth and riches are in his house. His righteousness endures forever.
verses.zh: 他家中有货物，有钱财；他的公义存到永远。

verses.en: Light dawns in the darkness for the upright, gracious, merciful, and righteous.
verses.zh: 正直人在黑暗中，有光向他发现；他有恩惠，有怜悯，有公义。

verses.en: It is well with the man who deals graciously and lends. He will maintain his cause in judgment.
verses.zh: 施恩与人、借贷与人的，这人事情顺利；他被审判的时候要诉明自己的冤。

words.g: and + to twine, i.e.  to unite

verses.en: For he will never be shaken. The righteous will be remembered forever.
verses.zh: 他永不动摇；义人被记念，直到永远。

verses.en: He will not be afraid of evil news. His heart is steadfast, trusting in the LORD.
verses.zh: 他必不怕凶恶的信息；他心坚定，倚靠耶和华。

words.g: from + something heard, i.e. an announcement

verses.en: His heart is established. He will not be afraid in the end when he sees his adversaries.
verses.zh: 他心确定，总不惧怕，直到他看见敌人遭报。

verses.en: He has dispersed, he has given to the poor. His righteousness endures forever. His horn will be exalted with honor.
verses.zh: 他施舍钱财，周济贫穷；他的仁义存到永远。他的角必被高举，大有荣耀。

words.g: to scatter, whether in enmity or bounty
to be high actively, to rise or raise
in + weight, but only figuratively in a good sense

verses.en: The wicked will see it, and be grieved. He shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away. The desire of the wicked will perish.
verses.zh: 恶人看见便恼恨，必咬牙而消化；恶人的心愿要归灭绝。

verses.en: Praise the LORD! Praise, you servants of the LORD, praise the LORD’s name.
verses.zh: 你们要赞美耶和华！耶和华的仆人哪，你们要赞美，赞美耶和华的名！

verses.en: Blessed be the LORD’s name, from this time forward and forever more.
verses.zh: 耶和华的名是应当称颂的，从今时直到永远！

verses.en: From the rising of the sun to its going down, the LORD’s name is to be praised.
verses.zh: 从日出之地到日落之处，耶和华的名是应当赞美的！

verses.en: The LORD is high above all nations, his glory above the heavens.
verses.zh: 耶和华超乎万民之上；他的荣耀高过诸天。

words.g: to be high actively, to rise or raise
weight, but only figuratively in a good sense + +him/his/it

verses.en: Who is like the LORD, our God, who has his seat on high,
verses.zh: 谁像耶和华―我们的神呢？他坐在至高之处，

words.g: the + to soar, i.e. be lofty

verses.en: who stoops down to see in heaven and on the earth?
verses.zh: 自己谦卑，观看天上地下的事。

verses.en: He raises up the poor out of the dust, and lifts up the needy from the ash heap,
verses.zh: 他从灰尘里抬举贫寒人，从粪堆中提拔穷乏人，

words.g: from + a heap of rubbish or filth
to be high actively, to rise or raise

verses.en: that he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.
verses.zh: 使他们与王子同坐，就是与本国的王子同坐。

verses.en: He settles the barren woman in her home as a joyful mother of children. Praise the LORD!
verses.zh: 他使不能生育的妇人安居家中，为多子的乐母。你们要赞美耶和华！

verses.en: When Israel went out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of foreign language,
verses.zh: 以色列出了埃及，雅各家离开说异言之民；

words.g: from + Mitsrajim, i.e. Upper and Lower Egypt
to speak in a foreign tongue

verses.en: Judah became his sanctuary, Israel his dominion.
verses.zh: 那时，犹大为主的圣所，以色列为他所治理的国度。

words.g: Jehudah , the name of five Israelites

verses.en: The sea saw it, and fled. The Jordan was driven back.
verses.zh: 沧海看见就奔逃；约旦河也倒流。

words.g: and + to flit, i.e. vanish away
the + Jarden, the principal river of Palestine

verses.zh: 大山踊跃，如公羊；小山跳舞，如羊羔。

verses.zh: 沧海啊，你为何奔逃？约旦哪，你为何倒流？

words.g: the + Jarden, the principal river of Palestine

verses.en: You mountains, that you skipped like rams? You little hills, like lambs?
verses.zh: 大山哪，你为何踊跃，如公羊？小山哪，你为何跳舞，如羊羔？

words.g: to stamp, i.e. to spring about

verses.en: Tremble, you earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob,
verses.zh: 大地啊，你因见主的面，就是雅各神的面，便要震动。

words.g: to twist or whirl , i.e.  to dance

verses.en: who turned the rock into a pool of water, the flint into a spring of waters.
verses.zh: 他叫磐石变为水池，叫坚石变为泉源。

verses.en: Not to us, LORD, not to us, but to your name give glory, for your loving kindness, and for your truth’s sake.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，荣耀不要归与我们，不要归与我们；要因你的慈爱和诚实归在你的名下！

words.g: weight, but only figuratively in a good sense

verses.zh: 为何容外邦人说：他们的神在哪里呢？

verses.en: But our God is in the heavens. He does whatever he pleases.
verses.zh: 然而，我们的神在天上，都随自己的意旨行事。

verses.en: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.
verses.zh: 他们的偶像是金的，银的，是人手所造的，

verses.zh: 有口却不能言，有眼却不能看，

verses.zh: 有耳却不能听，有鼻却不能闻，

verses.zh: 有手却不能摸，有脚却不能走，有喉咙也不能出声。

verses.zh: 造他的要和他一样；凡靠他的也要如此。
