verses.zh: 以色列啊，你要倚靠耶和华！他是你的帮助和你的盾牌。

verses.en: House of Aaron, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.
verses.zh: 亚伦家啊，你们要倚靠耶和华！他是你们的帮助和你们的盾牌。

verses.en: You who fear the LORD, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.
verses.zh: 你们敬畏耶和华的，要倚靠耶和华！他是你们的帮助和你们的盾牌。

verses.en: The LORD remembers us. He will bless us. He will bless the house of Israel. He will bless the house of Aaron.
verses.zh: 耶和华向来眷念我们；他还要赐福给我们：要赐福给以色列的家，赐福给亚伦的家。

verses.en: He will bless those who fear the LORD, both small and great.
verses.zh: 凡敬畏耶和华的，无论大小，主必赐福给他。

verses.en: May the LORD increase you more and more, you and your children.
verses.zh: 愿耶和华叫你们和你们的子孙日见加增。

verses.en: Blessed are you by the LORD, who made heaven and earth.
verses.zh: 你们蒙了造天地之耶和华的福！

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: The heavens are the LORD’s heavens, but he has given the earth to the children of men.
verses.zh: 天，是耶和华的天；地，他却给了世人。

verses.en: The dead don’t praise the LORD, nor any who go down into silence,
verses.zh: 死人不能赞美耶和华；下到寂静中的也都不能。

verses.en: but we will bless the LORD, from this time forward and forever more. Praise the LORD!
verses.zh: 但我们要称颂耶和华，从今时直到永远。你们要赞美耶和华！

verses.en: I love the LORD, because he listens to my voice, and my cries for mercy.
verses.zh: 我爱耶和华，因为他听了我的声音和我的恳求。

verses.en: Because he has turned his ear to me, therefore I will call on him as long as I live.
verses.zh: 他既向我侧耳，我一生要求告他。

verses.en: The cords of death surrounded me, the pains of Sheol got a hold of me. I found trouble and sorrow.
verses.zh: 死亡的绳索缠绕我；阴间的痛苦抓住我；我遭遇患难愁苦。

words.g: a rope , especially a measuring line

verses.en: Then I called on the LORD’s name: “LORD, I beg you, deliver my soul.”
verses.zh: 那时，我便求告耶和华的名，说：耶和华啊，求你救我的灵魂！

words.g: to be smooth, i.e.  to escape

verses.en: The LORD is gracious and righteous. Yes, our God is merciful.
verses.zh: 耶和华有恩惠，有公义；我们的神以怜悯为怀。

verses.en: The LORD preserves the simple. I was brought low, and he saved me.
verses.zh: 耶和华保护愚人；我落到卑微的地步，他救了我。

words.g: to be open, wide or free

verses.en: Return to your rest, my soul, for the LORD has dealt bountifully with you.
verses.zh: 我的心哪！你要仍归安乐，因为耶和华用厚恩待你。

words.g: to treat a person , i.e. benefit or requite

verses.en: For you have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.
verses.zh: 主啊，你救我的命免了死亡，救我的眼免了流泪，救我的脚免了跌倒。

words.g: from + a push, i.e.  a fall

verses.en: I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.
verses.zh: 我要在耶和华面前行活人之路。

verses.en: I believed, therefore I said, “I was greatly afflicted.”
verses.zh: 我因信，所以如此说话；我受了极大的困苦。

verses.en: I said in my haste, “All people are liars.”
verses.zh: 我曾急促地说：人都是说谎的！

words.g: in + to start up suddenly, i.e.  to hasten away + +me/my

verses.en: What will I give to the LORD for all his benefits toward me?
verses.zh: 我拿甚么报答耶和华向我所赐的一切厚恩？

verses.en: I will take the cup of salvation, and call on the LORD’s name.
verses.zh: 我要举起救恩的杯，称扬耶和华的名。

verses.en: I will pay my vows to the LORD, yes, in the presence of all his people.
verses.zh: 我要在他众民面前向耶和华还我的愿。

verses.en: Precious in the LORD’s sight is the death of his saints.
verses.zh: 在耶和华眼中，看圣民之死极为宝贵。

verses.en: LORD, truly I am your servant. I am your servant, the son of your servant girl. You have freed me from my chains.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，我真是你的仆人；我是你的仆人，是你婢女的儿子。你已经解开我的绑索。

verses.en: I will offer to you the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call on the LORD’s name.
verses.zh: 我要以感谢为祭献给你，又要求告耶和华的名。

verses.en: I will pay my vows to the LORD, yes, in the presence of all his people,
verses.zh: 我要在他众民面前，在耶和华殿的院内，在耶路撒冷当中，向耶和华还我的愿。你们要赞美耶和华！

verses.en: in the courts of the LORD’s house, in the middle of you, Jerusalem. Praise the LORD!
verses.zh: a

words.g: Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine

verses.en: Praise the LORD, all you nations! Extol him, all you peoples!
verses.zh: 万国啊，你们都当赞美耶和华！万民哪，你们都当颂赞他！

words.g: to address in aloud tone, i.e.  loud + +him/his/it
the + a collection, i.e. community of persons

verses.en: For his loving kindness is great toward us. The LORD’s faithfulness endures forever. Praise the LORD!
verses.zh: 因为他向我们大施慈爱；耶和华的诚实存到永远。你们要赞美耶和华！

verses.en: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
verses.zh: 你们要称谢耶和华，因他本为善；他的慈爱永远长存！

verses.en: Let Israel now say that his loving kindness endures forever.
verses.zh: 愿以色列说：他的慈爱永远长存！

verses.en: Let the house of Aaron now say that his loving kindness endures forever.
verses.zh: 愿亚伦的家说：他的慈爱永远长存！

verses.en: Now let those who fear the LORD say that his loving kindness endures forever.
verses.zh: 愿敬畏耶和华的说：他的慈爱永远长存！

verses.en: Out of my distress, I called on the LORD. The LORD answered me with freedom.
verses.zh: 我在急难中求告耶和华，他就应允我，把我安置在宽阔之地。

verses.en: The LORD is on my side. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
verses.zh: 有耶和华帮助我，我必不惧怕，人能把我怎么样呢？

verses.en: The LORD is on my side among those who help me. Therefore I will look in triumph at those who hate me.
verses.zh: 在那帮助我的人中，有耶和华帮助我，所以我要看见那恨我的人遭报。

words.g: in + to surround, i.e. protect or aid + +me/my

verses.en: It is better to take refuge in the LORD, than to put confidence in man.
verses.zh: 投靠耶和华，强似倚赖人；

verses.en: It is better to take refuge in the LORD, than to put confidence in princes.
verses.zh: 投靠耶和华，强似倚赖王子。

verses.en: All the nations surrounded me, but in the LORD’s name I cut them off.
verses.zh: 万民围绕我，我靠耶和华的名必剿灭他们。

verses.en: They surrounded me, yes, they surrounded me. In the LORD’s name I indeed cut them off.
verses.zh: 他们环绕我，围困我，我靠耶和华的名必剿灭他们。

verses.en: They surrounded me like bees. They are quenched like the burning thorns. In the LORD’s name I cut them off.
verses.zh: 他们如同蜂子围绕我，好像烧荆棘的火，必被熄灭；我靠耶和华的名，必剿灭他们。

verses.en: You pushed me back hard, to make me fall, but the LORD helped me.
verses.zh: 你推我，要叫我跌倒，但耶和华帮助了我。

words.g: to surround, i.e. protect or aid + +me/my

verses.en: The LORD is my strength and song. He has become my salvation.
verses.zh: 耶和华是我的力量，是我的诗歌；他也成了我的拯救。

verses.en: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tents of the righteous. “The right hand of the LORD does valiantly.
verses.zh: 在义人的帐棚里，有欢呼拯救的声音；耶和华的右手施展大能。

words.g: probably a force, whether of men

verses.en: The right hand of the LORD is exalted! The right hand of the LORD does valiantly!”
verses.zh: 耶和华的右手高举；耶和华的右手施展大能。

words.g: probably a force, whether of men

verses.en: I will not die, but live, and declare the LORD’s works.
verses.zh: 我必不致死，仍要存活，并要传扬耶和华的作为。

words.g: to live, whether literally or figuratively
and + to score with a mark as a tally or record, i.e.  to inscribe

verses.en: The LORD has punished me severely, but he has not given me over to death.
verses.zh: 耶和华虽严严地惩治我，却未曾将我交于死亡。

verses.en: Open to me the gates of righteousness. I will enter into them. I will give thanks to the LORD.
verses.zh: 给我敞开义门；我要进去称谢耶和华！

verses.en: This is the gate of the LORD; the righteous will enter into it.
verses.zh: 这是耶和华的门；义人要进去！

verses.en: I will give thanks to you, for you have answered me, and have become my salvation.
verses.zh: 我要称谢你，因为你已经应允我，又成了我的拯救！

verses.en: The stone which the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.
verses.zh: 匠人所弃的石头已成了房角的头块石头。

verses.en: This is the LORD’s doing. It is marvelous in our eyes.
verses.zh: 这是耶和华所做的，在我们眼中看为希奇。

verses.en: This is the day that the LORD has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it!
verses.zh: 这是耶和华所定的日子，我们在其中要高兴欢喜！

words.g: to spin round , i.e. usually rejoice

verses.en: Save us now, we beg you, LORD! LORD, we beg you, send prosperity now.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，求你拯救！耶和华啊，求你使我们亨通！

words.g: to be open, wide or free
to push forward, in various senses

verses.en: Blessed is he who comes in the LORD’s name! We have blessed you out of the LORD’s house.
verses.zh: 奉耶和华名来的是应当称颂的！我们从耶和华的殿中为你们祝福！

verses.en: The LORD is God, and he has given us light. Bind the sacrifice with cords, even to the horns of the altar.
verses.zh: 耶和华是神；他光照了我们。理当用绳索把祭牲拴住，牵到坛角那里。

words.g: a festival, or a victim therefor
in + something intwined, i.e. a string

verses.en: You are my God, and I will give thanks to you. You are my God, I will exalt you.
verses.zh: 你是我的神，我要称谢你！你是我的神，我要尊崇你！

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you
to be high actively, to rise or raise + +you/your

verses.en: Oh give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
verses.zh: 你们要称谢耶和华，因他本为善；他的慈爱永远长存！

verses.en: Blessed are those whose ways are blameless, who walk according to the LORD’s law.
verses.zh: 行为完全、遵行耶和华律法的，这人便为有福！

verses.en: Blessed are those who keep his statutes, who seek him with their whole heart.
verses.zh: 遵守他的法度、一心寻求他的，这人便为有福！

words.g: to guard, in a good sense  or a bad one

verses.en: Yes, they do nothing wrong. They walk in his ways.
verses.zh: 这人不做非义的事，但遵行他的道。

words.g: to do or make , especially to practise

verses.en: You have commanded your precepts, that we should fully obey them.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，你曾将你的训词吩咐我们，为要我们殷勤遵守。

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: Oh that my ways were steadfast to obey your statutes!
verses.zh: 但愿我行事坚定，得以遵守你的律例。

verses.en: Then I wouldn’t be disappointed, when I consider all of your commandments.
verses.zh: 我看重你的一切命令，就不至于羞愧。

words.g: to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed
a command, whether human or divine + +you/your

verses.en: I will give thanks to you with uprightness of heart, when I learn your righteous judgments.
verses.zh: 我学了你公义的判语，就要以正直的心称谢你。

words.g: in + to goad, i.e.  to teach + +me/my

verses.en: I will observe your statutes. Don’t utterly forsake me.
verses.zh: 我必守你的律例；求你总不要丢弃我！

verses.en: How can a young man keep his way pure? By living according to your word.
verses.zh: 少年人用甚么洁净他的行为呢？是要遵行你的话！

words.g: a boy , from the age of infancy to adolescence

verses.en: With my whole heart I have sought you. Don’t let me wander from your commandments.
verses.zh: 我一心寻求了你；求你不要叫我偏离你的命令。

words.g: from + a command, whether human or divine + +you/your

verses.en: I have hidden your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you.
verses.zh: 我将你的话藏在心里，免得我得罪你。

verses.en: Blessed are you, LORD. Teach me your statutes.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，你是应当称颂的！求你将你的律例教训我！

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: With my lips, I have declared all the ordinances of your mouth.
verses.zh: 我用嘴唇传扬你口中的一切典章。

words.g: to score with a mark as a tally or record, i.e.  to inscribe
the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +you/your

verses.en: I have rejoiced in the way of your testimonies, as much as in all riches.
verses.zh: 我喜悦你的法度，如同喜悦一切的财物。

verses.en: I will meditate on your precepts, and consider your ways.
verses.zh: 我要默想你的训词，看重你的道路。

words.g: to ponder, i.e.  converse  or  utter

verses.en: I will delight myself in your statutes. I will not forget your word.
verses.zh: 我要在你的律例中自乐；我不忘记你的话。

words.g: to mislay, i.e. to be oblivious of

verses.en: Do good to your servant. I will live and I will obey your word.
verses.zh: 求你用厚恩待你的仆人，使我存活，我就遵守你的话。

words.g: to treat a person , i.e. benefit or requite
to live, whether literally or figuratively

verses.en: Open my eyes, that I may see wondrous things out of your law.
verses.zh: 求你开我的眼睛，使我看出你律法中的奇妙。

verses.en: I am a stranger on the earth. Don’t hide your commandments from me.
verses.zh: 我是在地上作寄居的；求你不要向我隐瞒你的命令！

words.g: a command, whether human or divine + +you/your

verses.en: My soul is consumed with longing for your ordinances at all times.
verses.zh: 我时常切慕你的典章，甚至心碎。

verses.en: You have rebuked the proud who are cursed, who wander from your commandments.
verses.zh: 受咒诅、偏离你命令的骄傲人，你已经责备他们。

words.g: the + to stray , usually  to mistake
from + a command, whether human or divine + +you/your

verses.en: Take reproach and contempt away from me, for I have kept your statutes.
verses.zh: 求你除掉我所受的羞辱和藐视，因我遵守你的法度。

words.g: to guard, in a good sense  or a bad one

verses.en: Though princes sit and slander me, your servant will meditate on your statutes.
verses.zh: 虽有首领坐着妄论我，你仆人却思想你的律例。

words.g: to ponder, i.e.  converse  or  utter

verses.en: Indeed your statutes are my delight, and my counselors.
verses.zh: 你的法度是我所喜乐的，是我的谋士。

verses.en: My soul is laid low in the dust. Revive me according to your word!
verses.zh: 我的性命几乎归于尘土；求你照你的话将我救活！

words.g: to impinge, i.e. cling or adhere
to live, whether literally or figuratively + +me/my

verses.en: I declared my ways, and you answered me. Teach me your statutes.
verses.zh: 我述说我所行的，你应允了我；求你将你的律例教训我！

words.g: to score with a mark as a tally or record, i.e.  to inscribe

verses.en: Let me understand the teaching of your precepts! Then I will meditate on your wondrous works.
verses.zh: 求你使我明白你的训词，我就思想你的奇事。

words.g: and + to ponder, i.e.  converse  or  utter
in + perhaps to separate, i.e. distinguish + +you/your

verses.en: My soul is weary with sorrow; strengthen me according to your word.
verses.zh: 我的心因愁苦而消化；求你照你的话使我坚立！

verses.en: Keep me from the way of deceit. Grant me your law graciously!
verses.zh: 求你使我离开奸诈的道，开恩将你的律法赐给我！

verses.en: I have chosen the way of truth. I have set your ordinances before me.
verses.zh: 我拣选了忠信的道，将你的典章摆在我面前。

verses.en: I cling to your statutes, LORD. Don’t let me be disappointed.
verses.zh: 我持守你的法度；耶和华啊，求你不要叫我羞愧！

words.g: to impinge, i.e. cling or adhere
to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed + +me/my

verses.en: I run in the path of your commandments, for you have set my heart free.
verses.zh: 你开广我心的时候，我就往你命令的道上直奔。

words.g: a command, whether human or divine + +you/your

verses.en: Teach me, LORD, the way of your statutes. I will keep them to the end.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，求你将你的律例指教我，我必遵守到底！

words.g: and + to guard, in a good sense  or a bad one + +her/its
a heel, i.e.  the last of anything

verses.en: Give me understanding, and I will keep your law. Yes, I will obey it with my whole heart.
verses.zh: 求你赐我悟性，我便遵守你的律法，且要一心遵守。

words.g: and + to guard, in a good sense  or a bad one

verses.en: Direct me in the path of your commandments, for I delight in them.
verses.zh: 求你叫我遵行你的命令，因为这是我所喜乐的。

words.g: a command, whether human or divine + +you/your

verses.en: Turn my heart toward your statutes, not toward selfish gain.
verses.zh: 求你使我的心趋向你的法度，不趋向非义之财。

verses.en: Turn my eyes away from looking at worthless things. Revive me in your ways.
verses.zh: 求你叫我转眼不看虚假，又叫我在你的道中生活。

words.g: to live, whether literally or figuratively + +me/my

verses.en: Fulfill your promise to your servant, that you may be feared.
verses.zh: 你向敬畏你的人所应许的话，求你向仆人坚定！

verses.en: Take away my disgrace that I dread, for your ordinances are good.
verses.zh: 求你使我所怕的羞辱远离我，因你的典章本为美。

verses.en: Behold, I long for your precepts! Revive me in your righteousness.
verses.zh: 我羡慕你的训词；求你使我在你的公义上生活！

words.g: to live, whether literally or figuratively + +me/my

verses.en: Let your loving kindness also come to me, LORD, your salvation, according to your word.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，愿你照你的话，使你的慈爱，就是你的救恩，临到我身上，

verses.en: So I will have an answer for him who reproaches me, for I trust in your word.
verses.zh: 我就有话回答那羞辱我的，因我倚靠你的话。

words.g: to pull off, i.e.  to expose + +me/my

verses.en: Don’t snatch the word of truth out of my mouth, for I put my hope in your ordinances.
verses.zh: 求你叫真理的话总不离开我口，因我仰望你的典章。

words.g: from + the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +me/my

verses.en: So I will obey your law continually, forever and ever.
verses.zh: 我要常守你的律法，直到永永远远。

verses.en: I will walk in liberty, for I have sought your precepts.
verses.zh: 我要自由而行（或译：我要行在宽阔之地），因我素来考究你的训词。

verses.en: I will also speak of your statutes before kings, and will not be disappointed.
verses.zh: 我也要在君王面前论说你的法度，并不至于羞愧。

words.g: to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed

verses.en: I will delight myself in your commandments, because I love them.
verses.zh: 我要在你的命令中自乐；这命令素来是我所爱的。

words.g: and + to look upon , i.e. fondle
in + a command, whether human or divine + +you/your

verses.en: I reach out my hands for your commandments, which I love. I will meditate on your statutes.
verses.zh: 我又要遵行（原文是举手）你的命令，这命令素来是我所爱的；我也要思想你的律例。

words.g: a command, whether human or divine + +you/your
and + to ponder, i.e.  converse  or  utter

verses.en: Remember your word to your servant, because you gave me hope.
verses.zh: 求你记念向你仆人所应许的话，叫我有盼望。

verses.en: This is my comfort in my affliction, for your word has revived me.
verses.zh: 这话将我救活了；我在患难中，因此得安慰。

words.g: to live, whether literally or figuratively + +me/my

verses.en: The arrogant mock me excessively, but I don’t swerve from your law.
verses.zh: 骄傲的人甚侮慢我，我却未曾偏离你的律法。

verses.en: I remember your ordinances of old, LORD, and have comforted myself.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，我记念你从古以来的典章，就得了安慰。

verses.en: Indignation has taken hold on me, because of the wicked who forsake your law.
verses.zh: 我见恶人离弃你的律法，就怒气发作，犹如火烧。

verses.en: Your statutes have been my songs in the house where I live.
verses.zh: 我在世寄居，素来以你的律例为诗歌。

words.g: a song to be accompanied with instrumental music

verses.en: I have remembered your name, LORD, in the night, and I obey your law.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，我夜间记念你的名，遵守你的律法。

verses.en: This is my way, that I keep your precepts.
verses.zh: 我所以如此，是因我守你的训词。

words.g: to guard, in a good sense  or a bad one

verses.en: The LORD is my portion. I promised to obey your words.
verses.zh: 耶和华是我的福分；我曾说，我要遵守你的言语。

verses.en: I sought your favor with my whole heart. Be merciful to me according to your word.
verses.zh: 我一心求过你的恩；愿你照你的话怜悯我！

verses.en: I considered my ways, and turned my steps to your statutes.
verses.zh: 我思想我所行的道，就转步归向你的法度。

verses.en: I will hurry, and not delay, to obey your commandments.
verses.zh: 我急忙遵守你的命令，并不迟延。

words.g: to question or hesitate, i.e.  to be reluctant
a command, whether human or divine + +you/your

verses.en: The ropes of the wicked bind me, but I won’t forget your law.
verses.zh: 恶人的绳索缠绕我，我却没有忘记你的律法。

words.g: a rope , especially a measuring line
to mislay, i.e. to be oblivious of

verses.en: At midnight I will rise to give thanks to you, because of your righteous ordinances.
verses.zh: 我因你公义的典章，半夜必起来称谢你。

verses.zh: 凡敬畏你、守你训词的人，我都与他作伴。

verses.en: The earth is full of your loving kindness, LORD. Teach me your statutes.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，你的慈爱遍满大地；求你将你的律例教训我！

verses.en: You have treated your servant well, according to your word, LORD.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，你向来是照你的话善待仆人。

verses.zh: 求你将精明和知识赐给我，因我信了你的命令。

verses.zh: 我未受苦以先走迷了路，现在却遵守你的话。

verses.zh: 你本为善，所行的也善；求你将你的律例教训我！

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.zh: 骄傲人编造谎言攻击我，我却要一心守你的训词。

verses.zh: 我受苦是与我有益，为要使我学习你的律例。

verses.en: The law of your mouth is better to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver.
verses.zh: 你口中的训言（或译：律法）与我有益，胜于千万的金银。

verses.zh: 你的手制造我，建立我；求你赐我悟性，可以学习你的命令！

verses.zh: 敬畏你的人见我就要欢喜，因我仰望你的话。

verses.en: LORD, I know that your judgments are righteous, that in faithfulness you have afflicted me.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，我知道你的判语是公义的；你使我受苦是以诚实待我。

verses.en: Please let your loving kindness be for my comfort, according to your word to your servant.
verses.zh: 求你照着应许仆人的话，以慈爱安慰我。

verses.en: Let your tender mercies come to me, that I may live; for your law is my delight.

verses.zh: 愿骄傲人蒙羞，因为他们无理地倾覆我；但我要思想你的训词。

verses.zh: 愿敬畏你的人归向我，他们就知道你的法度。

verses.en: Let my heart be blameless toward your decrees, that I may not be disappointed.
verses.zh: 愿我的心在你的律例上完全，使我不致蒙羞。

words.g: to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed

verses.en: For I have become like a wineskin in the smoke. I don’t forget your statutes.
verses.zh: 我好像烟薰的皮袋，却不忘记你的律例。

verses.zh: 你仆人的年日有多少呢？你几时向逼迫我的人施行审判呢？

verses.zh: 不从你律法的骄傲人为我掘了坑。

verses.zh: 他们几乎把我从世上灭绝，但我没有离弃你的训词。

words.g: to end, whether intransitive  or transitived + +me/my

verses.zh: 求你照你的慈爱将我救活，我就遵守你口中的法度。

verses.zh: 耶和华啊，你的话安定在天，直到永远。

verses.zh: 你的诚实存到万代；你坚定了地，地就长存。

verses.zh: 天地照你的安排存到今日；万物都是你的仆役。

verses.zh: 我若不是喜爱你的律法，早就在苦难中灭绝了！

verses.zh: 我永不忘记你的训词，因你用这训词将我救活了。

verses.zh: 我没有偏离你的典章，因为你教训了我。

verses.zh: 我藉着你的训词得以明白，所以我恨一切的假道。

verses.en: Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.
verses.zh: 你的话是我脚前的灯，是我路上的光。

verses.en: I have sworn, and have confirmed it, that I will obey your righteous ordinances.
verses.zh: 你公义的典章，我曾起誓遵守，我必按誓而行。

words.g: to live, whether literally or figuratively + +me/my

verses.zh: 我的性命常在危险之中，我却不忘记你的律法。

verses.zh: 恶人为我设下网罗，我却没有偏离你的训词。

verses.zh: 我以你的法度为永远的产业，因这是我心中所喜爱的。

verses.zh: 我的心专向你的律例，永远遵行，一直到底。

verses.zh: 心怀二意的人为我所恨；但你的律法为我所爱。

verses.zh: 你是我藏身之处，又是我的盾牌；我甚仰望你的话语。

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.zh: 凡偏离你律例的人，你都轻弃他们，因为他们的诡诈必归虚空。

verses.zh: 凡地上的恶人，你除掉他，好像除掉渣滓；因此我爱你的法度。

words.g: to repose, i.e. desist from exertion

verses.en: My eyes fail looking for your salvation, for your righteous word.
verses.zh: 我因盼望你的救恩和你公义的话眼睛失明。

words.g: to end, whether intransitive  or transitived

verses.zh: 求你照你的慈爱待仆人，将你的律例教训我。

verses.zh: 我是你的仆人，求你赐我悟性，使我得知你的法度。

verses.zh: 你一切的训词，在万事上我都以为正直；我却恨恶一切假道。

verses.en: Your testimonies are wonderful, therefore my soul keeps them.
verses.zh: 你的法度奇妙，所以我一心谨守。

verses.zh: 你的言语一解开就发出亮光，使愚人通达。

verses.zh: 我张口而气喘，因我切慕你的命令。

words.g: the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +me/my
to + a command, whether human or divine + +you/your

verses.zh: 求你转向我，怜悯我，好像你素常待那些爱你名的人。

verses.en: Establish my footsteps in your word. Don’t let any iniquity have dominion over me.
verses.zh: 求你用你的话使我脚步稳当，不许甚么罪孽辖制我。

verses.en: Redeem me from the oppression of man, so I will observe your precepts.
verses.zh: 求你救我脱离人的欺压，我要遵守你的训词。

verses.en: Make your face shine on your servant. Teach me your statutes.
verses.zh: 求你用脸光照仆人，又将你的律例教训我。

words.g: and + to goad, i.e.  to teach + +me/my

verses.zh: 耶和华啊，你是公义的；你的判语也是正直的！

verses.zh: 你所命定的法度是凭公义和至诚。

verses.en: My zeal wears me out, because my enemies ignore your words.
verses.zh: 我心焦急，如同火烧，因我敌人忘记你的言语。

verses.zh: 你的话极其精炼，所以你的仆人喜爱。

verses.en: I am small and despised. I don’t forget your precepts.
verses.zh: 我微小，被人藐视，却不忘记你的训词。

verses.zh: 你的公义永远长存；你的律法尽都真实。

verses.en: Trouble and anguish have taken hold of me. Your commandments are my delight.
verses.zh: 我遭遇患难愁苦，你的命令却是我所喜爱的。

verses.zh: 耶和华啊，我一心呼吁你；求你应允我，我必谨守你的律例！

verses.zh: 我趁夜更未换将眼睁开，为要思想你的话语。

verses.zh: 我因学你的法度，久已知道是你永远立定的。

verses.zh: 求你看顾我的苦难，搭救我，因我不忘记你的律法。

verses.zh: 你话的总纲是真实；你一切公义的典章是永远长存。

verses.zh: 首领无故地逼迫我，但我的心畏惧你的言语。

verses.en: I rejoice at your word, as one who finds great plunder.
verses.zh: 我喜爱你的话，好像人得了许多掳物。

verses.zh: 谎话是我所恨恶所憎嫌的；惟你的律法是我所爱的。

verses.zh: 我因你公义的典章一天七次赞美你。

verses.zh: 我遵守了你的训词和法度，因我一切所行的都在你面前。

verses.zh: 愿我的舌头歌唱你的话，因你一切的命令尽都公义。

words.g: a command, whether human or divine + +you/your

verses.en: Let your hand be ready to help me, for I have chosen your precepts.
verses.zh: 愿你用手帮助我，因我拣选了你的训词。

words.g: to + to surround, i.e. protect or aid + +me/my

verses.en: I have longed for your salvation, LORD. Your law is my delight.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，我切慕你的救恩！你的律法也是我所喜爱的。

verses.en: Let my soul live, that I may praise you. Let your ordinances help me.
verses.zh: 愿我的性命存活，得以赞美你！愿你的典章帮助我！

words.g: to live, whether literally or figuratively
to surround, i.e. protect or aid + +me/my

verses.en: I have gone astray like a lost sheep. Seek your servant, for I don’t forget your commandments.
verses.zh: 我如亡羊走迷了路，求你寻找仆人，因我不忘记你的命令。

words.g: to vacillate, i.e. reel or stray
like + a member of a flock, i.e. a sheep or goat
a command, whether human or divine + +you/your
to mislay, i.e. to be oblivious of

verses.en: A Song of Ascents. In my distress, I cried to the LORD. He answered me.
verses.zh: （上行（或作登阶，下同）之诗。）我在急难中求告耶和华，他就应允我。

verses.en: Deliver my soul, LORD, from lying lips, from a deceitful tongue.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，求你救我脱离说谎的嘴唇和诡诈的舌头！

verses.en: What will be given to you, and what will be done more to you, you deceitful tongue?
verses.zh: 诡诈的舌头啊，要给你甚么呢？要拿甚么加给你呢？

verses.en: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.
verses.zh: 就是勇士的利箭和罗腾木（小树名，松类）的炭火。

verses.en: Woe is me, that I live in Meshech, that I dwell among the tents of Kedar!
verses.zh: 我寄居在米设，住在基达帐棚之中，有祸了！

words.g: to turn aside from the road , i.e. sojourn

verses.en: My soul has had her dwelling too long with him who hates peace.
verses.zh: 我与那恨恶和睦的人许久同住。

verses.en: I am for peace, but when I speak, they are for war.
verses.zh: 我愿和睦，但我发言，他们就要争战。

verses.en: A Song of Ascents. I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from?
verses.zh: （上行之诗。）我要向山举目；我的帮助从何而来？

words.n: essa — 'I lift'. From nasa, the verb you met in Jonah; the aleph prefix is what makes it 'I'.

verses.en: My help comes from the LORD, who made heaven and earth.
verses.zh: 我的帮助从造天地的耶和华而来。

verses.en: He will not allow your foot to be moved. He who keeps you will not slumber.
verses.zh: 他必不叫你的脚摇动；保护你的必不打盹！

verses.en: Behold, he who keeps Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.
verses.zh: 保护以色列的，也不打盹也不睡觉。

words.n: yishan — 'sleeps'. The psalm says it twice: he neither slumbers (yanum) nor sleeps. Hebrew poetry likes saying things twice, slightly differently.

verses.en: The LORD is your keeper. The LORD is your shade on your right hand.
verses.zh: 保护你的是耶和华；耶和华在你右边荫庇你。

verses.en: The sun will not harm you by day, nor the moon by night.
verses.zh: 白日，太阳必不伤你；夜间，月亮必不害你。

verses.en: The LORD will keep you from all evil. He will keep your soul.
verses.zh: 耶和华要保护你，免受一切的灾害；他要保护你的性命。

verses.en: The LORD will keep your going out and your coming in, from this time forward, and forever more.
verses.zh: 你出你入，耶和华要保护你，从今时直到永远。

verses.en: A Song of Ascents. By David. I was glad when they said to me, “Let’s go to the LORD’s house!”
verses.zh: （大卫上行之诗。）人对我说：我们往耶和华的殿去，我就欢喜。

verses.en: Our feet are standing within your gates, Jerusalem!
verses.zh: 耶路撒冷啊，我们的脚站在你的门内。

words.g: Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine

verses.en: Jerusalem is built as a city that is compact together,
verses.zh: 耶路撒冷被建造，如同连络整齐的一座城。

words.g: Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine

verses.en: where the tribes go up, even the LORD’s tribes, according to an ordinance for Israel, to give thanks to the LORD’s name.
verses.zh: 众支派，就是耶和华的支派，上那里去，按以色列的常例（或译：作以色列的证据）称赞耶和华的名。

verses.en: For there are set thrones for judgment, the thrones of David’s house.
verses.zh: 因为在那里设立审判的宝座，就是大卫家的宝座。

verses.en: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem. Those who love you will prosper.
verses.zh: 你们要为耶路撒冷求平安！耶路撒冷啊，爱你的人必然兴旺！

words.g: Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine
to be tranquil, i.e. secure or successful

verses.en: Peace be within your walls, and prosperity within your palaces.
verses.zh: 愿你城中平安！愿你宫内兴旺！

verses.en: For my brothers’ and companions’ sakes, I will now say, “Peace be within you.”
verses.zh: 因我弟兄和同伴的缘故，我要说：愿平安在你中间！

verses.en: For the sake of the house of the LORD our God, I will seek your good.
verses.zh: 因耶和华―我们神殿的缘故，我要为你求福！

verses.en: A Song of Ascents. I lift up my eyes to you, you who sit in the heavens.
verses.zh: （上行之诗。）坐在天上的主啊，我向你举目。

verses.en: Behold, as the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a maid to the hand of her mistress, so our eyes look to the LORD, our God, until he has mercy on us.
verses.zh: 看哪，仆人的眼睛怎样望主人的手，使女的眼睛怎样望主母的手，我们的眼睛也照样望耶和华―我们的神，直到他怜悯我们。

verses.en: Have mercy on us, LORD, have mercy on us, for we have endured much contempt.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，求你怜悯我们，怜悯我们！因为我们被藐视，已到极处。

verses.en: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scoffing of those who are at ease, with the contempt of the proud.
verses.zh: 我们被那些安逸人的讥诮和骄傲人的藐视，已到极处。

verses.en: A Song of Ascents. By David. If it had not been the LORD who was on our side, let Israel now say,
verses.zh: （大卫上行之诗。）以色列人要说：若不是耶和华帮助我们，

verses.en: if it had not been the LORD who was on our side, when men rose up against us,
verses.zh: 若不是耶和华帮助我们，当人起来攻击我们、

verses.en: then they would have swallowed us up alive, when their wrath was kindled against us,
verses.zh: 向我们发怒的时候，就把我们活活地吞了。

verses.en: then the waters would have overwhelmed us, the stream would have gone over our soul.
verses.zh: 那时，波涛必漫过我们，河水必淹没我们，

words.g: a stream, especially a winter torrent

verses.en: Then the proud waters would have gone over our soul.
verses.zh: 狂傲的水必淹没我们。

words.g: the + boiling of water, i.e. wave

verses.en: Blessed be the LORD, who has not given us as a prey to their teeth.
verses.zh: 耶和华是应当称颂的！他没有把我们当野食交给他们吞吃（原文是牙齿）。

verses.en: Our soul has escaped like a bird out of the fowler’s snare. The snare is broken, and we have escaped.
verses.zh: 我们好像雀鸟，从捕鸟人的网罗里逃脱；网罗破裂，我们逃脱了。

words.g: to be smooth, i.e.  to escape
to be smooth, i.e.  to escape

verses.en: Our help is in the LORD’s name, who made heaven and earth.
verses.zh: 我们得帮助，是在乎倚靠造天地之耶和华的名。

verses.en: A Song of Ascents. Those who trust in the LORD are as Mount Zion, which can’t be moved, but remains forever.
verses.zh: （上行之诗。）倚靠耶和华的人好像锡安山，永不动摇。

verses.en: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the LORD surrounds his people from this time forward and forever more.
verses.zh: 众山怎样围绕耶路撒冷，耶和华也照样围绕他的百姓，从今时直到永远。

words.g: Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine

verses.en: For the scepter of wickedness won’t remain over the allotment of the righteous, so that the righteous won’t use their hands to do evil.
verses.zh: 恶人的杖不常落在义人的分上，免得义人伸手作恶。

verses.en: Do good, LORD, to those who are good, to those who are upright in their hearts.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，求你善待那些为善和心里正直的人。

words.g: to be  good  in the widest sense

verses.en: But as for those who turn away to their crooked ways, the LORD will lead them away with the workers of iniquity. Peace be on Israel.
verses.zh: 至于那偏行弯曲道路的人，耶和华必使他和作恶的人一同出去受刑。愿平安归于以色列！

words.g: and + the + to stretch or spread out
to do or make , especially to practise

verses.en: A Song of Ascents. When the LORD brought back those who returned to Zion, we were like those who dream.
verses.zh: （上行之诗。）当耶和华将那些被掳的带回锡安的时候，我们好像做梦的人。

words.g: like + to bind firmly, i.e.  to be  plump

verses.en: Then our mouth was filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing. Then they said among the nations, “The LORD has done great things for them.”
verses.zh: 我们满口喜笑、满舌欢呼的时候，外邦中就有人说：耶和华为他们行了大事！

words.g: the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +us/our

verses.en: The LORD has done great things for us, and we are glad.
verses.zh: 耶和华果然为我们行了大事，我们就欢喜。

verses.en: Restore our fortunes again, LORD, like the streams in the Negev.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，求你使我们被掳的人归回，好像南地的河水复流。

verses.en: Those who sow in tears will reap in joy.
verses.zh: 流泪撒种的，必欢呼收割！

verses.en: He who goes out weeping, carrying seed for sowing, will certainly come again with joy, carrying his sheaves.
verses.zh: 那带种流泪出去的，必要欢欢乐乐地带禾捆回来！

verses.en: A Song of Ascents. By Solomon. Unless the LORD builds the house, they who build it labor in vain. Unless the LORD watches over the city, the watchman guards it in vain.
verses.zh: （所罗门上行之诗。）若不是耶和华建造房屋，建造的人就枉然劳力；若不是耶和华看守城池，看守的人就枉然警醒。

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!
used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: It is vain for you to rise up early, to stay up late, eating the bread of toil, for he gives sleep to his loved ones.
verses.zh: 你们清晨早起，夜晚安歇，吃劳碌得来的饭，本是枉然；惟有耶和华所亲爱的，必叫他安然睡觉。

words.g: to load up , i.e. to start early in the morning

verses.en: Behold, children are a heritage of the LORD. The fruit of the womb is his reward.
verses.zh: 儿女是耶和华所赐的产业；所怀的胎是他所给的赏赐。

verses.en: As arrows in the hand of a mighty man, so are the children of youth.
verses.zh: 少年时所生的儿女好像勇士手中的箭。

words.g: the + youth, the state  or the persons

verses.en: Happy is the man who has his quiver full of them. They won’t be disappointed when they speak with their enemies in the gate.
verses.zh: 箭袋充满的人便为有福；他们在城门口和仇敌说话的时候，必不至于羞愧。

words.g: the + a valiant man or warrior
to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed

verses.en: A Song of Ascents. Blessed is everyone who fears the LORD, who walks in his ways.
verses.zh: （上行之诗。）凡敬畏耶和华、遵行他道的人便为有福！

verses.en: For you will eat the labor of your hands. You will be happy, and it will be well with you.
verses.zh: 你要吃劳碌得来的；你要享福，事情顺利。

verses.en: Your wife will be as a fruitful vine in the innermost parts of your house, your children like olive shoots around your table.
verses.zh: 你妻子在你的内室，好像多结果子的葡萄树；你儿女围绕你的桌子，好像橄榄栽子。

words.g: like + a vine , especially the grape

verses.en: Behold, this is how the man who fears the LORD is blessed.
verses.zh: 看哪，敬畏耶和华的人必要这样蒙福！

verses.en: May the LORD bless you out of Zion, and may you see the good of Jerusalem all the days of your life.
verses.zh: 愿耶和华从锡安赐福给你！愿你一生一世看见耶路撒冷的好处！

words.g: from + Tsijon , a mountain of Jerusalem
in + good , in the widest sense
Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine

verses.en: Yes, may you see your children’s children. Peace be upon Israel.
verses.zh: 愿你看见你儿女的儿女！愿平安归于以色列！

verses.en: A Song of Ascents. Many times they have afflicted me from my youth up. Let Israel now say:
verses.zh: （上行之诗。）以色列当说：从我幼年以来，敌人屡次苦害我，

words.g: from + youth, the state  or the persons + +me/my

verses.en: many times they have afflicted me from my youth up, yet they have not prevailed against me.
verses.zh: 从我幼年以来，敌人屡次苦害我，却没有胜了我。

words.g: from + youth, the state  or the persons + +me/my

verses.en: The plowers plowed on my back. They made their furrows long.
verses.zh: 如同扶犁的在我背上扶犁而耕，耕的犁沟甚长。

verses.en: The LORD is righteous. He has cut apart the cords of the wicked.
verses.zh: 耶和华是公义的；他砍断了恶人的绳索。

verses.en: Let them be disappointed and turned backward, all those who hate Zion.
verses.zh: 愿恨恶锡安的都蒙羞退后！

words.g: to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed
and + to flinch, i.e.  to go back

verses.en: Let them be as the grass on the housetops, which withers before it grows up,
verses.zh: 愿他们像房顶上的草，未长成而枯干，

words.g: to pull out, up or off

verses.en: with which the reaper doesn’t fill his hand, nor he who binds sheaves, his bosom.
verses.zh: 收割的不够一把，捆禾的也不满怀。

verses.en: Neither do those who go by say, “The blessing of the LORD be on you. We bless you in the LORD’s name.”
verses.zh: 过路的也不说：愿耶和华所赐的福归与你们！我们奉耶和华的名给你们祝福！

verses.en: A Song of Ascents. Out of the depths I have cried to you, LORD.
verses.zh: （上行之诗。）耶和华啊，我从深处向你求告！

verses.en: Lord, hear my voice. Let your ears be attentive to the voice of my petitions.
verses.zh: 主啊，求你听我的声音！愿你侧耳听我恳求的声音！

verses.en: If you, LORD, kept a record of sins, Lord, who could stand?
verses.zh: 主―耶和华啊，你若究察罪孽，谁能站得住呢？

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: But there is forgiveness with you, therefore you are feared.
verses.zh: 但在你有赦免之恩，要叫人敬畏你。

verses.en: I wait for the LORD. My soul waits. I hope in his word.
verses.zh: 我等候耶和华，我的心等候；我也仰望他的话。

verses.en: My soul longs for the Lord more than watchmen long for the morning, more than watchmen for the morning.
verses.zh: 我的心等候主，胜于守夜的，等候天亮，胜于守夜的，等候天亮。

verses.en: Israel, hope in the LORD, for there is loving kindness with the LORD. Abundant redemption is with him.
verses.zh: 以色列啊，你当仰望耶和华！因他有慈爱，有丰盛的救恩。

verses.en: He will redeem Israel from all their sins.
verses.zh: 他必救赎以色列脱离一切的罪孽。

verses.en: A Song of Ascents. By David. LORD, my heart isn’t arrogant, nor my eyes lofty; nor do I concern myself with great matters, or things too wonderful for me.
verses.zh: （大卫上行之诗。）耶和华啊，我的心不狂傲，我的眼不高大；重大和测不透的事，我也不敢行。

words.g: to be high actively, to rise or raise
and + in + perhaps to separate, i.e. distinguish

verses.en: Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul, like a weaned child with his mother, like a weaned child is my soul within me.
verses.zh: 我的心平稳安静，好像断过奶的孩子在他母亲的怀中；我的心在我里面真像断过奶的孩子。

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!
like + to treat a person , i.e. benefit or requite
like + to treat a person , i.e. benefit or requite

verses.en: Israel, hope in the LORD, from this time forward and forever more.
verses.zh: 以色列啊，你当仰望耶和华，从今时直到永远！

verses.en: A Song of Ascents. LORD, remember David and all his affliction,
verses.zh: （上行之诗。）耶和华啊，求你记念大卫所受的一切苦难！

verses.en: how he swore to the LORD, and vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob:
verses.zh: 他怎样向耶和华起誓，向雅各的大能者许愿，

verses.en: “Surely I will not come into the structure of my house, nor go up into my bed;
verses.zh: 说：我必不进我的帐幕，也不上我的床榻；

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!
used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: I will not give sleep to my eyes, or slumber to my eyelids,
verses.zh: 我不容我的眼睛睡觉，也不容我的眼目打盹；

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: until I find out a place for the LORD, a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob.”
verses.zh: 直等我为耶和华寻得所在，为雅各的大能者寻得居所。

verses.en: Behold, we heard of it in Ephrathah. We found it in the field of Jaar.
verses.zh: 我们听说约柜在以法他，我们在基列・耶琳就寻见了。

words.g: in + Ephrath, another name for Bethlehem

verses.en: “We will go into his dwelling place. We will worship at his footstool.”
verses.zh: 我们要进他的居所，在他脚凳前下拜。

verses.en: Arise, LORD, into your resting place, you, and the ark of your strength.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，求你兴起，和你有能力的约柜同入安息之所！

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: Let your priests be clothed with righteousness. Let your saints shout for joy!
verses.zh: 愿你的祭司披上公义！愿你的圣民欢呼！

verses.en: For your servant David’s sake, don’t turn away the face of your anointed one.
verses.zh: 求你因你仆人大卫的缘故，不要厌弃你的受膏者！

verses.en: The LORD has sworn to David in truth. He will not turn from it: “I will set the fruit of your body on your throne.
verses.zh: 耶和华向大卫、凭诚实起了誓，必不反覆，说：我要使你所生的坐在你的宝座上。

verses.en: If your children will keep my covenant, my testimony that I will teach them, their children also will sit on your throne forever more.”
verses.zh: 你的众子若守我的约和我所教训他们的法度，他们的子孙必永远坐在你的宝座上。

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: For the LORD has chosen Zion. He has desired it for his habitation.
verses.zh: 因为耶和华拣选了锡安，愿意当作自己的居所，

words.g: in + Tsijon , a mountain of Jerusalem

verses.en: “This is my resting place forever. I will live here, for I have desired it.
verses.zh: 说：这是我永远安息之所；我要住在这里，因为是我所愿意的。

words.g: this place , i.e. here or hence

verses.en: I will abundantly bless her provision. I will satisfy her poor with bread.
verses.zh: 我要使其中的粮食丰满，使其中的穷人饱足。

verses.en: I will also clothe her priests with salvation. Her saints will shout aloud for joy.
verses.zh: 我要使祭司披上救恩，圣民大声欢呼！

verses.en: I will make the horn of David to bud there. I have ordained a lamp for my anointed.
verses.zh: 我要叫大卫的角在那里发生；我为我的受膏者预备明灯。

words.g: to set in a row, i.e. arrange

verses.en: I will clothe his enemies with shame, but on himself, his crown will shine.”
verses.zh: 我要使他的仇敌披上羞耻；但他的冠冕要在头上发光。

verses.en: A Song of Ascents. By David. See how good and how pleasant it is for brothers to live together in unity!
verses.zh: （大卫上行之诗。）看哪，弟兄和睦同居是何等地善，何等地美！

verses.en: It is like the precious oil on the head, that ran down on the beard, even Aaron’s beard, that came down on the edge of his robes,
verses.zh: 这好比那贵重的油浇在亚伦的头上，流到胡须，又流到他的衣襟；

words.g: the mouth , whether literal or figurative

verses.en: like the dew of Hermon, that comes down on the hills of Zion; for there the LORD gives the blessing, even life forever more.
verses.zh: 又好比黑门的甘露降在锡安山；因为在那里有耶和华所命定的福，就是永远的生命。

verses.en: A Song of Ascents. Look! Praise the LORD, all you servants of the LORD, who stand by night in the LORD’s house!
verses.zh: （上行之诗。）耶和华的仆人夜间站在耶和华殿中的，你们当称颂耶和华！

verses.en: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary. Praise the LORD!
verses.zh: 你们当向圣所举手，称颂耶和华！

verses.zh: 耶和华拣选雅各归自己，拣选以色列特作自己的子民。

verses.zh: 原来我知道耶和华为大，也知道我们的主超乎万神之上。

verses.zh: 耶和华在天上，在地下，在海中，在一切的深处，都随自己的意旨而行。

verses.zh: 主―耶和华、我救恩的力量啊，在争战的日子，你遮蔽了我的头。

verses.en: LORD, don’t grant the desires of the wicked. Don’t let their evil plans succeed, or they will become proud. Selah.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，求你不要遂恶人的心愿；不要成就他们的计谋，恐怕他们自高。（细拉）

words.g: to be high actively, to rise or raise

verses.en: As for the head of those who surround me, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.
verses.zh: 至于那些昂首围困我的人，愿他们嘴唇的奸恶陷害（原文是遮蔽）自己！

verses.en: Let burning coals fall on them. Let them be thrown into the fire, into miry pits, from where they never rise.
verses.zh: 愿火炭落在他们身上！愿他们被丢在火中，抛在深坑里，不能再起来。

verses.en: An evil speaker won’t be established on the earth. Evil will hunt the violent man to overthrow him.
verses.zh: 说恶言的人在地上必坚立不住；祸患必猎取强暴的人，将他打倒。

verses.en: I know that the LORD will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and justice for the needy.
verses.zh: 我知道耶和华必为困苦人伸冤，必为穷乏人辨屈。

verses.en: Surely the righteous will give thanks to your name. The upright will dwell in your presence.
verses.zh: 义人必要称赞你的名；正直人必住在你面前。

verses.en: A Psalm by David. LORD, I have called on you. Come to me quickly! Listen to my voice when I call to you.
verses.zh: （大卫的诗。）耶和华啊，我曾求告你，求你快快临到我这里！我求告你的时候，愿你留心听我的声音！

words.g: to broaden out the ear , i.e.  to listen

verses.en: Let my prayer be set before you like incense; the lifting up of my hands like the evening sacrifice.
verses.zh: 愿我的祷告如香陈列在你面前！愿我举手祈求，如献晚祭！

verses.en: Set a watch, LORD, before my mouth. Keep the door of my lips.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，求你禁止我的口，把守我的嘴！

words.g: to + the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +me/my
to guard, in a good sense  or a bad one
something swinging, i.e. the valve of adoor

verses.en: Don’t incline my heart to any evil thing, to practice deeds of wickedness with men who work iniquity. Don’t let me eat of their delicacies.
verses.zh: 求你不叫我的心偏向邪恶，以致我和作孽的人同行恶事；也不叫我吃他们的美食。

words.g: to do or make , especially to practise

verses.en: Let the righteous strike me, it is kindness; let him reprove me, it is like oil on the head; don’t let my head refuse it; Yet my prayer is always against evil deeds.
verses.zh: 任凭义人击打我，这算为仁慈；任凭他责备我，这算为头上的膏油；我的头不要躲闪。正在他们行恶的时候，我仍要祈祷。

verses.en: Their judges are thrown down by the sides of the rock. They will hear my words, for they are well spoken.
verses.zh: 他们的审判官被扔在岩下；众人要听我的话，因为这话甘甜。

words.g: a craggy rock, literally or figuratively

verses.en: “As when one plows and breaks up the earth, our bones are scattered at the mouth of Sheol.”
verses.zh: 我们的骨头散在墓旁，好像人耕田、刨地的土块。

words.g: a form of the prefix 'k-', but used separately  as
to slice, i.e. break open or pierce
to scatter, whether in enmity or bounty
to + the mouth , whether literal or figurative

verses.en: For my eyes are on you, LORD, the Lord. I take refuge in you. Don’t leave my soul destitute.
verses.zh: 主―耶和华啊，我的眼目仰望你；我投靠你，求你不要将我撇得孤苦！

verses.en: Keep me from the snare which they have laid for me, from the traps of the workers of iniquity.
verses.zh: 求你保护我脱离恶人为我设的网罗和作孽之人的圈套！

words.g: to do or make , especially to practise

verses.en: Let the wicked fall together into their own nets while I pass by.
verses.zh: 愿恶人落在自己的网里，我却得以逃脱。

verses.en: A contemplation by David, when he was in the cave. A Prayer.
verses.zh: （大卫在洞里作的训诲诗，乃是祈祷。）

verses.en: I cry with my voice to the LORD. With my voice, I ask the LORD for mercy.
verses.zh: 我发声哀告耶和华，发声恳求耶和华。

verses.en: I pour out my complaint before him. I tell him my troubles.
verses.zh: 我在他面前吐露我的苦情，陈说我的患难。

verses.en: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, you knew my route. On the path in which I walk, they have hidden a snare for me.
verses.zh: 我的灵在我里面发昏的时候，你知道我的道路。在我行的路上，敌人为我暗设网罗。

words.g: and + thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: Look on my right, and see; for there is no one who is concerned for me. Refuge has fled from me. No one cares for my soul.
verses.zh: 求你向我右边观看，因为没有人认识我；我无处避难，也没有人眷顾我。

words.g: to scrutinize, i.e. look intently at

verses.en: I cried to you, LORD. I said, “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，我曾向你哀求。我说：你是我的避难所；在活人之地，你是我的福分。

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: Listen to my cry, for I am in desperate need. Deliver me from my persecutors, for they are too strong for me.
verses.zh: 求你侧耳听我的呼求，因我落到极卑之地；求你救我脱离逼迫我的人，因为他们比我强盛。

words.g: to prick up the ears, i.e. hearken
to be alert, physically  or mentally

verses.en: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may give thanks to your name. The righteous will surround me, for you will be good to me.
verses.zh: 求你领我出离被囚之地，我好称赞你的名。义人必环绕我，因为你是用厚恩待我。

words.g: from + a fastener, i.e.  a smith
to treat a person , i.e. benefit or requite

verses.en: A Psalm by David. Hear my prayer, LORD. Listen to my petitions. In your faithfulness and righteousness, relieve me.
verses.zh: （大卫的诗。）耶和华啊，求你听我的祷告，留心听我的恳求，凭你的信实和公义应允我。

words.g: to broaden out the ear , i.e.  to listen

verses.en: Don’t enter into judgment with your servant, for in your sight no man living is righteous.
verses.zh: 求你不要审问仆人；因为在你面前，凡活着的人没有一个是义的。

verses.en: For the enemy pursues my soul. He has struck my life down to the ground. He has made me live in dark places, as those who have been long dead.
verses.zh: 原来仇敌逼迫我，将我打倒在地，使我住在幽暗之处，像死了许久的人一样。

verses.en: Therefore my spirit is overwhelmed within me. My heart within me is desolate.
verses.zh: 所以，我的灵在我里面发昏；我的心在我里面凄惨。

words.g: to stun , i.e. devastate or  stupefy

verses.en: I remember the days of old. I meditate on all your doings. I contemplate the work of your hands.
verses.zh: 我追想古时之日，思想你的一切作为，默念你手的工作。

words.g: to ponder, i.e.  converse  or  utter

verses.en: I spread out my hands to you. My soul thirsts for you, like a parched land. Selah.
verses.zh: 我向你举手；我的心渴想你，如干旱之地盼雨一样。（细拉）

verses.en: Hurry to answer me, LORD. My spirit fails. Don’t hide your face from me, so that I don’t become like those who go down into the pit.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，求你速速应允我！我心神耗尽！不要向我掩面，免得我像那些下坑的人一样。

words.g: to end, whether intransitive  or transitived
and + to liken, i.e.  to use figurative language

verses.en: Cause me to hear your loving kindness in the morning, for I trust in you. Cause me to know the way in which I should walk, for I lift up my soul to you.
verses.zh: 求你使我清晨得听你慈爱之言，因我倚靠你；求你使我知道当行的路，因我的心仰望你。

verses.en: Deliver me, LORD, from my enemies. I flee to you to hide me.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，求你救我脱离我的仇敌！我往你那里藏身。

verses.en: Teach me to do your will, for you are my God. Your Spirit is good. Lead me in the land of uprightness.
verses.zh: 求你指教我遵行你的旨意，因你是我的神。你的灵本为善；求你引我到平坦之地。

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you
a level, i.e. a plain  as a proper name of certain districts)

verses.en: Revive me, LORD, for your name’s sake. In your righteousness, bring my soul out of trouble.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，求你为你的名将我救活，凭你的公义，将我从患难中领出来，

words.g: to live, whether literally or figuratively + +me/my

verses.en: In your loving kindness, cut off my enemies, and destroy all those who afflict my soul, for I am your servant.
verses.zh: 凭你的慈爱剪除我的仇敌，灭绝一切苦待我的人，因我是你的仆人。

verses.en: By David. Blessed be the LORD, my rock, who trains my hands to war, and my fingers to battle—
verses.zh: （大卫的诗。）耶和华―我的磐石是应当称颂的！他教导我的手争战，教导我的指头打仗。

words.g: the + to goad, i.e.  to teach
something to sieze with, i.e. a finger + +me/my

verses.en: my loving kindness, my fortress, my high tower, my deliverer, my shield, and he in whom I take refuge, who subdues my people under me.
verses.zh: 他是我慈爱的主，我的山寨，我的高台，我的救主，我的盾牌，是我所投靠的；他使我的百姓服在我以下。

words.g: the + to tread in pieces, i.e.  to conquer

verses.en: LORD, what is man, that you care for him? Or the son of man, that you think of him?
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，人算甚么，你竟认识他！世人算甚么，你竟顾念他！

verses.en: Man is like a breath. His days are like a shadow that passes away.
verses.zh: 人好像一口气；他的年日如同影儿快快过去。

verses.en: Part your heavens, LORD, and come down. Touch the mountains, and they will smoke.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，求你使天下垂，亲自降临，摸山，山就冒烟。

words.g: and + to smoke, whether literal or figurative

verses.en: Throw out lightning, and scatter them. Send out your arrows, and rout them.
verses.zh: 求你发出闪电，使他们四散，射出你的箭，使他们扰乱。

words.g: and + to dash in pieces, literally or figuratively + +them/their

verses.en: Stretch out your hand from above, rescue me, and deliver me out of great waters, out of the hands of foreigners,
verses.zh: 求你从上伸手救拔我，救我出离大水，救我脱离外邦人的手。

verses.en: whose mouths speak deceit, whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
verses.zh: 他们的口说谎话；他们的右手起假誓。

words.g: the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +them/their

verses.en: I will sing a new song to you, God. On a ten-stringed lyre, I will sing praises to you.
verses.zh: 神啊，我要向你唱新歌，用十弦瑟向你歌颂。

verses.en: You are he who gives salvation to kings, who rescues David, his servant, from the deadly sword.
verses.zh: 你是那拯救君王的；你是那救仆人大卫脱离害命之刀的。

verses.en: Rescue me, and deliver me out of the hands of foreigners, whose mouths speak deceit, whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
verses.zh: 求你救拔我，救我脱离外邦人的手。他们的口说谎话；他们的右手起假誓。

words.g: the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +them/their

verses.en: Then our sons will be like well-nurtured plants, our daughters like pillars carved to adorn a palace.
verses.zh: 我们的儿子从幼年好像树栽子长大；我们的女儿如同殿角石，是按建宫的样式凿成的。

words.g: in + youth, the state  or the persons + +them/their
like + an angle , i.e.  a corner-column

verses.en: Our barns are full, filled with all kinds of provision. Our sheep produce thousands and ten thousands in our fields.
verses.zh: 我们的仓盈满，能出各样的粮食；我们的羊在田间孳生千万。

words.g: from + nourished , i.e. a form or sort
nourished , i.e. a form or sort
in + separate by awall, i.e. outside + +us/our

verses.en: Our oxen will pull heavy loads. There is no breaking in, and no going away, and no outcry in our streets.
verses.zh: 我们的牛驮着满驮，没有人闯进来抢夺，也没有人出去争战；我们的街市上也没有哭号的声音。

words.g: in + a width, i.e.  avenue or area + +us/our

verses.en: Happy are the people who are in such a situation. Happy are the people whose God is the LORD.
verses.zh: 遇见这光景的百姓便为有福！有耶和华为他们的神，这百姓便为有福！

words.g: which, that + just so, referring to the previous or following context

verses.en: A praise psalm by David.145:0 This is an acrostic psalm, with every verse (including the second half of verse 13) starting with a consecutive letter of the Hebrew alphabet. I will exalt you, my God, the King. I will praise your name forever and ever.
verses.zh: （大卫的赞美诗。）我的神我的王啊，我要尊崇你！我要永永远远称颂你的名！

words.g: to be high actively, to rise or raise + +you/your

verses.en: Every day I will praise you. I will extol your name forever and ever.
verses.zh: 我要天天称颂你，也要永永远远赞美你的名！

verses.en: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised! His greatness is unsearchable.
verses.zh: 耶和华本为大，该受大赞美；其大无法测度。

verses.en: One generation will commend your works to another, and will declare your mighty acts.
verses.zh: 这代要对那代颂赞你的作为，也要传扬你的大能。

words.g: to address in aloud tone, i.e.  loud

verses.en: I will meditate on the glorious majesty of your honor, on your wondrous works.
verses.zh: 我要默念你威严的尊荣和你奇妙的作为。

words.g: weight, but only figuratively in a good sense
to ponder, i.e.  converse  or  utter

verses.en: Men will speak of the might of your awesome acts. I will declare your greatness.
verses.zh: 人要传说你可畏之事的能力；我也要传扬你的大德。

words.g: to score with a mark as a tally or record, i.e.  to inscribe + +her/its

verses.en: They will utter the memory of your great goodness, and will sing of your righteousness.
verses.zh: 他们记念你的大恩就要传出来，并要歌唱你的公义。

verses.en: The LORD is gracious, merciful, slow to anger, and of great loving kindness.
verses.zh: 耶和华有恩惠，有怜悯，不轻易发怒，大有慈爱。

verses.en: The LORD is good to all. His tender mercies are over all his works.
verses.zh: 耶和华善待万民；他的慈悲覆庇他一切所造的。

verses.en: All your works will give thanks to you, LORD. Your saints will extol you.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，你一切所造的都要称谢你；你的圣民也要称颂你，

verses.en: They will speak of the glory of your kingdom, and talk about your power,
verses.zh: 传说你国的荣耀，谈论你的大能，

words.g: weight, but only figuratively in a good sense

verses.en: to make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, the glory of the majesty of his kingdom.
verses.zh: 好叫世人知道你大能的作为，并你国度威严的荣耀。

words.g: and + weight, but only figuratively in a good sense

verses.en: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom. Your dominion endures throughout all generations. The LORD is faithful in all his words, and loving in all his deeds.
verses.zh: 你的国是永远的国！你执掌的权柄存到万代！

verses.en: The LORD upholds all who fall, and raises up all those who are bowed down.
verses.zh: 凡跌倒的，耶和华将他们扶持；凡被压下的，将他们扶起。

verses.en: The eyes of all wait for you. You give them their food in due season.
verses.zh: 万民都举目仰望你；你随时给他们食物。

words.g: and + thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: You open your hand, and satisfy the desire of every living thing.
verses.zh: 你张手，使有生气的都随愿饱足。

verses.en: The LORD is righteous in all his ways, and gracious in all his works.
verses.zh: 耶和华在他一切所行的，无不公义；在他一切所做的都有慈爱。

verses.en: The LORD is near to all those who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.
verses.zh: 凡求告耶和华的，就是诚心求告他的，耶和华便与他们相近。

verses.en: He will fulfill the desire of those who fear him. He also will hear their cry, and will save them.
verses.zh: 敬畏他的，他必成就他们的心愿，也必听他们的呼求，拯救他们。

words.g: and + to be open, wide or free + +them/their

verses.en: The LORD preserves all those who love him, but he will destroy all the wicked.
verses.zh: 耶和华保护一切爱他的人，却要灭绝一切的恶人。

verses.en: My mouth will speak the praise of the LORD. Let all flesh bless his holy name forever and ever.
verses.zh: 我的口要说出赞美耶和华的话；惟愿凡有血气的都永永远远称颂他的圣名。

words.g: the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +me/my

verses.en: Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD, my soul.
verses.zh: 你们要赞美耶和华！我的心哪，你要赞美耶和华！

verses.en: While I live, I will praise the LORD. I will sing praises to my God as long as I exist.
verses.zh: 我一生要赞美耶和华！我还活的时候要歌颂我的神！

verses.en: Don’t put your trust in princes, in a son of man in whom there is no help.
verses.zh: 你们不要倚靠君王，不要倚靠世人；他一点不能帮助。

verses.en: His spirit departs, and he returns to the earth. In that very day, his thoughts perish.
verses.zh: 他的气一断，就归回尘土；他所打算的，当日就消灭了。

verses.en: Happy is he who has the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in the LORD, his God,
verses.zh: 以雅各的神为帮助、仰望耶和华―他神的，这人便为有福！

verses.en: who made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them; who keeps truth forever;
verses.zh: 耶和华造天、地、海，和其中的万物；他守诚实，直到永远。

verses.en: who executes justice for the oppressed; who gives food to the hungry. The LORD frees the prisoners.
verses.zh: 他为受屈的伸冤，赐食物与饥饿的。耶和华释放被囚的；

words.g: to + to press upon, i.e. oppress
to jump, i.e. be violently agitated

verses.zh: 耶和华开了瞎子的眼睛；耶和华扶起被压下的人。耶和华喜爱义人。

verses.en: The LORD preserves the foreigners. He upholds the fatherless and widow, but he turns the way of the wicked upside down.
verses.zh: 耶和华保护寄居的，扶持孤儿和寡妇，却使恶人的道路弯曲。

verses.en: The LORD will reign forever; your God, O Zion, to all generations. Praise the LORD!
verses.zh: 耶和华要作王，直到永远！锡安哪，你的神要作王，直到万代！你们要赞美耶和华！

verses.en: Praise the LORD, for it is good to sing praises to our God; for it is pleasant and fitting to praise him.
verses.zh: 你们要赞美耶和华！因歌颂我们的神为善为美；赞美的话是合宜的。

verses.en: The LORD builds up Jerusalem. He gathers together the outcasts of Israel.
verses.zh: 耶和华建造耶路撒冷，聚集以色列中被赶散的人。

words.g: Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine

verses.en: He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.
verses.zh: 他医好伤心的人，裹好他们的伤处。

words.g: the + to mend , i.e.  to cure

verses.en: He counts the number of the stars. He calls them all by their names.
verses.zh: 他数点星宿的数目，一一称他的名。

verses.en: Great is our Lord, and mighty in power. His understanding is infinite.
verses.zh: 我们的主为大，最有能力；他的智慧无法测度。

verses.en: The LORD upholds the humble. He brings the wicked down to the ground.
verses.zh: 耶和华扶持谦卑人，将恶人倾覆于地。

verses.en: Sing to the LORD with thanksgiving. Sing praises on the harp to our God,
verses.zh: 你们要以感谢向耶和华歌唱，用琴向我们的神歌颂。

verses.en: who covers the sky with clouds, who prepares rain for the earth, who makes grass grow on the mountains.
verses.zh: 他用云遮天，为地降雨，使草生长在山上。

verses.en: He provides food for the livestock, and for the young ravens when they call.
verses.zh: 他赐食给走兽和啼叫的小乌鸦。

verses.en: He doesn’t delight in the strength of the horse. He takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.
verses.zh: 他不喜悦马的力大，不喜爱人的腿快。

verses.en: The LORD takes pleasure in those who fear him, in those who hope in his loving kindness.
verses.zh: 耶和华喜爱敬畏他和盼望他慈爱的人。

verses.en: Praise the LORD, Jerusalem! Praise your God, Zion!
verses.zh: 耶路撒冷啊，你要颂赞耶和华！锡安哪，你要赞美你的神！

words.g: to address in aloud tone, i.e.  loud
Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine

verses.en: For he has strengthened the bars of your gates. He has blessed your children within you.
verses.zh: 因为他坚固了你的门闩，赐福给你中间的儿女。

words.g: in + the nearest part, i.e. the center + +you/your

verses.en: He makes peace in your borders. He fills you with the finest of the wheat.
verses.zh: 他使你境内平安，用上好的麦子使你满足。

words.g: wheat, whether the grain or the plant

verses.en: He sends out his commandment to the earth. His word runs very swiftly.
verses.zh: 他发命在地；他的话颁行最快。

verses.en: He gives snow like wool, and scatters frost like ashes.
verses.zh: 他降雪如羊毛，撒霜如炉灰。

words.g: to scatter, whether in enmity or bounty

verses.en: He hurls down his hail like pebbles. Who can stand before his cold?
verses.zh: 他掷下冰雹如碎渣；他发出寒冷，谁能当得起呢？

verses.en: He sends out his word, and melts them. He causes his wind to blow, and the waters flow.
verses.zh: 他一出令，这些就都消化；他使风刮起，水便流动。

words.g: to drip, or shed by trickling

verses.en: He shows his word to Jacob, his statutes and his ordinances to Israel.
verses.zh: 他将他的道指示雅各，将他的律例典章指示以色列。

verses.en: He has not done this for just any nation. They don’t know his ordinances. Praise the LORD!
verses.zh: 别国他都没有这样待过；至于他的典章，他们向来没有知道。你们要赞美耶和华！

verses.en: Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD from the heavens! Praise him in the heights!
verses.zh: 你们要赞美耶和华！从天上赞美耶和华，在高处赞美他！

verses.en: Praise him, all his angels! Praise him, all his army!
verses.zh: 他的众使者都要赞美他！他的诸军都要赞美他！

words.g: a mass of persons , especially reg. organized forwar + +him/his/it

verses.en: Praise him, sun and moon! Praise him, all you shining stars!
verses.zh: 日头月亮，你们要赞美他！放光的星宿，你们都要赞美他！

verses.en: Praise him, you heavens of heavens, you waters that are above the heavens.
verses.zh: 天上的天和天上的水，你们都要赞美他！

verses.en: Let them praise the LORD’s name, for he commanded, and they were created.
verses.zh: 愿这些都赞美耶和华的名！因他一吩咐便都造成。

verses.en: He has also established them forever and ever. He has made a decree which will not pass away.
verses.zh: 他将这些立定，直到永永远远；他定了命，不能废去（或译：越过）。

verses.en: Praise the LORD from the earth, you great sea creatures, and all depths,
verses.zh: 所有在地上的，大鱼和一切深洋，

words.g: a marine or land monster, i.e. sea-serpent or jackal

verses.en: lightning and hail, snow and clouds, stormy wind, fulfilling his word,
verses.zh: 火与冰雹，雪和雾气，成就他命的狂风，

verses.en: mountains and all hills, fruit trees and all cedars,
verses.zh: 大山和小山，结果的树木和一切香柏树，

verses.en: wild animals and all livestock, small creatures and flying birds,
verses.zh: 野兽和一切牲畜，昆虫和飞鸟，

verses.en: kings of the earth and all peoples, princes and all judges of the earth,
verses.zh: 世上的君王和万民，首领和世上一切审判官，

verses.en: both young men and maidens, old men and children.
verses.zh: 少年人和处女，老年人和孩童，都当赞美耶和华！

words.g: a boy , from the age of infancy to adolescence

verses.en: Let them praise the LORD’s name, for his name alone is exalted. His glory is above the earth and the heavens.
verses.zh: 愿这些都赞美耶和华的名！因为独有他的名被尊崇；他的荣耀在天地之上。

verses.en: He has lifted up the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints, even of the children of Israel, a people near to him. Praise the LORD!
verses.zh: 他将他百姓的角高举，因此他（或译：他使）一切圣民以色列人，就是与他相近的百姓，都赞美他！你们要赞美耶和华！

words.g: and + to be high actively, to rise or raise

verses.en: Praise the LORD! Sing to the LORD a new song, his praise in the assembly of the saints.
verses.zh: 你们要赞美耶和华！向耶和华唱新歌，在圣民的会中赞美他！

verses.en: Let Israel rejoice in him who made them. Let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.
verses.zh: 愿以色列因造他的主欢喜！愿锡安的民因他们的王快乐！

words.g: to spin round , i.e. usually rejoice

verses.en: Let them praise his name in the dance! Let them sing praises to him with tambourine and harp!
verses.zh: 愿他们跳舞赞美他的名，击鼓弹琴歌颂他！

verses.en: For the LORD takes pleasure in his people. He crowns the humble with salvation.
verses.zh: 因为耶和华喜爱他的百姓；他要用救恩当作谦卑人的妆饰。

verses.en: Let the saints rejoice in honor. Let them sing for joy on their beds.
verses.zh: 愿圣民因所得的荣耀高兴！愿他们在床上欢呼！

words.g: to jump for joy, i.e. exult
in + weight, but only figuratively in a good sense

verses.en: May the high praises of God be in their mouths, and a two-edged sword in their hand,
verses.zh: 愿他们口中称赞神为高，手里有两刃的刀，

verses.en: to execute vengeance on the nations, and punishments on the peoples;
verses.zh: 为要报复列邦，刑罚万民。

words.g: avengement, whether the act of the passion

verses.en: to bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;
verses.zh: 要用链子捆他们的君王，用铁镣锁他们的大臣；

words.g: in + what leaps forth, i.e. flash of fire

verses.en: to execute on them the written judgment. All his saints have this honor. Praise the LORD!
verses.zh: 要在他们身上施行所记录的审判。他的圣民都有这荣耀。你们要赞美耶和华！

verses.en: Praise the LORD! Praise God in his sanctuary! Praise him in his heavens for his acts of power!
verses.zh: 你们要赞美耶和华！在神的圣所赞美他！在他显能力的穹苍赞美他！

verses.en: Praise him for his mighty acts! Praise him according to his excellent greatness!
verses.zh: 要因他大能的作为赞美他，按着他极美的大德赞美他！

verses.en: Praise him with the sounding of the trumpet! Praise him with harp and lyre!
verses.zh: 要用角声赞美他，鼓瑟弹琴赞美他！

words.g: in + a blast of a trumpet

verses.en: Praise him with tambourine and dancing! Praise him with stringed instruments and flute!
verses.zh: 击鼓跳舞赞美他！用丝弦的乐器和箫的声音赞美他！

verses.en: Praise him with loud cymbals! Praise him with resounding cymbals!
verses.zh: 用大响的钹赞美他！用高声的钹赞美他！

words.g: clamor, i.e. acclamation of joy or a battle-cry

verses.en: Let everything that has breath praise the LORD! Praise the LORD!
verses.zh: 凡有气息的都要赞美耶和华！你们要赞美耶和华！
